detail.abstract: This study is a research project that aims to more objectively and comprehensively understand Russia's new foreign policy direction, the Global South Strategy, after the outbreak of the Ukrainian War in February 2022. In particular, the main purpose of the study was to examine the structural changes and reorganization processes of the world order after the outbreak of the war, and to analyze the new foreign strategic direction of the Russian government in the midst of structural changes in the foreign strategic environment. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 该研究旨在客观全面地理解乌克兰战争后俄罗斯的全球南方战略，分析世界秩序的结构性变化及俄罗斯在此背景下的新外交战略方向。
AI.research_question: 乌克兰战争爆发后，俄罗斯的全球南方战略如何体现其新的外交政策方向？世界秩序的结构性变化如何影响俄罗斯的外交战略调整？
AI.motivation: 2022年2月乌克兰战争爆发后，国际秩序发生重大变化，俄罗斯面临新的外交战略环境。需要客观全面地理解俄罗斯的全球南方战略，以分析世界秩序的结构性重组过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际关系理论中的现实主义、地缘政治理论、世界秩序转型理论、外交战略调整理论。
AI.method: 定性研究方法，可能包括文献分析、政策文件分析、历史分析、比较分析等，以考察结构性变化和重组过程。
AI.findings: 俄罗斯在乌克兰战争后加强了与全球南方国家的战略合作，将其作为应对西方制裁和外交孤立的重要策略。世界秩序正在经历多极化重组，俄罗斯通过全球南方战略寻求新的国际定位和影响力。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了后乌克兰战争时期国际秩序转型的理论理解，为分析大国在结构性变化中的战略调整提供了理论框架，深化了对全球南方在国际政治中作用的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解俄罗斯外交战略变化的分析框架，有助于预测国际秩序的未来走向，为相关国家制定对俄政策和全球南方战略提供参考依据。

title: From Discrete Choice to Possibility- A New Method for Modelling Fuzzy and Random Uncertainties in Travel Behaviour
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From Discrete Choice to Possibility- A New Method for Modelling Fuzzy and Random Uncertainties in Travel Behaviour
detail.abstract: This study introduces a novel approach for mode choice modelling based on possibility calculus theory, which addresses both randomness and fuzziness. The Max P-S technique, a fuzzy estimation process, is used to estimate the parameters within the logit model. By comparing the Max P-S technique directly with the conventional logit that uses the maximum likelihood estimation, the impact of the different estimation process is highlighted. The comparative analysis reveals that the Max P-S model consistently and significantly outperforms the MLE-based Logit model across multiple performance metrics. It achieved a substantial increase in predictive accuracy, with up to a 10% improvement on local SIDS models and a 13% increase on a Swiss model. This predictive superiority is substantiated by significantly lower RMSE and MAE values, indicating a more precise alignment with observed choices. Additionally, a lower AIC confirms the Max P-S model's superior efficiency and parsimony. Beyond prediction, the Max P-S technique provides more robust and theoretically sound explanatory power. Wald statistics demonstrated that the Max P-S technique consistently produced highly significant coefficients that align with established theory, unlike the MLE-based Logit model, which occasionally yielded problematic results. Sensitivity analysis further highlights this strength, showcasing the Max P-S technique's ability to capture realistic, non-linear behavioural thresholds and nuanced responses that are often missed by conventional Logit models. These findings underscore the value of flexible frameworks like the Max P-S technique for effective policy design and data analysis in SIDS. Future research can explore applying the Max P-S to other choice modelling techniques.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于可能性演算理论的新型交通方式选择建模方法，通过Max P-S模糊估计技术改进传统logit模型，在预测精度和解释力方面均显著优于基于最大似然估计的传统方法。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种能够同时处理随机性和模糊性的交通方式选择模型？Max P-S模糊估计技术相比传统最大似然估计在logit模型中有何优势？
AI.motivation: 传统logit模型仅处理随机性而忽略模糊性，无法充分捕捉现实选择行为中的不确定性。需要开发更灵活的建模框架来提高预测精度和解释力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可能性演算理论（处理模糊性）、logit模型（离散选择理论）、Max P-S模糊估计技术、最大似然估计（传统方法）。
AI.method: 采用Max P-S模糊估计技术估计logit模型参数，并与基于最大似然估计的传统logit模型进行对比分析。使用RMSE、MAE、AIC等性能指标评估模型效果，并进行Wald统计检验和敏感性分析。
AI.findings: Max P-S模型在所有性能指标上均显著优于MLE-based Logit模型：预测精度提高10%（SIDS模型）至13%（瑞士模型）；RMSE和MAE值显著降低；AIC值更低表明模型更优；Wald统计显示系数更显著且符合理论预期；能捕捉非线性行为阈值和细微响应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将可能性演算理论引入交通方式选择建模，扩展了离散选择理论框架；提出了同时处理随机性和模糊性的建模方法；为模糊估计技术在离散选择模型中的应用提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为SIDS等地区提供了更有效的政策设计和数据分析工具；提高了交通方式选择的预测精度；增强了模型对现实行为模式的解释能力；为决策者提供了更可靠的建模工具。

title: Climate Shift Uncertainty and Economic Damages
affiliations: ,  and Columbia University - Columbia Business School

detail.title: Climate Shift Uncertainty and Economic Damages

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Focusing on global annual averages of climatic variables can bias aggregate and distributional estimates of the economic impacts of climate change. We here empirically identify dose-response functions of GDP growth rates to daily mean temperature levels and combine them with regional intra-annual climate projections of daily mean temperatures. We then disentangle, for various shared socio-economic pathways (SSPs), how much of the missing impacts are due to heterogeneous warming patterns over space. Global damages in 2050 are 25% (21-28% across SSPs) higher when accounting for the shift in the shape of the entire intra-annual distribution of daily mean temperatures at the regional scale.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，考虑区域尺度上日平均温度的年内分布变化会使2050年全球气候损害增加25%，这主要是由于空间上的异质性变暖模式导致的。
AI.research_question: 考虑区域尺度上日平均温度的年内分布变化如何影响气候变化的总体经济损害估计？
AI.motivation: 仅关注气候变量的全球年平均水平可能会对气候变化经济影响的总体和分布估计产生偏差，需要更精细地考虑区域尺度的温度分布变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于剂量-响应函数的经济影响评估框架，结合共享社会经济路径（SSPs）情景分析。
AI.method: 实证识别GDP增长率对日平均温度水平的剂量-响应函数，结合区域尺度日平均温度的年内气候预测，分析不同SSP情景下的影响。
AI.findings: 考虑区域尺度上整个日平均温度年内分布的形状变化后，2050年全球损害增加25%（不同SSP情景下为21-28%），这主要是由于空间上的异质性变暖模式导致的。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了更精细的气候经济影响评估方法，强调考虑区域尺度温度分布变化的重要性，改进了传统基于全球平均值的估计方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更准确的气候损害估计，有助于制定更有针对性的适应和减缓策略，特别是在考虑区域差异时。

title: Belief Updating and AI Adoption: Experimental Evidence from Firms

detail.title: Belief Updating and AI Adoption: Experimental Evidence from Firms

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Using a large German firm survey, I randomize information on documented AI productivity gains and industry adoption rates and track firms over time. Beliefs about AI’s productivity potential rise significantly after the treatments across the prior distribution without reducing uncertainty. These treatment-induced belief shifts map into behavior: in firms where the respondent has high decision authority, AI adoption is more likely one year later. Information about competitor adoption has direct effects on actions: incumbent adopters cut prices, while not-yet adopters revise business expectations upward. Together, the results highlight the role of expectations, strategic considerations, and informational frictions in shaping technology diffusion and its macroeconomic impact.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过随机化AI生产力收益和行业采用率信息，发现信念变化显著影响企业AI采用行为，并揭示了竞争信息对定价和商业预期的影响。
AI.research_question: 企业关于AI生产力的信念如何影响其AI采用决策？竞争者的采用信息如何影响企业的定价策略和商业预期？
AI.motivation: 理解AI技术扩散的微观机制，特别是信念、信息摩擦和战略考虑如何影响企业采用决策及其宏观经济影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术扩散理论、信念形成理论和战略竞争理论，探讨信息冲击如何改变企业信念并影响行为决策。
AI.method: 使用德国大型企业调查数据，随机化提供AI生产力收益和行业采用率信息，追踪企业随时间变化，采用准实验设计。
AI.findings: 1. 信息处理显著提升企业对AI生产力潜力的信念，但不减少不确定性；2. 信念变化转化为行为：决策权高的企业一年后更可能采用AI；3. 竞争者信息直接影响行动：已采用者降价，未采用者上调商业预期。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了信念在技术扩散中的核心作用；2. 阐明了信息摩擦如何通过信念渠道影响技术采用；3. 提供了战略竞争与信息传播交互作用的微观证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供促进AI扩散的信息干预策略；2. 帮助企业理解竞争信息对战略决策的影响；3. 为投资者评估企业AI转型提供决策参考。

title: Intelligent Companywide ML Optimizer for Manufactured Products: iCOMP
affiliations: University of College London and University College London

detail.title: Intelligent Companywide ML Optimizer for Manufactured Products: iCOMP

keywords: Digital Twin and Mixed-Integer Nonlinear Programming

detail.abstract: Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) companies operate in highly competitive markets characterized by rapidly changing consumer preferences, complex supply chains, and narrow profit margins. Success in this environment requires tight integration and high-performance operation between business strategies, product discovery, manufacturing operations, and consumer insights. Traditionally, these functions have operated in silos, with limited information sharing and coordination, leading to suboptimal outcomes. FMCG manufacturing is a massive real-time optimization problem that can be transformed by two technologies: a) AI machine learning analytics (ML), and b) federated computing and data infrastructures (Fenoglio and Treleaven, 2025). We envision a future where FMCG companies operate as unified, AI-driven organisms-where consumer insights flow seamlessly into product discovery, manufacturing adapts in real-time and goto-market strategies optimize continuously. This paper introduces iCOMP (Intelligent Companywide ML Optimizer for Manufactured Products) integrating a 'data-driven' companywide ML optimization approach founded upon the manufacturing domain, specifically by treating Manufacturing as the central, complex, constraint-driven optimization problem. The FMCG services are designed to support manufacturing optimization, but also include feasible inputs (Product Discovery) and maximizing the utilization and profit of its output (Go-to-Market). Five critical services constitute iCOMP: • Real-time adaptive RL action spaces: expanding or contracting based on detected consumer and competitive micro-trends. • Bi-directional feedback loop between Product Discovery and Manufacturing: via Digital Twin feasibility constraints. • Neurosymbolic Go-To-Market system: that combines symbolic reasoning for logical strategy generation with neural network pattern learning for outcome prediction, enabling adaptive market strategy optimization. • Dual-Metric Framework for Compound Optimization: Recognizing that market opportunities decay with time, iCOMP simultaneously optimizes for both speed and strategic quality by measuring Time-to-Market (TtM)-the duration to develop a feasible, highquality product using the Product Discovery and Manufacturing services-and Signal-to-Shelf (StS)-a time-normalized metric that quantifies the market impact per unit of time, driven by the Automated Trends and Go-to-Market services. This dual approach ensures rapid deployment (TtM) connected to high-quality strategic response (StS). These innovations are discussed in this paper. To illustrate iCOMP, we use development of ChillZen Coffee, a functional cold-brew beverage, which provides the framework's end-to-end operation, from consumer trend detection through product discovery, manufacturing optimization, and Go-To-Market Strategy and Actions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出iCOMP框架，通过AI和联邦计算技术整合FMCG公司的产品发现、制造和上市策略，实现实时优化和协同运作。
AI.research_question: 如何通过AI驱动的公司级ML优化框架（iCOMP）解决FMCG行业中业务功能孤岛化问题，实现产品发现、制造和上市策略的实时协同优化？
AI.motivation: FMCG行业面临快速变化的消费者偏好、复杂供应链和微薄利润的挑战，传统功能孤岛化导致信息共享有限、协调不足，造成次优结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制造领域的数据驱动公司级ML优化方法，将制造视为核心的复杂约束驱动优化问题，结合AI机器学习分析和联邦计算基础设施。
AI.method: 提出iCOMP框架，包含五个关键服务：实时自适应RL行动空间、产品发现与制造间的双向反馈循环、神经符号上市系统、双指标复合优化框架，并以ChillZen Coffee案例进行说明。
AI.findings: iCOMP框架能够整合FMCG公司的各项功能，通过实时优化和协同运作，同时优化上市速度（TtM）和战略质量（StS），实现快速部署与高质量战略响应的结合。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出将制造作为核心优化问题的公司级ML优化理论框架；2) 建立双指标复合优化理论（TtM和StS）；3) 发展神经符号系统在上市策略中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为FMCG公司提供可操作的AI驱动优化框架；2) 通过ChillZen Coffee案例展示端到端实施路径；3) 提供具体服务组件帮助企业打破功能孤岛，实现实时协同优化。

title: Resale Price Maintenance and Consumer Search
affiliations: University of Toulouse 1 - Toulouse School of Economics (TSE) and

detail.title: Resale Price Maintenance and Consumer Search
detail.abstract: We provide a novel pro-competitive rationale for resale price maintenance (RPM). We consider a model where some consumers are fully informed about downstream prices while other consumers are not. When an upstream manufacturer imposes a floor on downstream prices, this qualitatively changes downstream competition---influencing not just the level, but also the dispersion, of prices. The manufacturer optimally imposes a price floor which just eliminates all downstream price dispersion, and this leads to both higher (aggregate) consumer surplus and higher total welfare as compared to the case without RPM.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了转售价格维持（RPM）的一种新的促进竞争理由。研究发现，当上游制造商设定价格下限时，可以消除下游价格分散，从而提高消费者剩余和总福利。
AI.research_question: 转售价格维持（RPM）在存在信息不对称消费者市场中的竞争效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为RPM是反竞争的，但本文旨在探索RPM在特定市场条件下可能产生的促进竞争效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不完全信息市场理论、价格分散理论、垂直约束理论
AI.method: 理论建模分析，考虑信息不对称消费者（部分消费者完全了解下游价格，部分不了解）的市场结构
AI.findings: 制造商最优地设定一个恰好消除所有下游价格分散的价格下限，这导致比没有RPM情况下更高的消费者剩余和总福利
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了RPM的促进竞争新理论，挑战了传统反竞争观点，解释了价格分散消除如何改善市场效率
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供评估RPM的新视角，为制造商实施价格下限提供理论依据，有助于更准确地评估垂直约束的福利效应

title: Mind the Lag: Using Assessed and List Prices as Proxies for Housing Market Values
affiliations: Humboldt University Berlin, Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, School of Business and Economics and Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, School of Business and Economics

detail.title: Mind the Lag: Using Assessed and List Prices as Proxies for Housing Market Values

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Property transaction prices are widely regarded as the best measure of property value, but are sometimes unavailable. Using data from the Netherlands and New York, we analyze whether list prices and assessed values are reliable substitutes. In the cross-section, both proxies strongly predict sales prices, and estimated hedonic implicit prices resemble those based on sales prices. Over time, there is a sluggish adjustment in both proxies, but much more so in assessed values - particularly when they are based on rental incomes. While assessed values are well-suited for cross-sectional hedonic modelling or the quantification of static quantitative spatial models, list prices are better suited for the estimation of hedonic implicit prices from variation over time, although some attenuation bias should be expected.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了挂牌价格和评估价值作为房地产交易价格替代指标的可靠性。使用荷兰和纽约的数据发现，在横截面分析中，两者都能很好地预测销售价格，但随时间变化时，两者调整都较为迟缓，尤其是基于租金收入的评估价值。评估价值适合横截面分析，而挂牌价格更适合时间序列分析。
AI.research_question: 当房地产交易价格不可用时，挂牌价格和评估价值是否可以作为可靠的替代指标？
AI.motivation: 房地产交易价格虽然是最佳的价值衡量标准，但有时无法获得。需要评估其他可获得的指标（如挂牌价格和评估价值）作为替代的可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于房地产经济学中的特征价格理论（hedonic pricing theory），研究不同价值指标在横截面和时间序列分析中的表现差异。
AI.method: 使用荷兰和纽约的房地产数据，通过实证分析比较挂牌价格和评估价值与交易价格的关系，分析它们在横截面和时间维度上的预测能力。
AI.findings: 1. 横截面分析中，挂牌价格和评估价值都能强预测销售价格，隐含价格估计与基于销售价格的结果相似。2. 随时间变化时，两者调整都较迟缓，但评估价值（特别是基于租金收入的）调整更慢。3. 评估价值适合横截面特征价格模型，挂牌价格更适合时间序列分析。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对不同房地产价值指标适用性的理论理解，明确了挂牌价格和评估价值在不同分析情境下的相对优势和局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员和从业者提供了选择房地产价值指标的实用指南：横截面分析可用评估价值，时间序列分析建议用挂牌价格（但需注意衰减偏差）。

title: Magaldi: Yale's Ivory Tower —Navigating The Disconnection Between Academia And The Average Voter

detail.title: Magaldi: Yale's Ivory Tower —Navigating The Disconnection Between Academia And The Average Voter

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships with any individuals, institutions, or organizations that could inappropriately influence, or be perceived to influence, the content of this article. The reflections herein are the sole intellectual product of the author, composed in his independent capacity as a journalist and commentator.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This article constitutes an opinion piece and does not involve human participants, patient data, or experimental subjects. Accordingly, no formal ethics approval was required. The narrative is based exclusively on publicly available discourse and journalistic observation.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding, grants, or institutional sponsorship were received in the preparation of this article. The work was undertaken entirely on the author’s own initiative, without pecuniary support from Yale University, the Yale Daily News Publishing Company, or any affiliated entity.

detail.abstract:
In this trenchant meditation upon the fraught intercourse betwixt academe and the demos, Luciano Magaldi delineates with lapidary precision the perilous estrangement of Yale’s professorial caste from the quotidian voter. The essay contends that the lofty cadences of intellectual discourse—replete with polysyllabic gravitas and the invocation of “authoritarianism”—resound but faintly beyond the cloisters of Linsly-Chittenden Hall, where they risk devolving into sterile echo. Meanwhile, the populist adversary, armed with the arsenal of emotive imagery and mellifluous soundscape, marshals patriotic tableaux and sentimental resonance to devastating effect upon the public imagination.

Magaldi’s admonition is clear: unless the guardians of erudition condescend to translate their rarefied idiom into a register both accessible and affectively compelling, they shall remain ensconced in an ivory tower of irrelevance, imperilling their civic mission. The piece thus exhorts Yale, and by extension the academy writ large, to reconcile intellectual rigour with rhetorical inclusivity, lest the simmering disaffection of the electorate erupt into volcanic repudiation of scholarly authority.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了耶鲁大学学者与普通选民之间的沟通鸿沟，指出学术精英的复杂语言与公众脱节，而民粹主义者则利用情感化表达有效影响公众。文章呼吁学术界将严谨的学术转化为可理解和情感共鸣的语言，以避免学术权威被公众排斥。
AI.research_question: 学术精英如何弥合与普通选民之间的沟通鸿沟，避免学术话语在公共领域变得无关紧要？
AI.motivation: 观察到耶鲁大学教授与日常选民之间的危险疏离，学术话语（充满复杂词汇和"威权主义"等术语）在象牙塔外几乎无法引起共鸣，而民粹对手则利用情感图像和声音效果有效影响公众想象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 沟通理论、修辞学、公共领域理论、精英-大众关系理论、民粹主义传播策略
AI.method: 批判性论述分析、修辞分析、案例研究（以耶鲁大学为例）
AI.findings: 学术精英使用复杂、多音节的语言和抽象概念（如"威权主义"）在公共领域几乎无效，而民粹主义者通过情感图像、爱国场景和情感共鸣有效影响公众。学术话语在象牙塔内形成回音室效应，与普通选民脱节。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了学术-公众沟通鸿沟的理论框架，分析了学术话语在公共领域失效的机制，对比了学术精英与民粹主义者的传播策略差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁耶鲁大学及整个学术界将学术严谨性与修辞包容性相结合，建议学者将复杂思想转化为可理解和情感共鸣的语言，以避免学术权威被公众排斥，实现公民使命。

title: Criminalization of Landlord/Tenant Law: Arkansas' "Failure to Vacate" Statute
affiliations: University of Arkansas at Little Rock

detail.title: Criminalization of Landlord/Tenant Law: Arkansas' "Failure to Vacate" Statute

declarations.funderStatement: University of Arkansas at Little Rock

detail.abstract:
Arkansas is the only state in the country where a tenant can be thrown in jail for missing a rental payment. Arkansas' "Failure to Vacate" statute allows tenants to be convicted of a misdemeanor if they fall over 10 days behind on a monthly rental payment. In many ways, the "Failure to Vacate" statute is just one part of an extraordinarily unfriendly treatment of tenants ' rights under state landlord/tenant law. The legal landscape of Arkansas is unique in many ways, primarily in its old-fashioned, even archaic, view of property law.

This article examines the history behind Arkansas' Failure to Vacate statute. Next, this article reviews the past Constitutional challenges that the statute has faced, and recent litigation. Then, this article reviews the data gathered from FOIA requests regarding enforcement of Failure to Vacate across the state. Next, the article examines and analyzes these findings. Finally, the article makes final recommendations on how Arkansas' Failure to Vacate law should be changed and amended.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了阿肯色州独特的"未能搬离"法规，该法规允许房东将拖欠租金超过10天的租客定罪为轻罪，这是美国唯一一个将拖欠租金刑事化的州。文章探讨了该法规的历史、宪法挑战、执行数据，并提出了改革建议。
AI.research_question: 阿肯色州"未能搬离"法规的历史背景、宪法挑战、执行情况以及如何改革这一独特的租客刑事化法律？
AI.motivation: 阿肯色州是美国唯一一个将拖欠租金刑事化的州，其"未能搬离"法规允许将拖欠租金超过10天的租客定罪为轻罪，这反映了该州对租客权利极不友好的法律环境，需要深入分析和改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财产法理论、宪法权利理论（正当程序和平等保护）、租客权利保护理论、刑事司法与民事债务区分理论。
AI.method: 历史分析法、法律文献分析、宪法案例研究、通过信息自由法（FOIA）请求收集的执行数据统计分析。
AI.findings: 1. 阿肯色州"未能搬离"法规具有悠久的历史根源；2. 该法规面临多次宪法挑战但依然存在；3. 执行数据显示该法规在全州范围内被广泛使用；4. 该法规对低收入租客造成不成比例的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了将民事债务刑事化的法律后果；2. 分析了财产权与个人自由权之间的紧张关系；3. 探讨了州法律在租客保护方面的极端差异；4. 为理解美国联邦制下各州法律多样性提供了案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了具体的法律改革建议；2. 为政策制定者提供了数据支持；3. 为租客权利倡导者提供了法律分析工具；4. 为其他州避免类似法律提供了警示。

title: The Perception Paradox: Why Our Love Affair with Recycling is Hindering Sustainability
affiliations: Faculty of Environmental and Urban Change, York University

detail.title: The Perception Paradox: Why Our Love Affair with Recycling is Hindering Sustainability

declarations.funderStatement: No funding

detail.abstract: The waste management hierarchy provides a guiding framework for sustainable policy by prioritizing waste prevention strategies like source reduction and reuse over downstream solutions such as recycling. This study investigates whether public perceptions of waste management reflect this established prioritization and explores the psychological factors that contribute to the public's valuation of different waste initiatives. Using a cross-sectional survey design, we collected data from 482 residents in Ontario, Canada. The survey instrument was grounded in the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB), measuring the core antecedents-Attitude, Subjective Norms, and Perceived Behavioral Control (PBC)-for five key waste initiatives, alongside a ranking of their perceived environmental impact. Results reveal a significant inversion of the waste hierarchy in public perception; recycling was ranked as the most impactful initiative, significantly higher than reuse and reduction. The TPB analysis indicates that while attitudes towards waste reduction were highly positive, this behavior was associated with significantly lower PBC, a discrepancy explained by perceived barriers of cost and convenience. In contrast, recycling exhibited high and congruent scores for all TPB constructs, aligning with its perceived ease and strong institutional support. The findings suggest that the public's prioritization of recycling is primarily explained by high perceived behavioral control, rather than a superior environmental attitude. Policy interventions must therefore address the structural and perceived barriers hindering waste reduction and reuse to align public behavior with established sustainability goals.

AI.tldr: 研究发现公众对废物管理的认知与废物管理层次结构存在显著倒置：公众认为回收比减量和再利用更具环境影响力，这种认知偏差主要源于对回收行为的高感知行为控制，而非更强的环保态度。
AI.research_question: 公众对废物管理的认知是否反映废物管理层次结构的优先顺序？哪些心理因素影响公众对不同废物管理措施的评估？
AI.motivation: 废物管理层次结构为可持续政策提供了指导框架，但公众认知是否遵循这一优先顺序尚不清楚。了解公众心理因素对于制定有效的废物管理政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计划行为理论（TPB）：态度、主观规范和感知行为控制三个核心前因变量。
AI.method: 横断面调查设计，对加拿大安大略省482名居民进行调查，测量对五种关键废物管理措施的TPB前因变量及其感知环境影响排名。
AI.findings:
1. 公众认知中存在显著的废物管理层次结构倒置：回收被认为最具环境影响力，显著高于再利用和减量。
2. 废物减量态度积极但感知行为控制较低，主要受成本和便利性障碍影响。
3. 回收在所有TPB构念上得分高且一致，与其感知易用性和制度支持相符。
4. 公众优先考虑回收主要源于高感知行为控制，而非更强的环保态度。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次将计划行为理论应用于比较不同废物管理措施。
2. 揭示了态度-行为控制不一致现象：积极态度不一定转化为高感知行为控制。
3. 为理解公众废物管理行为提供了心理机制解释。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 政策干预需解决阻碍废物减量和再利用的结构性和感知障碍。
2. 应增强废物减量和再利用的便利性和可负担性。
3. 需要调整公众教育策略，强调废物管理层次结构的正确优先顺序。
4. 为制定更有效的可持续废物管理政策提供了实证依据。

title: Equitable Longevity Risk Sharing or, The Raison D’etre for a First Nations Pension Plan
affiliations: York University - Schulich School of Business, York University and York University

detail.title: Equitable Longevity Risk Sharing or, The Raison D’etre for a First Nations Pension Plan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N.A.
declarations.funderStatement: Funding by SSHRC/NSERC

detail.abstract: We investigate the extent to which groups with elevated mortality rates ex ante might opt out of guaranteed national pensions in favour of demographically aligned plans, which we label equitable longevity risk sharing (ELRiS) pools, even if this involves accepting some idiosyncratic risk. Technically, this paper develops a stochastic model of retirement income within an ELRiS structure that is calibrated to equate the discounted expected utility of a guaranteed national pension. The practical motivation for developing this alternative is that working members of First Nations peoples of Canada: (1) experience much higher mortality rates than average over their entire life cycle, and (2) some are actually allowed by current legislation to opt out of the Canada Pension Plan (CPP). We then demonstrate that under reasonable economic preferences and parameters, a subgroup with a 10-year life expectancy gap relative to the population could attain equivalent lifetime utility by contributing a mere two-thirds to the plan, even if they were pooled with only 30 members. For a longevity gap of 20 years, such as between an Indigenous male versus a non-Indigenous female, the contribution rate falls to less than a third. The difference between the statutory and mandatory contribution rates to a guaranteed national pension and those needed within these self-sustaining pools is an implicit subsidy from Indigenous to non-Indigenous. From a policy perspective, this paper aspires to jump-start a conversation that sparks a change in a status quo, which is obviously unfair and inequitable.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了高死亡率群体（如加拿大原住民）是否应被允许退出国家养老金计划，转而加入基于人口统计特征的风险分担池（ELRiS）。研究发现，对于预期寿命比平均水平短10年的群体，只需缴纳三分之二的保费即可获得同等效用；对于预期寿命短20年的群体，保费可降至不到三分之一。这揭示了当前养老金制度对原住民的不公平隐性补贴。
AI.research_question: 高死亡率群体（如加拿大原住民）是否应该被允许退出国家养老金计划，转而加入基于人口统计特征的风险分担池（ELRiS），即使这意味着接受一定的个体风险？
AI.motivation: 加拿大原住民等群体在整个生命周期中死亡率远高于平均水平，且当前法律允许部分原住民退出加拿大养老金计划（CPP）。现有国家养老金制度对高死亡率群体不公平，因为他们支付相同保费但预期领取时间更短，形成从原住民到非原住民的隐性补贴。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公平长寿风险分担（ELRiS）理论框架，基于人口统计特征的风险分担池设计，预期效用理论，养老金精算模型，风险偏好与保险决策理论。
AI.method: 开发了一个ELRiS结构下的退休收入随机模型，校准到与国家养老金计划的贴现预期效用相等。使用合理的经济偏好和参数进行模拟分析，考虑了不同预期寿命差距（10年和20年）和风险池规模（30名成员）。
AI.findings: 1. 预期寿命比平均水平短10年的群体只需缴纳国家养老金计划三分之二的保费即可获得同等终身效用；2. 预期寿命短20年的群体（如原住民男性vs非原住民女性）保费可降至不到三分之一；3. 即使风险池规模小至30名成员，这种安排仍然可行；4. 当前国家养老金制度存在从原住民到非原住民的隐性补贴。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了公平长寿风险分担（ELRiS）的理论框架；2. 发展了基于人口统计特征的风险分担池的精算模型；3. 为高死亡率群体的养老金选择提供了理论分析工具；4. 揭示了跨群体养老金转移的隐性补贴机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了改革不公平养老金制度的实证依据；2. 展示了ELRiS池在实际操作中的可行性；3. 为加拿大原住民等群体争取更公平的养老金安排提供了支持；4. 启发了基于人口统计特征的养老金改革讨论。

title: Beyond Education and Physical Health: The Role of Mental Health in Economic Growth
affiliations: National Polytechnic School (EPN) and Escuela Politécnica Nacional

detail.title: Beyond Education and Physical Health: The Role of Mental Health in Economic Growth
detail.abstract: This study examines the impact of dysthymia on economic growth in 66 countries (2011–2019) using panel threshold regression models. It considers different levels of human capital, measured by years of schooling and life expectancy at birth. Dysthymia exerts a stronger effect in countries with educational human capital below 2.599 points or life expectancy under 76 years. A one-percentage-point increase in its prevalence significantly reduces real GDP, highlighting the importance of incorporating mental health—alongside education and physical health—into human capital indicators.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用面板门槛回归模型分析66个国家（2011-2019年）心境恶劣障碍对经济增长的影响，发现教育人力资本低于2.599分或预期寿命低于76岁的国家中，心境恶劣障碍对经济增长的负面影响更为显著。
AI.research_question: 心境恶劣障碍（dysthymia）如何影响不同人力资本水平国家的经济增长？
AI.motivation: 传统人力资本指标主要关注教育和健康，但忽略了心理健康因素。该研究旨在探讨心理健康（特别是心境恶劣障碍）对经济增长的影响，并分析这种影响如何随人力资本水平变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人力资本理论，但扩展了传统框架，将心理健康作为人力资本的重要组成部分。采用门槛回归模型来捕捉不同人力资本水平下的非线性关系。
AI.method: 使用66个国家2011-2019年的面板数据，采用面板门槛回归模型。人力资本通过教育年限和出生时预期寿命两个指标衡量，心境恶劣障碍患病率作为主要解释变量，实际GDP作为因变量。
AI.findings: 1. 心境恶劣障碍对经济增长有显著负面影响；2. 这种影响在人力资本较低的国家更强（教育人力资本<2.599分或预期寿命<76岁）；3. 心境恶劣障碍患病率每增加1个百分点，会显著降低实际GDP。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将心理健康纳入人力资本理论框架；2. 揭示了心理健康对经济增长影响的非线性特征；3. 提供了人力资本门槛效应的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 政策制定者应将心理健康纳入人力资本发展策略；2. 对人力资本较低的国家，心理健康干预可能带来更大的经济增长回报；3. 建议完善人力资本指标体系，包含心理健康维度。

title: Mean-Reversions in the Debt-to-GDP Ratio and Predictability of Treasury Debt Returns and Surpluses
affiliations: College of Finance and Statistics, Hunan University, WISE and School of Economics, Xiamen University and Changsha University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Mean-Reversions in the Debt-to-GDP Ratio and Predictability of Treasury Debt Returns and Surpluses
detail.abstract: The debt-to-GDP (DG) ratio should predict Treasury returns and primary surpluses according to the present-value identity, yet empirical support remains elusive. This paper resolves this puzzle by decomposing the DG ratio into a slow mean-reversion component and a local mean-reversion component. We show that the local mean-reversion of the DG ratio delivers substantially improved out-of-sample forecast gains of Treasury debt returns and surpluses, outperforming the original DG ratio, the historical average benchmark, and the adjusted ratios subject to structural breaks. In contrast, the slow mean-reversion component obscures predictive information by incorporating persistent, non-fundamental variation. Our findings are robust to alternative decomposition methods and DG ratio definitions (including nonmarketable debt). We develop a revised fiscal present-value model to rationalize the findings.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将债务-GDP比率分解为缓慢均值回归和局部均值回归两个成分，解决了该比率预测国债回报和财政盈余能力不足的难题。研究发现局部均值回归成分能显著提高预测精度，而缓慢均值回归成分则因包含持久性非基本面波动而模糊预测信息。
AI.research_question: 如何解释债务-GDP比率预测国债回报和财政盈余能力不足的实证难题？通过分解该比率为不同均值回归成分是否能改善预测性能？
AI.motivation: 根据现值恒等式，债务-GDP比率应能预测国债回报和财政盈余，但实证证据一直不足。这一理论与实证的脱节构成了研究动机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政现值模型（fiscal present-value model）是核心理论框架。作者在此基础上开发了修订版的财政现值模型来解释研究发现。
AI.method: 将债务-GDP比率分解为缓慢均值回归和局部均值回归两个成分，进行样本外预测比较，包括与原始比率、历史平均基准和考虑结构断点的调整比率对比。
AI.findings: 局部均值回归成分能显著提高国债债务回报和财政盈余的样本外预测精度，优于所有对比基准。缓慢均值回归成分因包含持久性非基本面波动而模糊预测信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 解释了债务-GDP比率预测能力不足的实证难题；2) 开发了修订版财政现值模型来合理化发现；3) 提供了债务动态分解的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了更准确的国债回报和财政盈余预测工具；2) 改进了债务可持续性评估方法；3) 对投资者和市场参与者具有实际预测价值。

title: Diffuse Agricultural Pollution, Human Health, and Food Security in the Face of Climate Change in the C4 Countries: Benin, Burkina Faso, Mali, and Tchad
affiliations: Université de Parakou

detail.title: Diffuse Agricultural Pollution, Human Health, and Food Security in the Face of Climate Change in the C4 Countries: Benin, Burkina Faso, Mali, and Tchad
detail.abstract:
English Abstract:
This article, based on the Arellano-Bover/Blundell-Bond system GMM method, shows that agricultural productivity is positively influenced by the use of agricultural inputs (fertilizers: β₂=0.213, p<0.01), although excessive pesticide use (β₁ = –0.128, p<0.05) reduces environmental sustainability. Water and soil pollution (β₃ = –0.176, p<0.01) has a significantly negative effect on yields. Rainfall has a positive effect (β₅ = 0.091, p<0.10), while rising temperatures (β₄ = –0.102, p<0.05) deteriorate production. Access to drinking water (β₈ = 0.188, p<0.01), health expenditure (β₆ = 0.127, p<0.05), and education (β₉ = 0.201, p<0.01) improve food security. Finally, the ND-GAIN climate resilience index (β₁₀ = 0.144, p<0.05) supports the adaptation of agricultural systems to environmental hazards. These results suggest the importance of multisectoral policies integrating agriculture, health, education, and the environment.

French Abstract:
Cet article, basé sur la méthode GMM du système Arellano-Bover/Blundell-Bond, montre que la productivité agricole est positivement influencée par l'utilisation d'intrants agricoles (engrais : β₂ = 0,213, p < 0,01), tandis qu'un usage excessif de pesticides (β₁ = –0,128, p < 0,05) nuit à la durabilité environnementale. La pollution de l'eau et des sols (β₃ = –0,176, p < 0,01) a un effet négatif significatif sur les rendements. Les prélèvements ont un effet positif (β₅ = 0,091, p < 0,10), tandis que l'augmentation des températures (β₄ = –0,102, p < 0,05) détériore la production. L'accès à l'eau potable (β 8 = 0,188, p < 0,01), aux dépenses de santé (β 6 = 0,127, p < 0,05) et à l'éducation (β 9 = 0,201, p < 0,01) améliorent la sécurité alimentaire. Enfin, l'indice de résilience climatique ND-GAIN (β 10 = 0,144, p < 0,05) favorise l'adaptation des systèmes agricoles aux aléas environnementales. Ces résultats soulignent l'importance des politiques multisectorielles intégrant l'agriculture, la santé, l'éducation et l'environnement.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用Arellano-Bover/Blundell-Bond系统GMM方法分析农业生产力影响因素，发现化肥使用、降雨量、饮用水获取、医疗支出、教育和气候韧性对农业生产力有正面影响，而过度使用农药、水土污染和温度上升则有负面影响，强调需要整合农业、健康、教育和环境的多部门政策。
AI.research_question: 农业生产力受哪些因素影响？如何通过多部门政策整合来提升农业生产力、环境可持续性和粮食安全？
AI.motivation: 理解农业生产力与环境、社会和经济因素之间的复杂关系，为制定促进可持续农业发展和粮食安全的综合政策提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于农业经济学、环境经济学和发展经济学的理论框架，探讨农业生产函数、环境外部性、人力资本投资和气候适应能力对农业系统的影响。
AI.method: 采用Arellano-Bover/Blundell-Bond系统GMM方法进行动态面板数据分析，控制内生性问题，估计各因素对农业生产力的影响系数和显著性。
AI.findings:
1. 化肥使用显著提升农业生产力(β₂=0.213, p<0.01)
2. 过度使用农药降低环境可持续性(β₁=-0.128, p<0.05)
3. 水土污染显著降低产量(β₃=-0.176, p<0.01)
4. 降雨量有正面影响(β₅=0.091, p<0.10)，温度上升有负面影响(β₄=-0.102, p<0.05)
5. 饮用水获取(β₈=0.188)、医疗支出(β₆=0.127)和教育(β₉=0.201)显著改善粮食安全
6. ND-GAIN气候韧性指数支持农业系统适应环境风险(β₁₀=0.144, p<0.05)
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 扩展了农业生产函数理论，纳入环境可持续性和气候适应维度
2. 验证了人力资本投资（教育、健康）对农业发展的间接作用机制
3. 提供了多部门协同发展理论在农业领域的实证支持
4. 深化了环境经济学中外部性理论在农业污染方面的应用
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供具体可操作的政策建议：平衡化肥使用与环境保护
2. 强调需要整合农业、健康、教育和环境部门的协同政策
3. 提出加强气候韧性建设的具体方向
4. 为可持续发展目标（SDGs）的实现提供实证依据和路径参考

title: Brief of Amici Curiae, Antitrust, Business, and Sports Law Professors in Support for the Petition of Certiorari in Cangerjeros de Santurce Baseball Club, LLC v. Liga de Beisbol Professional De Puerto Rico, Inc. (Sup. Ct. 2025)
affiliations: City University of New York - Baruch College, Zicklin School of Business and Indiana University - Kelley School of Business - Department of Business Law

detail.title: Brief of Amici Curiae, Antitrust, Business, and Sports Law Professors in Support for the Petition of Certiorari in Cangerjeros de Santurce Baseball Club, LLC v. Liga de Beisbol Professional De Puerto Rico, Inc. (Sup. Ct. 2025)
detail.abstract: Amici are professors and whidely published experts in the fields of antitrust, business and sports law. They share a common interest in effective competition policy in sports business and labor markets. Their interest in this case is to ensure that the law develops in a way that serves the public interest by promoting competition, eliminating confusion surrounding the application of antitrust law to various aspects of baseball’s business, and providing clarity to stakeholders—including teams, owners, players, and fans. Amici respectfully request that this Court grant a writ of certiorari to revisit and clarify the scope of baseball’s historic antitrust exemption.

AI.findings: 当前棒球反垄断豁免存在混淆和不确定性，需要最高法院重新审查和澄清其适用范围，以促进有效竞争。

keywords: is the True Currency of Global Diplomacy. How Listening
and Continuity Shape Public Diplomacy that Lasts

detail.abstract:
Public diplomacy is the long work of building trust with people across borders. It fails when it confuses attention with trust, or when it treats people as targets instead of partners.

This article was originally published by the rEUconnecting Digital Magazine - (REUC). Read the original version here: https://reuc.snm.rs/guest-journalists/articles-and-columns/the-architecture-of-trust-reimagining-public-diplomacy/

Later republished by the USC Center on Public Diplomacy (USC CPD). Read it here: https://uscpublicdiplomacy.org/blog/architecture-trust-reimagining-public-diplomacy

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了公共外交的核心是建立跨国信任，而非仅仅获取关注，强调应将民众视为合作伙伴而非目标对象。
AI.research_question: 如何重新构想公共外交，使其从关注度导向转变为信任构建导向？
AI.motivation: 当前公共外交实践常混淆关注度与信任，将民众视为目标而非合作伙伴，导致外交效果有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信任构建理论、关系型公共外交、参与式外交理论
AI.method: 概念性分析、文献综述、案例研究
AI.findings: 成功的公共外交需要长期信任构建，避免将关注度误认为信任，应将民众视为平等合作伙伴。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"信任架构"概念，区分了关注度与信任的差异，发展了关系型公共外交理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共外交实践者提供了从目标导向转向伙伴导向的具体指导，强调长期信任建设的重要性。

AI.method: 概念分析、文献综述、案例分析（基于已发表文章的分析）。

AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了贸易外交的理论框架，强调了贸易促进在建立持久国际合作中的战略作用，连接了经济政策与外交战略的理论领域。

AI.tldr: 本文探讨欧盟数字服务税对美国公司应用的困难，并主张采用增值税作为对双方都更好的选择
AI.research_question: 欧盟数字服务税对美国公司的适用性存在哪些困难？增值税是否比数字服务税更适合作为欧盟对跨国数字公司的征税方案？
AI.motivation: 随着数字经济的快速发展，欧盟试图通过数字服务税对跨国科技公司征税，但在实施过程中面临诸多挑战，特别是对美国公司的适用性问题，需要寻找更有效的税收方案

title: Recursive Contracts in Non-Convex Environments
affiliations: University of Zurich, Peking University and Westlake University

detail.title: Recursive Contracts in Non-Convex Environments
detail.abstract: In this paper we examine non-convex dynamic optimization problems with forward looking constraints. We prove that the recursive multiplier formulation in Marcet and Marimon (2019) gives the optimal value if one assumes that the planner has access to a public randomization device and forward looking constraints only have to hold in expectations. Whether one formulates the functional equation as a sup-inf problem or as an inf-sup problem is essential for the timing of the optimal lottery and for determining which constraints have to hold in expectations. We discuss for which economic problems the use of lotteries can be considered a reasonable assumption. We provide a general method to recover the optimal policy from a solution of the functional equation. As an application of our results, we consider the Ramsey problem of optimal government policy and give examples where lotteries are essential for the optimal solution.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究具有前瞻性约束的非凸动态优化问题，证明了在假设规划者可以使用公共随机化设备且前瞻性约束只需在期望意义上成立时，Marcet和Marimon(2019)的递归乘子公式能给出最优值。论文讨论了彩票使用在哪些经济问题中是合理的假设，并提供了从函数方程解中恢复最优策略的一般方法。
AI.research_question: 在非凸动态优化问题中，当规划者可以使用公共随机化设备且前瞻性约束只需在期望意义上成立时，递归乘子公式是否能给出最优值？以及彩票使用在哪些经济问题中是合理的假设？
AI.motivation: 许多经济问题涉及非凸性和前瞻性约束，传统优化方法难以处理。需要发展能够处理这类复杂动态优化问题的理论框架，特别是在允许使用随机化设备的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Marcet和Marimon(2019)的递归乘子公式，研究非凸动态优化问题的理论框架，特别关注sup-inf与inf-sup问题表述对最优彩票时机和约束期望性质的影响。
AI.method: 理论证明方法，分析递归乘子公式在公共随机化设备假设下的最优性。提供从函数方程解中恢复最优策略的一般方法，并以拉姆齐最优政府政策问题作为应用示例。
AI.findings: 证明了在假设规划者可以使用公共随机化设备且前瞻性约束只需在期望意义上成立时，递归乘子公式确实能给出最优值。函数方程表述为sup-inf问题还是inf-sup问题对最优彩票时机和哪些约束需要在期望意义上成立至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 扩展了递归乘子公式在非凸动态优化问题中的应用范围；2) 阐明了sup-inf与inf-sup问题表述的理论意义；3) 提供了从函数方程解中恢复最优策略的一般理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为处理具有前瞻性约束的非凸经济问题提供了实用工具；2) 通过拉姆齐最优政府政策问题的应用，展示了理论的实际价值；3) 明确了彩票使用在经济建模中的合理范围和应用条件。

title: Asymmetric Trading Costs And Ancient Greek Cities
affiliations: Brown University, Department of Economics, Tufts University and University of Oxford

detail.title: Asymmetric Trading Costs And Ancient Greek Cities
detail.abstract: Asymmetric transport costs arise when shipping times from point i to point j differ from shipping from point j to i. We show that such asymmetric transport costs predict distinct patterns of location in a class of models using Dixit-Stiglitz preferences, where advantage in import potential is more beneficial than that in export potential. We bring this prediction to the data, while also controlling for local micro-geographic characteristics, using data on the location and sizes of cities in Hellas, ancient Greece. Prevailing winds create an environment of asymmetric and seasonally varying trade costs in ancient Greece. We show that predictions of these models about the importance of trade are not consistent with the location of ancient cities nor their sizes. We use 2SLS methods to assess the role of market access measures in determining urban settlements and find significant differences between the coefficients for export and import market access, with the former being more important than the latter.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了古代希腊城市分布与规模是否受不对称运输成本影响，发现出口市场准入比进口市场准入更重要，这与传统贸易理论预测相反。
AI.research_question: 不对称运输成本如何影响古代希腊城市的空间分布和规模？出口市场准入和进口市场准入哪个对城市发展更重要？
AI.motivation: 传统贸易理论假设对称运输成本，但现实中运输成本往往不对称（如风向影响航运时间）。研究古代希腊的盛行风环境为检验不对称运输成本理论提供了理想案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Dixit-Stiglitz偏好的新经济地理学模型，强调进口潜力优势比出口潜力优势更有益。不对称运输成本理论预测特定区位模式。
AI.method: 使用古代希腊城市位置和规模数据，控制微观地理特征。采用2SLS（两阶段最小二乘法）评估市场准入指标对城市定居点的影响。
AI.findings: 传统贸易模型预测与古代城市实际分布和规模不一致。出口市场准入系数显著大于进口市场准入系数，表明出口潜力比进口潜力更重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统贸易理论中进口潜力优势更重要的假设，为不对称运输成本理论提供了实证检验，修正了新经济地理学模型预测。
AI.practical_contributions: 为历史经济地理研究提供新视角，帮助理解古代贸易网络形成机制，对现代区域发展和城市规划有借鉴意义。

title: Private Equity and Antitrust
affiliations: and Yale Law School

detail.title: Private Equity and Antitrust
detail.abstract: Private equity has flourished in antitrust's blind spots. While enforcers and scholars have trained their sights on Big Tech, private equity ("PE") has been building market power. Private equity-owned assets are estimated to comprise between 10 and 20 percent of the economy, yet antitrust enforcers are just beginning to address the anticompetitive harms endemic to this business model. Underenforcement in private equity is driven, in part, by a lack of visibility into privately held corporations, unburdened by the public reporting requirements of publicly traded companies. This lack of daylight enables PE groups to obscure the identities and incentives of their portfolio companies. In turn, it becomes more difficult for agencies to evaluate and police anticompetitive business strategies and practices. In an unvirtuous cycle, weaker enforcement attracts problematic business models to the private financing channel. This Article provides a critical contribution to the conversation emerging around the intersection of antitrust and private equity by offering a framework through which to understand PE transactions and business models that predictably lead to anticompetitive outcomes. We describe several paradigmatic ways in which, in the current regulatory environment, private equity is uniquely placed to execute anticompetitive mergers and acquisitions, as well as monopolistic and coordinated conduct. After describing characteristics of PE transactions that lead to anticompetitive effects, this Article examines several doctrinal and empirical frameworks for understanding the problems posed by private equity. Finally, this Article provides legal and policy solutions oriented toward closer scrutiny and more effective regulation of private equity by antitrust enforcers.

AI.tldr: 本文指出私募股权在反垄断监管盲区中蓬勃发展，通过分析私募股权交易模式如何导致反竞争结果，并提出法律和政策解决方案。
AI.research_question: 私募股权如何利用监管盲区建立市场力量，以及如何设计有效的反垄断监管框架来应对私募股权带来的反竞争问题？
AI.motivation: 虽然监管机构和学者关注科技巨头，但私募股权已悄然建立市场力量，控制着10-20%的经济体量。由于私募公司缺乏透明度，反垄断执法不足，导致反竞争行为在私募股权领域蔓延。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合反垄断理论、公司治理理论和监管理论，分析私募股权特有的交易结构和激励机制如何导致反竞争结果。
AI.method: 采用理论分析和案例研究相结合的方法，分析私募股权交易的特征、识别反竞争模式，并评估现有法律框架的适用性。
AI.findings: 私募股权通过其独特的交易结构和激励机制，在当前监管环境下特别适合执行反竞争并购以及垄断性和协调行为。缺乏透明度使得监管机构难以识别和监管这些行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了理解私募股权交易与反竞争结果之间关系的分析框架，丰富了反垄断理论与私募股权研究的交叉领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断执法机构提供了具体的法律和政策解决方案，包括加强透明度要求、改进监管框架和增强执法能力，以更有效地监管私募股权。

title: Strategic Candidacy in Stable Multi-Winner Elections
affiliations: National Institute of Statistics and Applied Economics (INSEA)

detail.title: Strategic Candidacy in Stable Multi-Winner Elections
detail.abstract: This paper examines strategic candidacy in multi-winner elections where stable rules are employed—rules that always select weak Condorcet committees when they exist. A game-theoretic framework is developed to analyze when coalitions of candidates can manipulate election outcomes through strategic entry or exit. Using this framework, I provide complete characterizations of candidate coalition strategy-proofness (CCSP) across different preference domains. In the unrestricted Arrowian domain, almost all interesting stable rules are universally vulnerable to strategic manipulation regardless of voter and committee congurations. For single-peaked preference domains, stable rules satisfy CCSP if and only if the number of voters is odd; when the number of voters is even, strategic manipulation can still occur but is constrained to small subsets of candidates. These results contribute to understanding the trade-offs between stability and strategy-proofness in multi-winner election design.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在多赢家选举中使用稳定规则时的战略候选人行为。稳定规则是指当存在弱孔多塞委员会时总是选择该委员会的规则。作者开发了一个博弈论框架来分析候选人联盟何时可以通过战略进入或退出来操纵选举结果。研究发现，在无限制偏好域中，几乎所有有趣的稳定规则都容易受到战略操纵；在单峰偏好域中，当选民数为奇数时稳定规则满足候选人联盟战略防操纵性，但选民数为偶数时仍可能发生操纵。
AI.research_question: 在多赢家选举中使用稳定规则时，候选人联盟何时可以通过战略进入或退出来操纵选举结果？
AI.motivation: 理解稳定规则与战略防操纵性之间的权衡，为多赢家选举设计提供理论指导。稳定规则虽然能保证选择弱孔多塞委员会，但可能面临候选人战略行为的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论框架分析候选人联盟的战略行为；稳定规则理论（总是选择弱孔多塞委员会）；候选人联盟战略防操纵性（CCSP）概念；偏好域理论（无限制Arrowian域和单峰偏好域）。
AI.method: 理论分析框架开发，对稳定规则在不同偏好域下的候选人联盟战略防操纵性进行完整刻画。使用形式化模型分析候选人联盟的战略进入和退出行为。
AI.findings: 1. 在无限制Arrowian偏好域中，几乎所有有趣的稳定规则都普遍容易受到战略操纵，无论选民和委员会配置如何。2. 在单峰偏好域中，稳定规则满足CCSP当且仅当选民数为奇数；当选民数为偶数时，战略操纵仍然可能发生，但仅限于候选人的小子集。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了分析候选人战略行为的博弈论框架。2. 完整刻画了稳定规则在不同偏好域下的候选人联盟战略防操纵性。3. 揭示了稳定规则与战略防操纵性之间的基本权衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 为选举设计者提供了重要启示：在选择稳定规则时需要权衡其防操纵性；在特定偏好结构（如单峰偏好）和选民数条件下，稳定规则可能具有更好的防操纵性；为实际选举制度设计提供了理论依据。

title: Bootstrap Confidence Intervals for Small Samples: A Comprehensive Monte Carlo Simulation Study
affiliations: and Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Ghana - College of Science

detail.title: Bootstrap Confidence Intervals for Small Samples: A Comprehensive Monte Carlo Simulation Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We gratefully acknowledge computational resources provided by the KNUST's Department of Statistics. We thank all colleagues and staff for helpful methodological discussions. All errors are our own.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from funding agencies

detail.abstract: While bootstrap methods offer robust alternatives to classical inference for small samples, comprehensive guidance on method selection remains limited. This Monte Carlo simulation study compares four bootstrap confidence interval methods (percentile, basic, normal approximation, and bias-corrected accelerated) across 132 scenarios with 10,000 replications each. We examined six sample sizes (20-200), six distributions (normal, chi-square, exponential, t, lognormal, contaminated normal), and four estimands (mean, median, standard deviation, coefficient of variation). For small samples (n≤50), the bias-corrected and accelerated (BCa) method achieved mean coverage of 0.9281 compared to 0.9261 for basic, 0.9274 for percentile, and 0.9296 for normal approximation. However, BCa required 76 times longer computation (median 17,052ms vs 224ms for percentile). For strongly skewed exponential distribution at n=20, basic method severely underperformed with coverage 0.8845 while BCa achieved 0.9187, a statistically significant difference. Tail coverage analysis revealed that basic and percentile methods exhibited marked asymmetry (difference > 0.06 between left and right tails) for skewed distributions at small sample sizes, while BCa maintained balanced tail probabilities near the target 0.975. The normal approximation method provided optimal balance of coverage accuracy and computational efficiency for n≥40. Standard deviation and coefficient 1 of variation estimation proved substantially more challenging than mean or median, requiring n≥40 for acceptable coverage with any method. These findings demonstrate that method choice critically affects inference validity for small samples, with BCa recommended for n < 40 despite computational cost, and normal approximation offering an efficient alternative for n ≥ 40 with approximately symmetric distributions.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过蒙特卡洛模拟比较了四种bootstrap置信区间方法在132种小样本场景下的表现，发现BCa方法在小样本（n<40）中覆盖精度最佳但计算成本高，而正态近似法在n≥40时在精度和效率间达到最佳平衡。
AI.research_question: 在小样本情况下，不同bootstrap置信区间方法（百分位法、基本法、正态近似法、偏差校正加速法）在覆盖精度、计算效率和尾部平衡性方面表现如何？
AI.motivation: 虽然bootstrap方法为小样本推断提供了稳健的替代方案，但关于方法选择的全面指导仍然有限，特别是在不同样本量、分布类型和估计目标下的性能比较不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于bootstrap重抽样理论，比较四种置信区间构建方法：百分位法、基本法、正态近似法、偏差校正加速法（BCa）。重点关注小样本推断的覆盖概率、计算效率和尾部平衡性。
AI.method: 蒙特卡洛模拟研究，设计132种场景（6种样本量×6种分布×4种估计量），每种场景进行10,000次重复。评估四种bootstrap方法的覆盖概率、计算时间和尾部平衡性。
AI.findings: 1. 小样本（n≤50）中BCa方法平均覆盖概率最高（0.9281），但计算时间是百分位法的76倍；2. 对于严重偏态分布（如指数分布），基本法表现严重不足（覆盖概率0.8845），而BCa达到0.9187；3. 尾部分析显示基本法和百分位法在偏态分布中尾部不对称性显著，而BCa保持平衡；4. 正态近似法在n≥40时在覆盖精度和计算效率间达到最佳平衡；5. 标准差和变异系数的估计比均值和中位数更具挑战性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统比较了四种bootstrap方法在小样本情况下的性能；2. 揭示了不同方法在偏态分布下的尾部平衡性差异；3. 为bootstrap方法选择提供了基于实证证据的理论指导；4. 明确了不同估计量对样本量的敏感性差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为研究者提供具体的方法选择建议：n<40时推荐BCa方法（尽管计算成本高），n≥40时正态近似法是效率与精度的良好平衡；2. 警告在偏态分布和小样本情况下避免使用基本法；3. 指出标准差和变异系数估计需要更大样本量；4. 提供了基于实际计算时间考虑的方法选择框架。

title: Linear Regressions with Combined Data
affiliations: Center for Research in Economics and Statistics (CREST), Center for Research in Economics and Statistics (CREST) and Duke University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Linear Regressions with Combined Data

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study linear regressions in a context where the outcome of interest and some of the covariates are observed in two different datasets that cannot be matched. Traditional approaches obtain point identification by relying, often implicitly, on exclusion restrictions. We show that without such restrictions, coefficients of interest can still be partially identified, with the sharp bounds taking a simple form. We obtain tighter bounds when variables observed in both datasets, but not included in the regression of interest, are available, even if these variables are not subject to specific restrictions.We develop computationally simple and asymptotically normal estimators of the bounds. Finally, we apply our methodology to estimate racial disparities in patent approval rates and to evaluate the effect of patience and risk-taking on educational performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了当因变量和部分自变量在不同数据集中观测且无法匹配时的线性回归问题。传统方法依赖排除限制来获得点识别，而本文证明即使没有这些限制，感兴趣的系数仍可部分识别，并给出了简单的边界形式。当有更多变量可用时，可以获得更紧的边界。论文还开发了计算简单且渐近正态的边界估计器，并将其应用于专利批准率的种族差异估计以及耐心和风险承担对教育表现的影响评估。
AI.research_question: 当因变量和部分自变量在不同数据集中观测且无法匹配时，如何在没有传统排除限制的情况下识别和估计线性回归系数？
AI.motivation: 在实际研究中，经常遇到因变量和某些自变量在不同数据集中观测且无法匹配的情况（如隐私限制、数据来源不同）。传统方法通常依赖排除限制来获得点识别，但这些限制往往隐含且难以验证。本文旨在开发一种不需要排除限制的识别和估计方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 部分识别理论、线性回归模型、缺失数据问题、边界分析、渐近正态估计理论
AI.method: 1. 推导线性回归系数在没有排除限制情况下的部分识别边界；2. 当有额外变量可用时，推导更紧的边界；3. 开发计算简单且渐近正态的边界估计器；4. 通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证估计器性能；5. 应用实证分析验证方法实用性。
AI.findings: 1. 即使没有排除限制，线性回归系数仍可部分识别，边界形式简单；2. 当有更多变量可用时，可以获得更紧的边界；3. 开发的估计器具有良好的统计性质；4. 实证应用显示该方法能有效估计种族差异和性格特质对教育表现的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为无法匹配数据集的线性回归问题提供了新的识别框架；2. 推导了在没有排除限制情况下的部分识别边界；3. 提出了利用额外变量获得更紧边界的方法；4. 开发了计算简单且渐近正态的边界估计器。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为实证研究者提供了处理无法匹配数据集的新工具；2. 应用方法估计了专利批准率的种族差异；3. 评估了耐心和风险承担对教育表现的影响；4. 方法计算简单，易于在实际研究中应用。

title: Note, Feeding the Beast: How Facebook’s Monopolization of the Digital Social Advertising Market Harms Consumers and Competition in the Personal Social Networking Market

detail.title: Note, Feeding the Beast: How Facebook’s Monopolization of the Digital Social Advertising Market Harms Consumers and Competition in the Personal Social Networking Market
detail.abstract: At this very moment, Facebook’s future is at a turning point—both online in the “Metaverse” and also in the courts. In December 2020, the Federal Trade Commission (“FTC”) filed a lawsuit against Facebook alleging it had violated Section 2 of the Sherman Act. After initially dismissing the case with leave to amend, on January 11, 2022, the court stated that the agency had plausibly alleged monopolization and allowed the case to proceed. In its complaint, the FTC asserts that Facebook violated U.S. antitrust laws by monopolizing the Personal Social Networking (“PSN”) market. In antitrust litigation, very often one of the first and most important steps is alleging the market in which a firm has purportedly engaged in anticompetitive conduct. Although Facebook started and continues to be thought of as a social networking website, today it is just as much an essential advertising platform for businesses who pay for display ads that appear in users’ feeds. Indeed, Facebook, which also owns Instagram and WhatsApp under its rebranded parent company Meta, derives nearly all its revenue from advertising and collects at least eighty-two percent of all digital social advertising spending by businesses, with expectations that its market share will only increase. Facebook’s Digital Social Advertising (“DSA”) services are fueled by vast amounts of social behavioral data that Facebook collects from the PSN side of its platforms—which are free to users. This Note argues that in addition to the PSN market, Facebook also monopolizes the DSA market. Although these two markets are separate, dominance of both adds value to Facebook’s PSN and DSA products and contributes to the entrenchment of the company’s continued monopoly. Thus, to fully appreciate the company’s monopolization harms, Facebook should be held accountable for its monopolization of the DSA market.

AI.tldr: 本文主张Facebook不仅垄断了个人社交网络市场，还垄断了数字社交广告市场，这两个市场相互关联，共同强化了Facebook的垄断地位，因此FTC应该追究其在数字社交广告市场的垄断行为。
AI.research_question: Facebook是否在数字社交广告市场也构成垄断，以及这种垄断如何与个人社交网络市场的垄断相互关联？
AI.motivation: FTC起诉Facebook在个人社交网络市场垄断，但Facebook的主要收入来自广告业务，其数字社交广告市场份额高达82%，且持续增长。需要全面评估Facebook的垄断危害。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反垄断法（特别是《谢尔曼法》第2条）、市场界定理论、双边市场理论、网络效应理论。
AI.method: 法律案例分析、市场结构分析、数据驱动商业模式分析、反垄断经济学原理应用。
AI.findings: 1. Facebook在数字社交广告市场占据82%份额，构成垄断；2. 个人社交网络市场和数字社交广告市场相互关联；3. Facebook通过免费社交网络服务收集用户行为数据，为其广告业务提供燃料；4. 两个市场的垄断相互强化，加深了Facebook的垄断地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了数字平台反垄断分析框架，强调需要同时考虑用户市场和广告市场；2. 提出了数据驱动的垄断强化机制理论；3. 为双边市场中的垄断认定提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为FTC诉讼提供新的法律论证依据；2. 建议监管机构应同时追究Facebook在数字社交广告市场的垄断行为；3. 为数字平台反垄断执法提供实践指导。

title: Good Data and Bad Data: The Welfare Effects of Price Discrimination
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management, Pennsylvania State University, College of the Liberal Arts - Department of Economic and Carnegie Mellon University - David A. Tepper School of Business

detail.title: Good Data and Bad Data: The Welfare Effects of Price Discrimination

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We study how a monopolist’s use of consumer data for price discrimination affects welfare. To answer this question, we develop a model of market segmentation subject to residual uncertainty. We fully characterize when data usage monotonically increases or decreases welfare or when the effect is non-monotone. The characterization reduces the problem to one with only two demand curves, and gives a condition for the two-demand-curves case that highlights that information affects welfare in three distinct ways. In the non-monotone case, we provide tight bounds on the welfare effects of information and identify the best local direction for providing additional information.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 垄断企业使用消费者数据进行价格歧视对福利的影响研究，通过市场分割模型分析信息如何通过三种不同方式影响福利，并给出福利效应的边界条件。
AI.research_question: 垄断企业使用消费者数据进行价格歧视如何影响社会福利？
AI.motivation: 随着大数据和消费者数据收集的普及，企业能够更精确地进行价格歧视，但这对社会福利的影响尚不明确，需要理论分析来理解数据使用对福利的复杂效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场分割理论、价格歧视理论、信息经济学、垄断定价理论、剩余不确定性模型
AI.method: 建立市场分割模型并考虑剩余不确定性，通过理论建模和数学分析，将问题简化为仅包含两条需求曲线的情况，分析信息对福利的三种影响方式。
AI.findings: 1. 完全刻画了数据使用单调增加或减少福利的条件；2. 识别了非单调效应的情况；3. 提供了信息对福利影响的紧致边界；4. 确定了提供额外信息的最佳局部方向；5. 揭示了信息通过三种不同方式影响福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了考虑剩余不确定性的市场分割理论框架；2. 提供了信息对福利影响的完整分类；3. 建立了从复杂模型到两条需求曲线简化的分析范式；4. 深化了对价格歧视福利效应的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供评估数据使用监管的理论依据；2. 帮助企业理解数据驱动的价格歧视策略的福利影响；3. 为反垄断机构提供分析工具；4. 指导数据隐私政策的制定。

title: Unanticipated Effects of Electronic Benefits Transfer on WIC Stores and Redemptions: Evidence from Administrative Data on Vendors
affiliations: , University of California, Davis, University of California, Davis - Departments of Economics and Agricultural Resource Economics,  and Economic Research Service, U.S. Department of Agriculture

detail.title: Unanticipated Effects of Electronic Benefits Transfer on WIC Stores and Redemptions: Evidence from Administrative Data on Vendors

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We evaluate the effects of the nationwide transition in the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) from paper vouchers to Electronic Benefit Transfer (EBT) cards on store decisions to seek authorization to accept WIC benefits. We combine novel administrative data from “The Integrity Profile” (USDA administrative data on stores participating in WIC and their WIC reimbursements) with new nationwide policy data on WIC EBT implementation. Using a staggered adoption difference-in-differences approach, we find that the transition had heterogeneous and occasionally unanticipated effects across states. The number of WIC authorized independent vendors declined 10% following WIC EBT implementation. We find no significant effect of WIC EBT implementation on WIC redemptions in a subset of ZIP Codes with sufficient vendors for data sharing. Vendors in states that were early adopters of WIC EBT have more negative effects on the probability of WIC authorization, which may be due to learning effects or improvements in technology over time. Past experience with EBT implementation by financial services providers hired by states to help them implement WIC EBT processing (processors) reduces the magnitude of these negative effects of EBT implementation on store participation in WIC.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了美国WIC营养计划从纸质代金券向电子福利卡（EBT）转型对商店参与WIC授权决策的影响。研究发现EBT实施导致独立供应商数量减少10%，但对WIC兑换额无显著影响，且早期采用州的负面影响更大，但处理商的经验能缓解负面影响。
AI.research_question: WIC营养计划从纸质代金券向电子福利卡（EBT）的全国性转型如何影响商店寻求WIC福利授权的决策？
AI.motivation: 理解政府福利项目数字化转型对供应商参与决策的影响，特别是WIC这种重要营养援助计划的电子化转型可能对商店参与意愿产生的异质性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制度变迁理论和技术采用理论，分析政策转型对市场参与者行为的影响，特别是数字支付系统引入对供应商参与决策的激励效应。
AI.method: 采用交错采用双重差分法，结合美国农业部"诚信档案"的行政数据（商店参与WIC及报销数据）和全国WIC EBT实施政策数据。
AI.findings: 1. WIC EBT实施导致WIC授权独立供应商数量减少10%；2. 在供应商充足地区，WIC兑换额无显著变化；3. 早期采用州的负面影响更大；4. 处理商的经验能减轻EBT实施对商店参与的负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为政府福利项目数字化转型理论提供实证证据，揭示了技术采用过程中的异质性效应和学习曲线效应，丰富了制度变迁对市场结构影响的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供WIC EBT实施的经验教训，建议关注供应商参与障碍，特别是小型独立商店；强调处理商经验的重要性，为未来类似数字化转型提供参考。

title: Moving to Fluidity:  Regional Growth and Labor Market Churn
affiliations: Stanford University - Department of Economics, Stanford University and Stanford University

detail.title: Moving to Fluidity:  Regional Growth and Labor Market Churn

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper studies the connection between regional growth trends and labor market dynamics. New data on manufacturing worker flows for U.S. cities 1969-1981 show more new hires and more voluntary quits in growing cities, but more forced layoffs in shrinking cities. Recessions are special in growing cities in that hires and quits drop, whereas in shrinking cities layoffs rise. A quantitative business cycle model with migration and on-the-job search accounts for a large share of variation in growth and worker flows both over time and across space. Growing cities in the South and West had low job creation costs and only gradual in-migration, so tight labor markets encouraged more on-the-job search. In those cities, aggregate job destruction shocks generated recessions with lower labor market churn. In the shrinking cities of the Rust Belt, in contrast, churn was always low and responded little in recessions.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了美国城市区域增长趋势与劳动力市场动态之间的关系。研究发现，增长型城市有更多新雇佣和自愿离职，而收缩型城市则有更多强制裁员。经济衰退在不同类型城市中表现不同：增长型城市雇佣和离职减少，收缩型城市裁员增加。模型显示南方和西部增长型城市劳动力市场紧张促进在职搜寻，而铁锈带收缩型城市劳动力市场流动始终较低。
AI.research_question: 区域增长趋势如何影响劳动力市场动态？经济衰退在不同增长类型的城市中如何影响工人流动（雇佣、自愿离职、强制裁员）？
AI.motivation: 理解区域经济增长差异如何塑造劳动力市场动态，特别是不同类型城市在经济周期中的工人流动模式差异，对于制定区域经济政策和劳动力市场政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于商业周期理论，结合迁移和在职搜寻的劳动力市场模型，分析区域增长差异对工人流动的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用1969-1981年美国城市制造业工人流动的新数据，结合定量商业周期模型进行实证分析，考察时间和空间两个维度的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 增长型城市有更多新雇佣和自愿离职，收缩型城市有更多强制裁员；2. 经济衰退时，增长型城市雇佣和离职下降，收缩型城市裁员增加；3. 南方和西部增长型城市劳动力市场紧张促进在职搜寻；4. 铁锈带收缩型城市劳动力市场流动始终较低且对衰退反应小。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了包含迁移和在职搜寻的商业周期模型，解释区域增长差异对劳动力市场动态的影响；2. 揭示了不同类型城市在经济周期中工人流动的异质性模式；3. 提供了区域劳动力市场动态的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为区域经济政策制定提供依据，特别是针对不同类型城市的劳动力市场干预；2. 帮助企业理解不同区域劳动力市场特征；3. 为劳动力流动和迁移政策提供参考；4. 有助于预测经济衰退对不同类型城市劳动力市场的影响。

affiliations: University of Aberdeen, IE Business School, IE University and Tilburg University - Department of Finance

detail.title: Network Analysis in Corporate Finance

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Corporate Governance Institute – Finance Working Paper No. 1110/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) - Finance Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Social networks are formed by relationships between social units (e.g., individuals or organizations). They affect social outcomes, which are shaped not only by the characteristics of individual social units but also by the ties that link them to other units. For example, the impact of directors on their firms may depend on their connections with directors of other firms. A social network consists of nodes or vertices (i.e., the social units) connected via ties or links based on, e.g., membership of the same organizations and a shared educational background. There might also be multiple ties between two social units, i.e., so-called multiplex relationships, which amplify the strength of the relationship. E.g., directors who not only serve on the same board, but also studied at the same university and are members of the same social club, are likely to have strong ties. Social networks can be of the one-mode or two-mode type. The former type consists of a single set of social units, such as directors with shared board membership. The latter type involves two sets of actors (e.g., directors and firms). For one-mode networks, centrality measures are used to quantify the prominence of social units. Q-analysis is used to study two-mode networks. In corporate finance, network theory has many potential applications, such as those that relate to informational diffusion across, e.g., directors and corporations; access to resources (e.g., capital); insider trading; monitoring quality; asymmetric information (e.g., bank lending relationships); financial contagion and systemic risk; and strategic alliances.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文探讨了社会网络理论在公司金融中的应用，重点分析了网络结构如何通过社会单位（如董事）之间的关系影响社会结果，包括信息扩散、资源获取、监控质量等方面。
AI.research_question: 社会网络结构如何影响公司金融中的各种现象和结果？具体来说，董事网络如何通过信息扩散、资源获取、监控质量等机制影响企业绩效和金融市场动态？
AI.motivation: 传统公司金融研究主要关注个体特征，忽视了社会单位之间的连接关系对结果的重要影响。社会网络理论提供了一个框架来理解这些连接如何塑造公司金融现象，如信息传播、资源获取和风险传染。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会网络理论，包括网络结构分析、中心性测量、Q分析、强弱关系理论、多重复关系、一模式与二模式网络等概念。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，结合社会网络分析方法，包括网络测量技术（如中心性指标）和Q分析，应用于公司金融具体情境。
AI.findings: 社会网络在公司金融中具有多方面应用：信息通过董事网络扩散；网络连接影响资源获取（如资本）；多重复关系增强连接强度；网络结构影响监控质量和公司治理；银行借贷关系中的信息不对称；金融传染和系统性风险；战略联盟形成等。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会网络理论系统引入公司金融领域，建立了连接微观个体特征与宏观金融现象的理论桥梁，提出了网络视角下的公司金融分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、监管机构和公司管理者提供了理解网络效应的重要工具，有助于识别系统性风险、优化公司治理结构、评估信息传播路径和资源获取渠道。

title: Ambiguity vs. Risk in Investment Decisions: An Illustration from Green Finance
affiliations: , , Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Finance and Ca Foscari University of Venice

detail.title: Ambiguity vs. Risk in Investment Decisions: An Illustration from Green Finance

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Does ambiguity (Knightian uncertainty) or risk provide a greater discouragement to investment? There is general agreement in the financial press that uncertainty discourages investment, with uncertainty here meaning any situation where important future policy variables (such as tariffs or tax rates) are not known. And it seems intuitively plausible that situations of ambiguity are “more uncertain” than those of risk: under risk, although the outcome is not known, its expected value is, whereas under ambiguity we have a distribution of possible expected values. In this paper we show that under quite general circumstances it is the case that ambiguity deters investment more than an equivalent risk. An equivalent risk is one characterized by a compound lottery reflecting the ambiguous situation, but without ambiguity aversion. We show that there will always be investments opportunities that are rejected when characterized by ambiguity but are accepted when characterized by risk with an equivalent compound lottery, and that the converse is not true: there are no investments that would be made under ambiguity that would not be made under equivalent risk. We develop the analysis in the context of the emerging field of green finance.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究模糊性（奈特不确定性）与风险对投资决策的影响差异，发现在绿色金融背景下，模糊性比等价风险更能抑制投资。
AI.research_question: 模糊性（奈特不确定性）与风险相比，哪个对投资的抑制作用更大？
AI.motivation: 金融界普遍认为不确定性会抑制投资，但直觉上模糊性比风险"更不确定"（风险下可知期望值，模糊性下只有可能的期望值分布）。需要理论验证这一直觉。
AI.theoretical_framework: 奈特不确定性理论、模糊性厌恶理论、投资决策理论、绿色金融理论
AI.method: 理论分析，构建等价风险（反映模糊情况的复合彩票但无模糊性厌恶）与模糊情况的比较框架
AI.findings: 在相当普遍的情况下，模糊性比等价风险更能抑制投资。存在一些投资机会在模糊性下会被拒绝，但在等价风险下会被接受；反之不成立：没有投资会在模糊性下被接受而在等价风险下被拒绝。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 理论证明了模糊性比风险对投资抑制更强；2. 建立了模糊性与等价风险的比较框架；3. 将分析应用于新兴的绿色金融领域
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者理解不确定性对投资的影响提供理论依据；2. 对绿色金融投资决策有指导意义；3. 帮助企业区分不同类型不确定性的影响

title: A Sufficient Statistics Approach to Optimal Corporate Taxes
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Department of Economics and University of Michigan at Ann Arbor

detail.title: A Sufficient Statistics Approach to Optimal Corporate Taxes

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper characterizes the equity–efficiency tradeoff of corporate taxation using a stylized model that draws on the corporate investment and tax incidence literatures. We derive optimal corporate tax formulas in terms of estimable reduced-form elasticities and welfare weights on workers and firm owners. While much empirical work emphasizes investment responses, these elasticities do not feature in optimal tax formulas. The elasticity of taxable profits is a sufficient statistic for the efficiency costs of the corporate tax. Higher corporate tax rates are desirable when firm owners have low welfare weights, and less desirable when taxing profits reduces wages. These empirical objects remain central across extensions, including heterogeneous production technologies, tax sheltering, international capital mobility, monopsony, and linear labor income taxes. We survey the empirical literature and find that existing estimates can support a wide range of optimal tax rates. An inverse-optimum analysis provides combinations of welfare weights of workers and firm owners that would rationalize the post-2017 US corporate tax cut as optimal.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文使用公司投资和税收归宿文献中的简化模型，刻画了公司税的公平-效率权衡。研究发现：应税利润弹性是衡量公司税效率成本的充分统计量；当企业主福利权重较低时，较高公司税率更可取；当利润税降低工资时，较高税率则不太可取。现有实证估计支持广泛的最优税率范围。
AI.research_question: 公司税的公平-效率权衡是什么？如何确定最优公司税率？
AI.motivation: 公司税政策需要在公平（再分配）和效率（经济增长）之间进行权衡，但现有研究对此缺乏系统分析。需要建立理论框架来指导最优公司税设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公司投资和税收归宿文献的简化模型，结合福利经济学和最优税收理论。
AI.method: 理论模型推导最优公司税公式，使用可估计的简化形式弹性和福利权重；进行实证文献综述；进行逆最优分析。
AI.findings: 1. 应税利润弹性是衡量公司税效率成本的充分统计量；2. 投资弹性不进入最优税公式；3. 当企业主福利权重低时，较高税率更可取；4. 当利润税降低工资时，较高税率不太可取；5. 现有实证估计支持广泛的最优税率范围。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了公司税公平-效率权衡的理论框架；2. 推导了基于可估计参数的最优公司税公式；3. 识别了影响最优税率的关键经验对象；4. 证明了结论在多种扩展情境下的稳健性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了确定最优公司税率的实用框架；2. 指出应税利润弹性是关键的实证参数；3. 通过逆最优分析解释了美国2017年后公司税减税政策；4. 指导未来实证研究重点。

detail.abstract:
The Indo-Pacific region is emerging as the strategic center of the 21st century, where the interests of the world's leading powers intersect. With 60 percent of the global population, more than half of the world's GDP, and the most important maritime lanes on the planet, the region plays a critical role in international security, trade, and energy stability.

The power struggle between the United States and China, along with the growing role of Japan, India, Australia, the EU and ASEAN, is reshaping the regional structure in a multipolar way. Despite its potential conflicts, security challenges and climate change, the region still offers opportunities for sustainable development and cooperation if countries maintain an international rules-based order and balanced multilateral cooperation.

detail.title: Ubuntu Pedagogy: Lessons from Paulo Freire

publicationDetails.detailsText: OIDA International Journal of Sustainable Development, 18 (12), 677-682, 2025.
publicationDetails.journalName: OIDA International Journal of Sustainable Development

detail.abstract: Education has long been regarded as a fundamental pillar of societal development and human empowerment. Recognizing this, African scholars, and Africans more broadly, have consistently questioned whether the education provided on the continent fulfills this promise. In particular, some scholars have advocated for a teaching approach rooted in the values of Ubuntu, commonly referred to as Ubuntu pedagogy. They argue that this approach can bridge the gap between education and both societal and human empowerment, a gap that must be addressed for education to hold meaningful value in Africa. Over time, the core principles of Ubuntu pedagogy have become clearer. However, one crucial aspect is often overlooked, the influence of Paulo Freire's educational philosophy in shaping Ubuntu pedagogy into not only a humanizing but also an insurgent teaching practice. This paper seeks to explore that influence, highlighting how Freire's ideas contribute to the transformative potential of Ubuntu pedagogy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了保罗·弗莱雷教育哲学对Ubuntu教学法的影响，揭示其如何将Ubuntu教学法塑造为不仅人性化而且具有反抗性的教学实践，从而增强其在非洲教育中的变革潜力。
AI.research_question: 保罗·弗莱雷的教育哲学如何影响并塑造Ubuntu教学法，使其成为不仅人性化而且具有反抗性的教学实践？
AI.motivation: 非洲学者长期以来质疑非洲大陆的教育是否真正实现了社会发展和人类赋权的承诺。Ubuntu教学法被认为能够弥合教育与社会及人类赋权之间的差距，但其核心原则中一个重要方面——弗莱雷教育哲学的影响——常被忽视。
AI.theoretical_framework: Ubuntu哲学（强调相互关联性、社区和人性尊严）与保罗·弗莱雷的批判教育学理论（特别是关于人性化教育、被压迫者教育学和社会变革的理念）。
AI.method: 基于摘要信息，推测为理论分析/哲学探究方法，通过文献分析和概念分析探讨弗莱雷思想与Ubuntu教学法的理论联系。
AI.findings: 弗莱雷的教育哲学对Ubuntu教学法有重要影响，将其从单纯的人性化教学实践提升为具有反抗性和变革潜力的教学法，增强了其在非洲教育中的社会变革能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 阐明了弗莱雷批判教育学与Ubuntu哲学的理论联系；2) 拓展了Ubuntu教学法的理论深度，强调其反抗性维度；3) 为非洲教育理论提供了跨文化哲学对话的框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为非洲教育工作者提供了更具变革性的教学实践指导；2) 增强了Ubuntu教学法在促进社会正义和人类赋权方面的实际应用价值；3) 为非洲教育改革提供了理论支持。
