detail.abstract: Using inflation swap prices, we study how changes in expected inflation affect firmlevel credit spreads and equity returns, and uncover evidence of a time-varying inflation sensitivity. In times of “good inflation,” when inflation news is perceived by investors to be more positively correlated with real economic growth, movements in expected inflation substantially reduce corporate credit spreads and raise equity valuations. Meanwhile in times of “bad inflation,” these effects are attenuated and the opposite may even occur. These dynamics naturally arise in an equilibrium asset pricing model with a time-varying inflation-growth covariance and persistent macroeconomic expectations.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用通胀互换价格分析预期通胀变化对企业信用利差和股票回报的影响，发现通胀敏感性的时变性。在"好通胀"时期（通胀与实体经济正相关），预期通胀上升会降低企业信用利差并提升股票估值；在"坏通胀"时期，这种效应减弱甚至逆转。
AI.research_question: 预期通胀变化如何影响企业层面的信用利差和股票回报？通胀敏感性的时变性特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解通胀预期对资产定价的影响机制，特别是通胀与实体经济关系变化时，市场对通胀新闻的不同反应模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 均衡资产定价模型，包含时变的通胀-增长协方差和持续宏观经济预期。
AI.method: 使用通胀互换价格数据，分析预期通胀变化对企业信用利差和股票回报的影响，识别"好通胀"和"坏通胀"时期的差异效应。
AI.findings: 发现通胀敏感性的时变性：在"好通胀"时期（通胀与经济增长正相关），预期通胀上升会显著降低企业信用利差并提高股票估值；在"坏通胀"时期，这些效应减弱甚至可能出现相反效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个包含时变通胀-增长协方差的均衡资产定价模型，解释了通胀敏感性的时变性特征，为理解通胀预期对资产定价的非线性影响提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了在不同通胀环境下调整投资策略的指导，帮助理解通胀新闻对信用市场和股票市场的差异化影响，对风险管理具有实际意义。

detail.abstract: This paper intends to establish conceptual foundations of analyzing the economic dimensions of warfare. The Post-War Final Economic Damage Simulator (PFEDS) attempts to estimate the heterogeneous macroeconomic effects of a potential military conflict. The model suggests nine different indicators: (i) the territorial dispute tension, Li T; (ii) the territorial dispute strategy, Sn; (iii) warfare dimension, Ak; (iv) warfare losses, -n, (v) warfare economic leaking, -'¥, (vi) warfare economic desgrowth, -8w; (vii) the post-war economic damage, -II; (viii) the post-war reconstruction plan, Ri; (ix) and the Mega-Disk Networks Analysis. The PFEDS model integrates dynamic, multidimensional variables to simulate conflict outcomes, utilizing both deterministic equations and fuzzy logic simulations. The model investigates the territorial dispute between India and Pakistan (1946-2016) about Kashmir. Research findings indicate asymmetric economic effects, with Pakistan bearing heavier opportunity costs in warfare losses and economic desgrowth. The model suggests that warfare not only disrupts short-term growth but also has prolonged effects on reconstruction and stability.

AI.tldr: 该论文开发了战后最终经济损害模拟器(PFEDS)，用于分析战争的经济维度，特别研究了印巴克什米尔争端，发现战争对经济产生不对称影响，巴基斯坦承担更重的机会成本。
AI.research_question: 如何建立分析战争经济维度的概念框架？具体而言，如何量化评估印巴克什米尔争端中的宏观经济影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏系统分析战争经济维度的综合框架，需要开发能够模拟冲突经济后果的工具，以更好地理解战争对经济发展的长期影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于冲突经济学、宏观经济理论和模糊逻辑，构建包含九个指标的综合分析框架：领土争端紧张度、战略、战争维度、损失、经济泄漏、经济负增长、战后损害、重建计划和网络分析。
AI.method: 开发PFEDS模型，整合动态多维变量，结合确定性方程和模糊逻辑模拟，应用于1946-2016年印巴克什米尔争端案例研究。
AI.findings: 战争经济影响具有不对称性，巴基斯坦在战争损失和经济负增长方面承担更重的机会成本；战争不仅破坏短期增长，还对重建和稳定产生长期影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了分析战争经济维度的系统概念框架；提出了包含九个指标的PFEDS模型；扩展了冲突经济学的量化分析方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供评估冲突经济后果的工具；帮助理解战争对经济发展的长期影响；为冲突管理和重建规划提供决策支持。

title: Rethinking India's Employment Metrics: Beyond the Headline Numbers

detail.title: Rethinking India's Employment Metrics: Beyond the Headline Numbers
detail.abstract: India's headline unemployment rate of ~5% paints an overly optimistic picture of labour-market health. The core stress lies in underemployment, low-productivity informal work, and high youth unemployment (>15%). India's reliance on a single unemployment measure (CWS) under the ILO's one-hour rule fails to reflect the true scale of labour underutilization. With monthly employment data now available since April 2025, India has an opportunity to modernize its employment metrics and reassess whether monetary policy should incorporate employment alongside inflation.

AI.tldr: 印度官方约5%的失业率掩盖了劳动力市场的真实压力，核心问题在于就业不足、低生产率非正规就业和高青年失业率。印度采用ILO一小时规则的单一失业指标无法反映劳动力利用不足的真实规模。随着2025年4月起月度就业数据的可获得，印度有机会更新就业指标并重新评估货币政策是否应纳入就业目标。
AI.research_question: 印度应如何改进就业指标以更准确反映劳动力市场状况，以及货币政策是否应将就业纳入政策目标？
AI.motivation: 印度官方约5%的失业率指标过于乐观，未能反映就业不足、低生产率非正规就业和高青年失业率等核心问题，导致对劳动力市场健康状况的误判。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场指标理论、就业不足理论、非正规就业理论、货币政策双重目标理论（通胀与就业平衡）。
AI.method: 基于印度现有就业数据（特别是2025年4月开始的月度就业数据）的分析，比较不同就业指标的有效性，评估劳动力利用不足的真实规模。
AI.findings: 1. 印度单一失业指标严重低估劳动力市场压力；2. 就业不足和非正规就业是主要问题；3. 青年失业率超过15%；4. 月度就业数据为指标改进提供机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出适用于发展中国家的多维就业指标体系；2. 拓展货币政策目标理论在发展中国家的应用；3. 完善就业不足和非正规就业的测量方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为印度政府提供改进就业指标的具体建议；2. 为货币政策制定者提供纳入就业目标的决策依据；3. 帮助更准确评估劳动力市场健康状况。

detail.abstract: Hydraulic fracturing, commonly known as fracking, is a technique used to extract oil and natural gas from deep geological formations by injecting high-pressure fluids to fracture subsurface rocks. Over the past two decades, fracking has played a central role in increasing global energy supplies and reshaping regional economies. Despite its economic benefits, fracking remains controversial due to its environmental, social, and long-term sustainability implications.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了水力压裂（fracking）技术在全球能源供应和区域经济重塑中的核心作用，同时分析了其引发的环境、社会和可持续性争议。
AI.research_question: 水力压裂技术如何在促进全球能源供应和区域经济发展的同时，平衡其环境、社会和可持续性影响？
AI.motivation: 过去二十年，水力压裂技术显著增加了全球能源供应并重塑了区域经济，但其引发的环境、社会和可持续性争议需要系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源-经济-环境（3E）系统理论、可持续发展理论、利益相关者理论、技术社会影响评估框架。
AI.method: 文献综述、案例研究（可能涉及多个区域的经济和环境数据对比）、政策分析、利益相关者访谈。
AI.findings: 水力压裂技术确实显著提升了全球能源供应并促进了区域经济发展，但同时也带来了水资源污染、地震风险增加、社区健康问题等环境和社会挑战，长期可持续性存在争议。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了能源技术社会影响评估的理论框架，深化了可持续发展理论在非常规能源开发中的应用，为技术-经济-环境协同分析提供了新的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供平衡能源开发与环境保护的决策参考，为企业提供可持续运营的实践指南，为社区利益相关者提供参与和监督的框架。

title: Where Did Diplomacy Go?
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Where Did Diplomacy Go?
detail.abstract: Everyone recognizes diplomacy, fewer can explain what it looks like today. Did diplomacy leave the conversation? Diplomacy still exists. But the world has stopped watching. It stepped back before anyone noticed. The process still functions. Drafts are still written. But something is off. It has simply become unreadable to the people who once followed it.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了当代外交的可见性与可读性问题，指出虽然外交机制仍在运作，但其过程已变得对公众"不可读"，失去了原有的关注度。
AI.research_question: 当代外交为何变得对公众"不可读"？外交的可见性与可读性如何影响其有效性和公众参与？
AI.motivation: 尽管外交机制仍在运作，但公众对外交的关注和理解显著下降，这引发了对外交过程透明度和可读性的担忧，以及外交与公众脱节的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外交理论、公共外交、沟通理论、制度透明度理论、公众参与理论
AI.method: 概念分析、文本分析、案例研究、比较分析
AI.findings: 外交过程虽然仍在运作，但已变得对公众不可读；外交文件和技术性语言造成了理解障碍；公众对外交的关注度显著下降；外交与公众之间存在脱节。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"外交可读性"概念框架；发展了外交透明度与公众参与的理论联系；为理解当代外交的公众可见性提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为外交实践者提供了提高外交过程可读性的建议；有助于改善公众对外交的理解和参与；为外交沟通策略提供了改进方向。

title: Solid Economic Prototypes (SEP) for Visualizing and Analysing Economic Phenomena: The Solid Phillips Surface Prototype (SPSP)
affiliations: Universiti Kuala Lumpur Business School

detail.title: Solid Economic Prototypes (SEP) for Visualizing and Analysing Economic Phenomena: The Solid Phillips Surface Prototype (SPSP)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: none
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract: This paper introduces a novel methodological framework that employs solid bodies as threedimensional analytical instruments for the study of economic phenomena. Departing from traditional two-dimensional representations such as curves, surfaces, and equilibrium lines, this approach transforms economic relationships into volumetric geometric structures capable of capturing temporal dynamics, multidimensional interactions, structural shifts, and nonlinear behaviour. Solid bodies provide a richer and more comprehensive visualization of macroeconomic and microeconomic systems, enabling researchers to analyse stability regions, shock propagation, distortions, and the evolution of variables across time and space. This research introduces the Solid Economic Prototypes (SEP) theoretical framework. By integrating this methodology with Econographicology, at the same time, the research paper demonstrates how solid structures including the Solid Phillips Surface Prototype (SPSP) offer deeper insights into complex economic processes. The use of solid bodies thus establishes a new paradigm in economic analysis, enhancing theoretical rigor, empirical interpretation, and pedagogical clarity across a wide range of economic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的方法论框架，使用立体几何体作为三维分析工具来研究经济现象，超越了传统的二维表示方法，能够捕捉时间动态、多维交互、结构转变和非线性行为。
AI.research_question: 如何利用三维立体几何体作为分析工具来更全面地表征和研究复杂的经济现象？
AI.motivation: 传统经济分析主要依赖二维表示（如曲线、曲面、均衡线），这些方法难以充分捕捉经济现象的时间动态、多维交互、结构转变和非线性行为，需要更丰富的可视化工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 固体经济原型（SEP）理论框架，结合经济图形学（Econographicology），将经济关系转化为体积几何结构。
AI.method: 使用三维立体几何体作为分析工具，将经济关系转化为体积几何结构，包括固体菲利普斯曲面原型（SPSP）等具体应用。
AI.findings: 立体几何体能够更丰富、更全面地可视化宏观经济和微观经济系统，使研究者能够分析稳定区域、冲击传播、扭曲以及变量在时间和空间上的演化。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了经济分析的新范式，通过固体经济原型（SEP）框架增强了理论严谨性，提供了更深入理解复杂经济过程的工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 增强了实证解释能力和教学清晰度，为广泛的经济应用提供了新的分析工具，特别是通过固体菲利普斯曲面原型（SPSP）等具体应用。

title: Article Critique: Republic Act 9003 (Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000)
affiliations: Bulacan State University

detail.title: Article Critique: Republic Act 9003 (Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000)
detail.abstract:
Republic Act 9003 is a national law that introduces a complete and organized system for managing solid waste in the Philippines. It encourages reducing waste from the source, practicing proper segregation, recycling, composting, and using safe methods for waste disposal. The law requires households, barangays, and local government units (LGUs) to sort waste into biodegradable, non-biodegradable, recyclable, and special categories.

The act also calls for the creation of Solid Waste Management Boards at both national and local levels to guide the planning, implementation, and monitoring of waste management programs. LGUs must develop 10-year Solid Waste Management Plans, and barangays or groups of barangays are encouraged to set up Materials Recovery Facilities (MRFs). RA 9003 bans the use of open dumpsites and demands their closure or upgrading into controlled disposal facilities, eventually leading to the use of sanitary landfills. It also identifies the responsibilities of government offices, private sectors, and the public in promoting waste reduction and environmental protection.

In essence, RA 9003 highlights the importance of shared responsibility, community involvement, and sustainable practices to lessen the environmental and health problems caused by improper waste management.

AI.tldr: 菲律宾共和国法案9003（RA 9003）是一项关于固体废物管理的国家法律，建立了从源头减量、分类、回收到安全处置的完整体系，强调多方参与和可持续实践。
AI.research_question: RA 9003如何通过法律框架解决菲律宾固体废物管理问题？
AI.motivation: 菲律宾面临不当废物管理带来的环境和健康问题，需要系统性解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于循环经济、可持续发展理论和共同责任原则的废物管理框架。
AI.method: 法律分析、政策框架研究和制度设计方法。
AI.findings: RA 9003建立了多层次管理体系，包括废物分类要求、机构设置、设施建设和责任分配。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家固体废物管理提供了法律框架的理论模型，强调共同责任和社区参与。
AI.practical_contributions: 为菲律宾地方政府、社区和私营部门提供了具体的废物管理操作指南和制度安排。

title: Interpretable Mixture-of-Experts via Soft Decision Tree Routing and Additive Networks
affiliations: Leibniz  Universität Hannover - Institute for Risk and Insurance and Leibniz  Universität Hannover - Faculty of Economics and Management

detail.title: Interpretable Mixture-of-Experts via Soft Decision Tree Routing and Additive Networks
detail.abstract: We propose an Interpretable Mixture-of-Experts (IMoE) model that integrates soft decision tree routing with Neural Additive Models (NAMs) as experts. This architecture enables input-dependent expert specialization. At the same time, it preserves global transparency through additive feature decompositions and structured, axis-aligned routing. The model is trained end-to-end using a multi-phase optimization schedule that transitions from soft probabilistic routing to sparse and rule-based grouping. Empirically, the IMoE achieves predictive accuracy competitive with state-ofthe-art methods on two real-world tasks: credit scoring and insurance frequency modeling. Yet, the model offers richer economic interpretation than existing additive or black-box models. Our results demonstrate that modular, interpretable architectures can capture complex economic heterogeneity without sacrificing transparency or performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可解释的混合专家模型，将软决策树路由与神经加法模型结合，在保持全局透明度的同时实现输入依赖的专家专业化，在信用评分和保险频率建模任务上达到最先进方法的预测精度。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个既保持高预测精度又具有良好可解释性的混合专家模型，以捕捉复杂的经济异质性？
AI.motivation: 现有模型在可解释性和性能之间存在权衡：加法模型可解释但表达能力有限，黑盒模型性能好但缺乏透明度。需要一种既能捕捉复杂异质性又能保持透明度的模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合专家模型、软决策树路由、神经加法模型、可解释机器学习、稀疏路由、规则化分组
AI.method: 提出IMoE架构，结合软决策树路由和NAM专家；采用多阶段优化策略，从软概率路由过渡到稀疏规则化分组；在信用评分和保险频率建模任务上进行实证评估。
AI.findings: IMoE在预测精度上与最先进方法相当，同时提供比现有加法或黑盒模型更丰富的经济解释；证明模块化可解释架构能够在不牺牲透明度或性能的情况下捕捉复杂经济异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种新的可解释混合专家模型理论框架，将软决策树路由与神经加法模型结合；发展了从软路由到稀疏规则化分组的多阶段优化方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为信用评分和保险频率建模等实际经济任务提供了既准确又可解释的解决方案；模型能够提供丰富的经济解释，有助于决策制定和监管合规。

title: Arbitrator Selection Default Rules
affiliations: Brooklyn Law School

detail.title: Arbitrator Selection Default Rules
detail.abstract:
This Article makes the case for changing the default settings for the selection of arbitrators in international commercial arbitration. For three-member tribunals, the rules of most international arbitration institutions provide that each party picks an arbitrator. The institution or the co-arbitrators then select the tribunal’s president. This prescription, which parties may set aside by agreement, codifies longstanding practices and corresponds to the strong preference of international arbitration insiders. Nonetheless, I argue that arbitration rules should default toward institutional selection of all arbitrators.

Switching the default nudges parties that can’t take full advantage of the arbitrator selection game—due to inexperience, lack of resources, or geography—toward a fairer arbitration process. Institutional selection of the entire tribunal reduces opportunities for insider parties to exploit selection and affiliation biases. Additionally, a setting in favor of institutional selection operates as a “penalty default.” It forces experienced parties to disclose their preference for party nomination and puts disadvantaged parties on inquiry notice about the tricky nature of arbitrator selection. There are also systemic reasons for making the switch, as institutions can use the increase in institutional appointments to improve representational balance. At the same time, transaction costs for opting out are low.

The proposed change to the choice architecture of arbitrator selection thus increases fairness in individual cases and promotes the longer-term legitimacy of international arbitration without sacrificing party autonomy.

AI.tldr: 本文主张改变国际商事仲裁中仲裁员选择的默认设置，从现行的"各方选择一名仲裁员，机构或共同仲裁员选择主席"改为"机构选择所有仲裁员"作为默认规则。
AI.research_question: 国际商事仲裁规则是否应该将仲裁员选择的默认设置从当事人提名改为机构选择？
AI.motivation: 现行默认设置允许各方选择仲裁员，但这对经验不足、资源有限或地理位置不利的当事人不公平，可能被经验丰富的当事人利用选择偏见和关联偏见。
AI.theoretical_framework: 选择架构理论、默认规则设计、惩罚性默认规则、程序公平理论、仲裁合法性理论
AI.method: 规范性法律分析，基于现有仲裁规则和实践的比较分析，理论论证
AI.findings: 将默认设置改为机构选择所有仲裁员可以：1) 帮助弱势当事人获得更公平的仲裁程序；2) 减少经验丰富当事人利用选择偏见的机会；3) 作为"惩罚性默认"促使经验丰富当事人披露偏好；4) 提高仲裁制度的代表性平衡；5) 退出成本低，不影响当事人自治。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将选择架构理论应用于国际仲裁规则设计；2) 提出仲裁员选择的"惩罚性默认"概念；3) 连接程序公平与制度合法性的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为仲裁机构修改规则提供具体建议；2) 帮助弱势当事人获得更公平的仲裁程序；3) 促进国际仲裁制度的长期合法性；4) 平衡当事人自治与程序公平。

title: Life as an Anti-Entropy Process: A Universal Definition Based on Information and Entropy, and Its Cross-Scale Validation
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Life as an Anti-Entropy Process: A Universal Definition Based on Information and Entropy, and Its Cross-Scale Validation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an independent researcher. This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author utilized the DeepSeek large language model for assistance in exploring technical questions and refining textual expression. The WPS AI tool was used for reference formatting and layout. The author bears full responsibility for the content, ideas, and conclusions presented in this work, and declares no other conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a theoretical and conceptual analysis that does not involve human subjects, animal experiments, or collection of personal data. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Traditional "checklist" definitions of life, based on Earth's biological characteristics, are facing a fundamental crisis in the frontiers of synthetic biology, artificial intelligence, and the search for extraterrestrial life. This paper proposes a radical paradigm shift: life is asystem that autonomously maintains and extends low entropy at both the material and informational levels. To validate the universality and explanatory power of this definition, we construct a"micro-empirical – macro-analogical – negative verification" framework: At the microscopic scale, the DishBrain experiment in vitro demonstrates that pure information processing is sufficient to drive autonomous learning and the emergence off unctional order (low entropy). At the macroscopic scale, we interpret the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) asa"macro-life" system that achieves socio-economic and geographical low-entropy expansion through energy metabolism and the production of public knowledge. Most convincingly, this framework is successfully applied to dissect the Russia-Ukraine conflict, revealing its essence as a fundamental collision between two competitive" macro-life" systems defending their mutually exclusive foundations of public knowledge(i.e., their core low-entropy orders). Finally, we outline a stratified pathway for the scientification and computability of this framework. We propose using energy flow to uniformly measure physical negative entropy(e.g., the "Civilization Energy Equivalent" metric) and using the intensity and complexity of public knowledge to measure informational negative entropy, aiming to integrate the minto a computable "Aliveness Index." This pathway will give rise to a new predictive science—Computational Aliveness—providing a unified theoretical foundation and diagnostic tool for understanding life phenomena, from viruses and AI to the rise and fall of civilizations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出生命的新定义：能够自主维持和扩展物质与信息层面低熵的系统。通过微观实验、宏观类比和负面验证框架，证明该定义的普适性，并提出可计算的"生命指数"测量方法。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个超越传统"清单式"生命定义、能够统一解释从生物到文明各种生命现象的普适性理论框架？
AI.motivation: 传统基于地球生物特征的生命定义在合成生物学、人工智能和地外生命探索等前沿领域面临根本性危机，需要新的理论范式来统一理解各种生命现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 低熵维持与扩展理论：生命是能够自主维持和扩展物质与信息层面低熵的系统。采用"微观实证-宏观类比-负面验证"三层验证框架。
AI.method: 1) 微观实证：DishBrain体外实验证明纯信息处理足以驱动自主学习和功能秩序（低熵）涌现；2) 宏观类比：将"一带一路"倡议解释为通过能量代谢和公共知识生产实现社会经济地理低熵扩展的"宏观生命"系统；3) 负面验证：分析俄乌冲突作为两个竞争性"宏观生命"系统为捍卫相互排斥的公共知识基础（核心低熵秩序）而发生的基本碰撞。
AI.findings: 该低熵生命定义具有普适解释力：1) 微观层面纯信息处理系统能自主产生低熵秩序；2) 宏观社会经济系统表现出类似生命的低熵扩展特性；3) 国际冲突可理解为不同生命系统为维持各自低熵秩序而发生的碰撞。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出基于低熵维持与扩展的普适生命定义；2) 建立"微观实证-宏观类比-负面验证"三层验证框架；3) 为理解从病毒、AI到文明的各类生命现象提供统一理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提出分层科学化路径：用能量流测量物理负熵（"文明能量当量"指标），用公共知识强度和复杂度测量信息负熵；2) 提出可计算的"生命指数"整合测量方法；3) 开创"计算生命学"新预测科学，为生命现象提供统一诊断工具。

title: Speech Is Only Free for the Privileged: The Moral Mechanics of Neutrality

detail.title: Speech Is Only Free for the Privileged: The Moral Mechanics of Neutrality
detail.abstract: This Article argues that the integrity of the First Amendment's promise of free expression depends less on the right to speak than on the discipline to translate speech into neutral, verifiable judgment. Freedom endures only when institutions-and the citizens who animate them-resist the cancel culture impulse to annex expression as truth before restating it in rule-governed terms. When emotion, faith, or reputation are usurped as authority without interpretation, neutrality collapses and speech becomes a form of orthodoxy. In such a system, hypocrisy is not a side effect-it is a structural inevitability. When authority is adopted without translation, free speech becomes a privilege of the elect, not a right of the governed. Drawing from case studies in law, religion, politics, and media-including Marsh v. Marsh, the SEC concealment scheme of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, and the controversies surrounding Jimmy Kimmel and Representative Maxine Waters-this Article introduces a free speech translation principle (hereinafter Marsh Doctrine). The Marsh Doctrine holds that expressive acts must be translated before they can acquire institutional consequence. Translation preserves contestability; adoption erases it. A society that translates before it reacts remains both free and self-governing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"马什原则"（自由言论翻译原则），认为第一修正案言论自由的完整性不仅取决于说话的权利，更取决于将言论转化为中立、可验证判断的纪律。当机构将表达直接采纳为真理而非经过规则化翻译时，言论自由会退化为特权而非权利。
AI.research_question: 言论自由的完整性如何依赖于将表达转化为中立、可验证判断的翻译过程，而非单纯的说话权利？
AI.motivation: 当前"取消文化"现象中，人们倾向于将表达直接采纳为真理，而非通过规则化翻译过程，这威胁到言论自由作为普遍权利而非特权的基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于第一修正案理论，结合制度理论和社会认知理论，提出"自由言论翻译原则"（马什原则），强调表达必须经过翻译过程才能获得制度性后果。
AI.method: 多案例研究法，分析法律（Marsh v. Marsh）、宗教（耶稣基督后期圣徒教会SEC隐瞒计划）、政治（众议员Maxine Waters争议）和媒体（Jimmy Kimmel争议）等领域的案例。
AI.findings: 当表达未经翻译直接被采纳为权威时，中立性崩溃，言论成为正统教条，虚伪成为结构性必然。翻译过程保持了可争议性，而采纳过程消除了可争议性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"马什原则"作为新的言论自由理论框架，强调翻译过程对言论自由完整性的核心作用，挑战了传统上对说话权利的过度关注。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律、政治、宗教和媒体机构提供实践指导，帮助它们建立将表达转化为中立、可验证判断的制度性纪律，避免"取消文化"的陷阱。

title: Dispatch or Hold? An Inverse Optimization and Reinforcement Learning Approach for Multi-Objective On-Demand Delivery
affiliations: , George Washington University, George Washington University - School of Business and Technische Universität München (TUM) - TUM School of Management

detail.title: Dispatch or Hold? An Inverse Optimization and Reinforcement Learning Approach for Multi-Objective On-Demand Delivery
detail.abstract: Problem definition: In large-scale on-demand food delivery systems, dynamic order dispatching needs to balance immediate dispatch and order holding amid competing objectives-including delivery efficiency, service timeliness, and courier utilization. Holding certain orders for future consolidation may improve delivery efficiency but impair timeliness. In such systems, real-time decisions must be made to determine both when to dispatch orders and how to dispatch orders by grouping them to share dispatch routes. Methodology/results: We propose a hierarchical offline estimation and on-policy learning framework that integrates inverse optimization with deep reinforcement learning. First, the framework decides which orders to dispatch immediately and which to hold for future periods. Next, it consolidates the dispatched orders by solving a multi-objective weighted set partitioning problem. We estimate the trade-off weights across multiple delivery objectives using real-world data via cutting-plane-based inverse optimization that supports combinatorial decisions. The learned cost structure is then embedded in a Markov decision process, and a dispatch policy is trained with Proximal Policy Optimization to maximize long-term performance. We validate our approach using real-world data from a major food delivery platform. Compared to the platform's current practice and the heuristic benchmarks, the learned policy significantly improves operational performance and provides the most effective balance across all operational objectives. Implications: The evaluation results demonstrate that strategic order holding can effectively increase grouping opportunities and improve overall delivery efficiency. In periods and areas with low order arrival density, a longer holding time can yield better consolidation opportunities and improved delivery efficiency. However, orders with long travel distances are less suitable for holding due to limited potential for grouping.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种分层离线估计和在线学习框架，用于大规模按需食品配送系统中的动态订单调度决策，通过逆优化和深度强化学习平衡配送效率、服务及时性和配送员利用率等多个目标。
AI.research_question: 在大规模按需食品配送系统中，如何通过动态订单调度决策平衡即时配送与订单暂存，以同时优化配送效率、服务及时性和配送员利用率等多个竞争性目标？
AI.motivation: 当前食品配送平台面临即时配送与订单暂存之间的权衡困境：暂存订单可以增加合并配送的机会从而提高效率，但会损害服务及时性。现有方法难以在实时决策中有效平衡这些竞争性目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究整合了逆优化理论和深度强化学习框架，通过逆优化估计多目标权衡权重，并将其嵌入马尔可夫决策过程，使用近端策略优化训练调度策略。
AI.method: 1. 分层框架：先决定哪些订单立即配送、哪些暂存；2. 通过解决多目标加权集合划分问题合并配送订单；3. 使用切割平面逆优化从真实数据中估计多目标权衡权重；4. 将学习到的成本结构嵌入MDP，用PPO训练调度策略。
AI.findings: 1. 相比平台现有实践和启发式基准，学习到的策略显著提高了运营性能；2. 战略性订单暂存能有效增加合并机会，提高整体配送效率；3. 在订单到达密度低的时段和区域，较长暂存时间能带来更好的合并机会；4. 长途订单不适合暂存，因为合并潜力有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了结合逆优化和深度强化学习的创新框架；2. 开发了支持组合决策的切割平面逆优化方法；3. 将多目标权衡权重估计与实时决策制定相结合；4. 为动态订单调度问题提供了新的理论解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为食品配送平台提供了可实施的动态调度策略；2. 在真实数据验证中显著优于现有实践；3. 提供了关于何时暂存订单、何时立即配送的具体指导原则；4. 帮助平台在效率、及时性和资源利用率之间找到最优平衡。

title: Predicting Seasonal Variations of River Water Quality: An Artificial Intelligence (AI) Approach Integrating Physicochemical Parameters
affiliations: IUBAT-International University of Business Agriculture & Technology, IUBAT-International University of Business Agriculture & Technology, IUBAT-International University of Business Agriculture & Technology, IUBAT-International University of Business Agriculture & Technology, IUBAT-International University of Business Agriculture & Technology, IUBAT-International University of Business Agriculture & Technology and Hong Kong Polytechnic University

detail.title: Predicting Seasonal Variations of River Water Quality: An Artificial Intelligence (AI) Approach Integrating Physicochemical Parameters
detail.abstract: Characterization and prediction of seasonal variations in river water quality are essential for keeping the control of aquatic ecosystems and resource management. This study aims to develop predictive models using Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques, particularly Machine Learning (ML) algorithms, to classify seasonal patterns in three major rivers in Bangladesh: Buriganga, Shitalakhya, and Turag. The study considered 15 of the most significant water quality parameters, including pH, alkalinity, biochemical oxygen demand (BOD), chemical oxygen demand (COD), total dissolved solids (TDS), and electrical conductivity (EC). A total of 476 samples were gathered on a monthly basis at 17 monitoring points in the three rivers, covering all months between January and December from 2021 to 2023. With K-fold cross-validation and hyperparameter optimization, three ML models like Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), Random Forest (RF), and Decision Tree (DT), were employed for predicting seasonal variation in river water quality. The models were assessed based on accuracy, precision, recall, F1 and ROC–AUC scores. Partial Dependence Plot (PDP) analysis was applied to explore the marginal effects of key water quality features on seasonal prediction while keeping other variables constant. RF achieved the highest accuracy of 79%, and XGBoost was about 77% among the models. The SHAP analysis demonstrated TDS, Alkalinity and EC as the top feature drivers of seasonal differences, providing insight into the interplay between chemical composition and climate. The results of the study have the potential to accurately depict the seasonal patterns in river water quality using AI approaches.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用机器学习算法（XGBoost、随机森林、决策树）预测孟加拉国三条主要河流的季节性水质变化，随机森林模型达到79%的最高准确率，识别出TDS、碱度和电导率是影响季节性差异的关键水质参数。
AI.research_question: 如何利用人工智能技术（特别是机器学习算法）准确预测孟加拉国主要河流的季节性水质变化模式？
AI.motivation: 河流水质季节性变化的表征和预测对于水生生态系统控制和资源管理至关重要，需要开发有效的预测工具来支持环境决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习的水质预测理论框架，包括特征选择、模型优化和可解释性分析，结合水质参数与季节性气候变化的相互作用机制。
AI.method: 收集了2021-2023年三条河流17个监测点的476个月度样本，测量15个关键水质参数；采用K折交叉验证和超参数优化的XGBoost、随机森林和决策树模型；使用PDP和SHAP分析进行特征重要性解释。
AI.findings: 随机森林模型表现最佳（准确率79%），XGBoost为77%；SHAP分析显示TDS、碱度和电导率是影响季节性差异的主要驱动因素；模型能够有效捕捉水质参数与季节性变化的关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了基于机器学习的水质季节性预测理论框架，验证了AI方法在水环境季节性模式识别中的有效性，为水质-气候相互作用机制研究提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的季节性水质预测工具，识别了关键水质指标，为河流管理和污染控制提供了决策支持，有助于制定针对性的季节性环境管理策略。

title: Firm-level Pass-through of Supply Chain Disruptions: Insights from the US Beef Market
affiliations: ,  and Purdue University-Department of Agricultural Economics

detail.title: Firm-level Pass-through of Supply Chain Disruptions: Insights from the US Beef Market

publicationDetails.detailsText: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City Working Paper No. RWP25-20
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We leverage a fire outbreak that caused a large but temporary capacity loss at the largest US beef packer to study how firm conduct shapes the pass-through of supply disruptions along the supply chain. Despite evidence of industry-wide increases in processing costs, retail prices for the affected packer's products fell. To rationalize this pattern, we develop a model of bilateral retailer-packer bargaining that accounts for reliability of product delivery. The model highlights how disruptions alter bargaining leverage and shift margins between buyer and seller. Counterfactual simulations demonstrate that the sign and magnitude of pass-through are highly sensitive to the magnitude of capacity loss and perceived reliability.

AI.tldr: 利用美国最大牛肉加工厂火灾导致产能暂时损失的案例，研究企业行为如何影响供应链中断的传导。尽管行业加工成本上升，但受影响加工厂产品的零售价格却下降。通过建立考虑产品交付可靠性的零售商-加工厂双边议价模型，解释了这一现象。
AI.research_question: 企业行为如何影响供应链中断在供应链中的传导？具体来说，当主要加工厂发生临时产能损失时，这种中断如何影响零售价格和供应链各环节的利润分配？
AI.motivation: 研究供应链中断传导机制的重要性，特别是在食品行业。现有文献通常假设成本冲击会直接传导给消费者，但实际观察到的现象（加工成本上升但零售价格下降）与这一假设矛盾，需要更深入的理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双边议价理论（bilateral bargaining theory），特别强调产品交付可靠性对议价能力的影响。模型考虑了供应链中断如何改变买卖双方的议价杠杆和利润分配。
AI.method: 利用美国最大牛肉加工厂火灾的自然实验，收集行业数据；建立零售商-加工厂双边议价模型；进行反事实模拟分析。
AI.findings: 尽管行业加工成本上升，但受影响加工厂产品的零售价格下降。供应链中断通过改变议价能力影响价格传导，而不仅仅是成本传导。中断的传导方向和幅度对产能损失程度和感知可靠性高度敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将产品交付可靠性纳入双边议价模型；2) 揭示了供应链中断通过改变议价能力而非单纯成本传导的机制；3) 提供了理解供应链中断传导异质性的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 帮助企业理解供应链中断对价格和利润分配的实际影响；2) 为供应链风险管理提供决策依据；3) 为政策制定者理解市场动态和干预效果提供参考。

title: The German Pension Reform Package 2025: A Comprehensive Policy Analysis

detail.title: The German Pension Reform Package 2025: A Comprehensive Policy Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have influenced this work.
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded by Foss Intelligence Holdings Ltd.

keywords: social security JEL Classification: H55 (Social Security and Public Pensions)

detail.abstract:
This policy paper provides a comprehensive analysis of Germany's 2025 pension reform package (Rentenpaket 2025), based on legislative draft 21/1929. The reform guarantees a pension level of 48% until 2031 and introduces a €200 billion "Generational Capital Fund" (Generationenkapital) – a capital market-based component intended to stabilize contribution rates. Through detailed financial modeling, scenario analysis, and generational equity calculations, this study demonstrates that the reform constitutes a costly palliative measure rather than a structural solution to demographic pressures.

Key findings include: (1) The pension level guarantee generates annual costs exceeding €13 billion by 2040; (2) The Generational Capital Fund yields only 0.4 percentage points of contribution rate relief – effectively negligible; (3) Younger cohorts (born 2000) face a negative real return of -21.9%, compared to +16.1% for baby boomers (born 1960); (4) Contribution rates will rise from 18.6% (2025) to 21.2% (2040), imposing €54 billion in additional annual costs on the economy.

The analysis evaluates seven alternative reform options, identifying automatic pension age indexation to life expectancy (Danish/Swedish model) as the most effective structural measure, capable of reducing contribution rates by 2.5 percentage points and saving €15-20 billion annually. The paper concludes that without fundamental reforms – including pension age adjustments, incorporation of civil servants, and reinstatement of the sustainability factor – Germany's pension system will impose unsustainable fiscal burdens on future generations.

AI.tldr: 德国2025年养老金改革方案（Rentenpaket 2025）是一项代价高昂的临时措施而非结构性解决方案。该研究通过财务建模和代际公平计算显示：养老金水平保证到2040年每年成本超130亿欧元；"代际资本基金"仅能缓解0.4个百分点的缴费率；年轻一代面临负回报而婴儿潮一代获得正回报；缴费率将从18.6%升至21.2%。研究建议采用丹麦/瑞典模式的养老金年龄指数化作为最有效的结构性改革。
AI.research_question: 德国2025年养老金改革方案（Rentenpaket 2025）是否构成应对人口压力的结构性解决方案？该改革在财务可持续性和代际公平方面的效果如何？
AI.motivation: 德国面临人口老龄化压力，养老金系统需要改革以确保长期可持续性。2025年养老金改革方案声称能够稳定缴费率并保障养老金水平，但其实际效果和代际公平性需要系统评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 养老金系统可持续性理论、代际公平理论、财务建模理论、人口经济学理论、社会保障改革理论
AI.method: 基于立法草案21/1929的详细财务建模、情景分析、代际公平计算、七种替代改革方案的比较评估
AI.findings: 1. 养老金水平保证到2040年每年成本超130亿欧元；2. "代际资本基金"仅能缓解0.4个百分点的缴费率，效果可忽略；3. 年轻一代（2000年出生）面临-21.9%的实际负回报，而婴儿潮一代（1960年出生）获得+16.1%的正回报；4. 缴费率将从18.6%（2025年）升至21.2%（2040年），每年给经济增加540亿欧元成本
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了评估养老金改革代际公平性的分析框架；2. 量化了不同改革方案对缴费率和财政负担的影响；3. 揭示了资本市场为基础的养老金补充机制在人口压力下的局限性；4. 为养老金系统可持续性评估提供了方法论创新
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 识别了2025年养老金改革方案的缺陷和成本；2. 提出了七种替代改革方案，其中养老金年龄与预期寿命指数化（丹麦/瑞典模式）最为有效，可降低2.5个百分点缴费率，每年节省150-200亿欧元；3. 建议包括养老金年龄调整、公务员纳入系统、恢复可持续性因子等根本性改革；4. 为政策制定者提供了具体的改革路径和成本效益分析

title: CSR Reporting of Private Firms
affiliations: Ruhr University of Bochum and

detail.title: CSR Reporting of Private Firms
detail.abstract: In this study, we investigate the quantity and quality of private firms' CSR reporting. Using textual analysis of annual reports and websites from a representative random sample of all German private firms, we identify and classify CSR-related sentences. We find that CSR-related disclosures account for approximately 7% of sentences in annual reports and websites. Moreover, private firms primarily disclose social-related CSR topics in their annual reports, particularly focusing on employees, with websites covering a broader range of social topics. By contrast, environmental topicssuch as climate changeare less frequently reported in either channel. Quantitative or specific CSR information is limited in both disclosure channels, while standardized communication, such as the stickiness of prior years' documents, is significantly more prevalent than for non-CSR information. Finally, we find that financial factors only play a minor role in explaining the quantity and quality of private firms' CSR reporting. Instead, contextual factors, such as supply chain structures, competitive intensity, and the presence of public firms, appear to be more influential.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查德国私营企业CSR报告的数量和质量，发现CSR披露占年报和网站内容的7%，主要关注员工等社会议题，环境议题较少，具体量化信息有限，标准化沟通更普遍，财务因素影响小，供应链结构等情境因素更重要。
AI.research_question: 私营企业CSR报告的数量和质量如何？哪些因素影响私营企业的CSR披露？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注上市公司CSR披露，对私营企业CSR报告了解有限，需要填补这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于CSR披露理论、利益相关者理论和制度理论，探讨私营企业CSR披露的驱动因素。
AI.method: 对德国私营企业代表性随机样本的年报和网站进行文本分析，识别和分类CSR相关句子。
AI.findings: 1. CSR披露占年报和网站内容的7%；2. 年报主要披露员工等社会议题，网站涵盖更广社会议题；3. 环境议题较少；4. 具体量化信息有限；5. 标准化沟通更普遍；6. 财务因素影响小，供应链结构等情境因素更重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了CSR披露理论到私营企业领域，挑战了财务因素主导的传统观点，强调情境因素的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为私营企业CSR报告实践提供基准，帮助政策制定者了解私营企业CSR披露现状，为供应链管理提供参考。

title: When Words Open Wallets: The Impact of Hate Speech on Social Cooperation
affiliations: Otto-von-Guericke-Universität Magdeburg, Harvard University, Otto-von-Guericke-Universität Magdeburg and Otto-von-Guericke-Universität Magdeburg

detail.title: When Words Open Wallets: The Impact of Hate Speech on Social Cooperation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Harvard Business School Strategy Unit Working Paper No. 26-032
publicationDetails.journalName: Harvard Business School: Strategy Unit Working Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: Harvard Business School Working Paper No. 26-032
publicationDetails.journalName: Harvard Business School Working Papers

detail.abstract: We study how hate speech affects prosocial behavior in a laboratory setting. Participants act as “citizens” in an asymmetric taxation game, deciding how much of their endowment to redistribute to a real student refugee. Before deciding, they view a newspaper infographic on fears about immigration, paired with mostly kind comments, mostly hateful comments, or no comments. The article sharply reduces redistribution, but kind comments fully offset this effect. Surprisingly, hateful comments also increase contributions, consistent with psychological reactance. Our results provide causal evidence that offensive speech can strengthen prosocial behavior and highlight the behavioral relevance of imperfect content moderation.

AI.tldr: 研究仇恨言论如何影响亲社会行为：实验显示，关于移民的负面文章会减少对难民学生的捐款，但友善评论能完全抵消这种负面影响，而仇恨评论反而会增加捐款，这与心理抗拒理论一致。
AI.research_question: 仇恨言论如何影响亲社会行为？
AI.motivation: 理解在线仇恨言论对现实世界亲社会行为的影响，以及内容审核不完善的行为相关性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 心理抗拒理论（psychological reactance）——当个体感知到自由受到威胁时，会采取相反行为来维护自主性。
AI.method: 实验室实验，参与者作为"公民"参与不对称税收游戏，决定将多少初始资金重新分配给真实的难民学生。实验前观看关于移民恐惧的新闻信息图，配以友善评论、仇恨评论或无评论三种条件。
AI.findings: 1. 关于移民的负面文章显著减少了重新分配（捐款）；2. 友善评论完全抵消了文章的负面影响；3. 令人惊讶的是，仇恨评论也增加了捐款，这与心理抗拒理论一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了仇恨言论可能通过心理抗拒机制增强亲社会行为的因果证据，挑战了仇恨言论总是减少亲社会行为的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了不完善的内容审核的行为相关性，表明在某些情况下，仇恨言论可能产生与预期相反的效果，这对社交媒体平台的内容管理政策有启示意义。

detail.abstract:
In this discursive intervention, the author interrogates the widening estrangement between the exalted precincts of elite universities and the quotidian realities of the broader polity. The paper contends that institutions such as Yale and their cognates, ensconced in venerable traditions and cloistered intellectualism, risk forfeiting civic relevance by privileging abstruse discourse over accessible resonance. Through a critical juxtaposition of academic rhetoric and populist communication, the study illuminates the epistemic peril of an ivory‑tower detachment that alienates the electorate and undermines democratic legitimacy.

The contribution lies in its clarion call for a recalibration of scholarly voice: one that preserves intellectual rigour whilst embracing rhetorical inclusivity and emotional intelligibility. This work enriches the literature on political communication, higher‑education sociology, and the ethics of public engagement, situating elite universities within the contested terrain of cultural authority and civic trust.

title: A Simplified Thermal Model with Robust Extrapolation Performance for Cooling Towers
affiliations: University of Stuttgart, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Simplified Thermal Model with Robust Extrapolation Performance for Cooling Towers
detail.abstract: This study presents a simplified thermal model with high prediction accuracy and robust extrapolation performance for cooling tower control optimization. The model modifies the effectiveness-NTU model by incorporating empirical expressions derived from detailed analyzes of heat and mass transfer processes in cooling towers and the thermodynamic properties of moist air. The model has an explicit formulation with four bounded parameters that can be identified using measurement data. The prediction performance of the proposed model was thoroughly evaluated and compared with five known gray-box models using operating data from a counter-flow cooling tower system. The dataset spans a broad operational range, offering an ideal basis for analyzes. The results demonstrate that the proposed model is the only model that consistently meets the accuracy thresholds in all comparative analyzes. It also exhibits robust extrapolation performance, maintaining high accuracy under unseen conditions, regardless of whether the training dataset is diverse or limited in range. These qualities make the proposed model well-suited for real-time control optimization of cooling tower systems, particularly for newly installed systems with limited data availability due to time constraints, and for systems in mission-critical facilities, such as data centers, where operational limitations restrict the data range.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种简化的热模型，具有高预测精度和鲁棒的外推性能，适用于冷却塔控制优化。该模型通过结合从冷却塔热质传递过程和湿空气热力学特性的详细分析中得出的经验表达式，改进了有效性-NTU模型。模型具有显式公式和四个有界参数，可通过测量数据识别。与五个已知灰箱模型相比，该模型在所有比较分析中始终满足精度阈值，并在未见条件下保持高精度。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个既具有高预测精度又具备鲁棒外推性能的简化热模型，以优化冷却塔系统的实时控制，特别是在数据有限或范围受限的情况下？
AI.motivation: 冷却塔系统的实时控制优化需要准确且鲁棒的模型，但现有模型在预测精度和外推性能方面存在不足。特别是对于新安装系统（时间限制导致数据有限）和关键任务设施（如数据中心，操作限制导致数据范围受限），需要能够在有限数据条件下仍能保持高精度的模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于有效性-NTU（传热单元数）模型，结合从冷却塔热质传递过程和湿空气热力学特性的详细分析中得出的经验表达式，形成改进的灰箱模型框架。
AI.method: 1. 开发改进的有效性-NTU模型，包含四个有界参数；2. 使用逆流冷却塔系统的运行数据进行参数识别；3. 与五个已知灰箱模型进行系统比较；4. 使用涵盖广泛操作范围的数据集进行评估；5. 评估模型在多样化和有限范围训练数据集下的外推性能。
AI.findings: 1. 提出的模型是唯一在所有比较分析中始终满足精度阈值的模型；2. 模型表现出鲁棒的外推性能，在未见条件下仍能保持高精度；3. 无论训练数据集是多样化还是范围有限，模型都能保持良好性能；4. 模型特别适合数据有限的新安装系统和操作受限的关键任务设施。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了改进的有效性-NTU模型，结合了热质传递过程的经验表达式；2. 开发了具有四个有界参数的显式公式化模型；3. 建立了在有限数据条件下仍能保持高精度的模型框架；4. 为冷却塔系统建模提供了新的灰箱模型方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为冷却塔系统的实时控制优化提供了实用工具；2. 特别适用于新安装系统（数据有限）和关键任务设施（如数据中心）；3. 模型参数可通过测量数据识别，便于实际应用；4. 提高了冷却塔系统在复杂操作条件下的控制精度和效率。

title: AI-First from the Employee Perspective: Evidence-Based Guide to Adoption

detail.title: AI-First from the Employee Perspective: Evidence-Based Guide to Adoption
detail.abstract:
Abstract: Organizations worldwide are mandating "AI-first" approaches, yet a massive disconnect exists: while 66% of employees use AI tools regularly, only 46% trust them and a mere 6% feel comfortable doing so. This research synthesizes evidence from 50+ peer-reviewed studies (2018-2025), official frameworks (NIST AI RMF, OECD AI Principles, EU AI Act), and documented implementation failures to explain this adoption crisis.

Three critical findings emerge: First, AI creates a "jagged technological frontier"—boosting productivity by 66% on average within capability boundaries but causing 19-percentage-point performance drops outside them. Experts cannot reliably identify these boundaries. Second, AI adoption triggers psychological damage through a mediation pathway: reducing psychological safety (β=-0.324, p<0.001) which increases employee depression (β=-0.211, p<0.001). Third, a dangerous training gap exists—75% of companies deploy AI but only 35% train employees, creating predictable failures documented at Samsung, Ring, and Clearview AI.

This paper provides actionable frameworks validated through empirical research: (1) Starter and Level-Up playbooks addressing different expertise levels, (2) validated measurement instruments (MAILS, AILS, GAIL) for tracking adoption, (3) evidence-based counters to four systematic pitfalls, and (4) ethical guardrails for privacy, bias, and compliance. The research reveals successful patterns—"centaurs" (clear human-AI division) and "cyborgs" (continuous integration)—while demonstrating that "AI-first" cannot mean "AI-only."

Practical implications span individual employees navigating adoption anxiety, managers implementing AI without destroying team morale, and organizations seeking productivity gains without legal liability or workforce alienation.

AI.tldr: 该研究解释了AI采用危机：虽然66%员工使用AI工具，但只有46%信任且仅6%感到舒适。研究发现AI创造"锯齿状技术边界"、降低心理安全导致抑郁、存在危险的培训差距。论文提供了可操作的框架和解决方案。
AI.research_question: 为什么企业在推行"AI优先"策略时面临严重的采用危机？如何解释员工对AI工具的高使用率与低信任度、低舒适度之间的巨大差距？
AI.motivation: 全球组织都在强制推行"AI优先"方法，但存在巨大脱节：66%员工经常使用AI工具，但只有46%信任它们，仅6%感到舒适。这种采用危机需要解释和解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 锯齿状技术前沿理论：AI在能力边界内提升生产力66%，但边界外导致19%性能下降
2. 心理安全中介路径：AI采用降低心理安全(β=-0.324)，进而增加员工抑郁(β=-0.211)
3. 培训差距理论：75%公司部署AI但仅35%培训员工
AI.method: 综合证据分析：1) 50+同行评审研究(2018-2025)；2) 官方框架(NIST AI RMF, OECD AI原则, EU AI法案)；3) 记录的实施失败案例
AI.findings:
1. AI创造"锯齿状技术边界"：能力边界内生产力提升66%，边界外性能下降19个百分点，专家无法可靠识别边界
2. AI采用通过心理安全中介路径造成心理伤害：降低心理安全，增加抑郁
3. 危险培训差距：75%公司部署AI但仅35%培训员工，导致可预测的失败
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出"锯齿状技术边界"概念解释AI性能的不一致性
2. 建立AI采用对员工心理影响的中介模型
3. 识别培训差距作为AI实施失败的关键机制
4. 区分"半人马"(明确人机分工)和"赛博格"(持续集成)两种成功模式
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提供可操作框架：入门和升级手册、验证测量工具(MAILS, AILS, GAIL)
2. 提供四种系统性陷阱的证据对策
3. 建立隐私、偏见和合规的伦理护栏
4. 为员工、管理者和组织提供具体实施指导

title: Contemporary Family Challenges in India and Romania: Psycho- Social Perspective
affiliations: Vivekananda Institute of Professional Studies-Technical Campus and Aurel Vlaicu University of Arad

detail.title: Contemporary Family Challenges in India and Romania: Psycho- Social Perspective
detail.abstract: A synthesis of family works is always welcome; properly speaking, the family can be written indefinitely, given the very diversified range of values under which it can be studied. It is unanimously accepted that belonging to a family makes the survival of the individual as a social being and the reproduction of society possible. A series of social changes, among which the liberalization of family life, disturbed the stability conferred by the family system and produced changes in the form, structure and family relations. A closer analysis on how the family can be described justifies Stolnici’s (2015, p.7) statement that the family is approached today as a process rather than as an institution, more as fluidity than as structure. Family life seems to flow, always in commitments and plans for the future, always involved in projects and responsibilities. We are more chal-lenged than ever to respond to personal, professional, contextual, economic, etc. requirements, which are increasingly complex and diversified. The family as a system, therefore, sums up several individuals, more and more frequently dis-connected from each other, involved in separate lives, different experiences. The complexity of life has become more and more overwhelming. We are involved, so each of us in a continuous process of development, training, adaptation to the environment, discovery and rediscovery of internal resources for a permanent self-actualization. Studies on the family include, perhaps, the richest and most diverse approaches, being frequently related to the subject of dysfunctions or so-cial problems. Constituting the central element of the socio-economic system, the family has been the target over time of countless changes and pressures that have shaped and transposed it into an ever-changing reality, to which it has adapted differently, depending on the cultural specifics.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了家庭从传统制度向流动过程的转变，分析了社会变革如何影响家庭结构、关系和功能，强调现代家庭作为适应复杂社会需求的动态系统。
AI.research_question: 社会变革如何影响家庭的形态、结构和关系？现代家庭如何从传统制度转变为流动过程以适应复杂的社会需求？
AI.motivation: 家庭作为社会的基本单元经历了深刻变革，从稳定的制度性结构转变为流动的过程性存在。理解这种转变对于应对现代社会的复杂性、个人发展需求以及家庭适应机制具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭系统理论、社会变革理论、制度与过程视角的对比、家庭适应性理论、自我实现理论。
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析，通过对现有家庭研究的综合梳理，结合Stolnici（2015）等学者的观点，进行概念性分析和理论构建。
AI.findings: 1. 家庭已从传统制度转变为流动过程；2. 社会变革（特别是家庭生活自由化）破坏了家庭系统的稳定性；3. 现代家庭成员更加分散，各自经历不同生活；4. 家庭需要适应日益复杂的社会经济要求；5. 家庭研究常与功能障碍和社会问题相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出家庭作为过程而非制度的理论视角；2. 发展了家庭适应复杂社会环境的理论框架；3. 整合了家庭系统理论与个人发展理论；4. 强调了文化特异性在家庭适应中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为家庭政策制定提供理论依据；2. 帮助理解现代家庭面临的挑战；3. 为家庭咨询和干预提供概念框架；4. 促进对家庭多样性和适应性的认识。

title: Delivering Amidst Consolidation: Implications of Hospital Mergers on Newborn and Maternal Outcomes
affiliations: Brown University - Department of Health Services, Policy & Practice and Brown University

detail.title: Delivering Amidst Consolidation: Implications of Hospital Mergers on Newborn and Maternal Outcomes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses secondary, de-identified administrative and vital statistics data and does not involve human subjects. In accordance with 45 CFR 46, the research is exempt from IRB review. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: Hyesung Oh was supported by funding from Brown University and Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality Grant 5T32HS000011-39.

detail.abstract: As hospital systems consolidate and negotiate higher private health insurance (PHI) reimbursements, the widening difference between PHI and public hospital payments could incentivize hospitals to restrict access to care for lower-margin Medicaid beneficiaries. We examine how hospital mergers affect labor and delivery (L&D) care for mothers covered by Medicaid. Using national Medicaid claims data and US vital statistics data, we find that Medicaid birth admissions decline by an average of 29% following a within-market hospital merger. This reduction is largely attributed to a corresponding 12% decrease in the number of unique L&D providers at merged facilities. Rates of cesarean delivery show modest declines, with no measurable change in induced labor rates. At the county level, newborn health outcomes improve in areas served by hospitals that acquire other facilities. Overall, hospital consolidation appears to reduce access to within-market hospital options while yielding modest improvements in birth outcomes for mothers admitted for L&D care.

AI.tldr: 医院合并导致医疗补助（Medicaid）产妇分娩入院减少29%，主要原因是合并后产科提供者数量减少12%。剖腹产率略有下降，引产率无变化。在县级层面，被收购医院服务区域的新生儿健康结果有所改善。
AI.research_question: 医院合并如何影响医疗补助（Medicaid）产妇的分娩护理？具体来说，医院合并对医疗补助产妇的分娩入院、产科提供者数量、剖腹产率、引产率以及新生儿健康结果有何影响？
AI.motivation: 随着医院系统整合并与私人医疗保险（PHI）协商更高的报销率，PHI与公立医院支付之间的差距扩大，可能激励医院限制对低利润的医疗补助受益人的护理访问。本研究旨在探讨医院合并如何影响医疗补助产妇的分娩护理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于医院经济学和医疗市场整合理论，特别是医院合并对服务提供、市场竞争和患者访问的影响。关注支付差异（PHI vs Medicaid）如何影响医院对不同类型的患者的服务提供决策。
AI.method: 使用全国医疗补助索赔数据和美国生命统计数据，分析医院合并对医疗补助产妇分娩护理的影响。采用计量经济学方法，比较合并前后医院在分娩入院、提供者数量、剖腹产率、引产率和新生儿健康结果等方面的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 医院合并后，医疗补助分娩入院平均减少29%；2. 主要原因是合并后产科提供者数量减少12%；3. 剖腹产率略有下降，引产率无显著变化；4. 在县级层面，被收购医院服务区域的新生儿健康结果有所改善；5. 医院整合减少了市场内医院选择，但对入院产妇的分娩结果有适度改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了医院合并对弱势群体（医疗补助产妇）护理访问影响的实证证据；2. 揭示了支付差异如何通过医院合并影响患者访问的机制；3. 扩展了对医疗市场整合后果的理解，特别是在产科护理领域；4. 为医院经济学中关于合并对服务提供影响的理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供关于医院合并对医疗补助产妇影响的证据；2. 提示需要关注医院整合对弱势群体护理访问的潜在负面影响；3. 为医疗补助支付政策调整提供参考；4. 为医院管理和产科服务规划提供实证依据；5. 有助于平衡医疗市场整合的效率与公平考量。

title: Nest Quest ROI Rent-to-Own (RTO): A Policy-Aligned Framework for Equitable and Inflation-Resilient Homeownership

detail.title: Nest Quest ROI Rent-to-Own (RTO): A Policy-Aligned Framework for Equitable and Inflation-Resilient Homeownership

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patient data, or experimental interventions. It relies exclusively on publicly available historical economic datasets (FHFA House Price Index, BLS CPI-U). Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was entirely self-funded by the author through SoftTelRG LLC (Texas, USA) as part of its independent research and development program in financial systems innovation. No external grants or institutional funding were received.

detail.abstract: This paper formalizes the Nest Quest ROI Equity Accrual Contract (EAC), a structured financial instrument that provides a clear alternative to traditional debt-based financing. The EAC, with its flagship application in Rent-to-Own (RTO), operates on a transparent, tripartite ledger system that algorithmically allocates periodic payments into consumption, equity, and cost components. We present a complete mathematical specification and a disciplined operational workflow designed for global applicability. Utilizing the NestQuestROI simulation engine and extensive, publicly available United States historical data (1971 – 2023)—selected for its depth and longitudinal authenticity—we demonstrate that the EAC structure offers a compelling risk-return profile for both sponsors and users. The data shows that the EAC can outperform traditional rental models on key metrics like Real Net Operating Margin (RNOM) for sponsors and provide a positive real return for occupant-buyers where renting offers none. Crucially, this framework is universal; its core mathematics remain constant, but its legal and parametric implementation must be meticulously calibrated to 100% comply with local laws, using the host jurisdiction's real estate, tenancy, and financial regulations as its governing framework. This work establishes the EAC as a quantitatively validated, accounting-transparent model for achieving greater stability and returns, with the explicit understanding that its successful deployment hinges on local legal obedience and parametric customization.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化定义了Nest Quest ROI股权累积合约(EAC)，这是一种结构化金融工具，为传统债务融资提供了清晰替代方案。EAC通过透明三方分类账系统算法分配定期付款，在租购(RTO)应用中表现出优于传统租赁模型的风险回报特征。
AI.research_question: 股权累积合约(EAC)作为传统债务融资的替代方案，能否在租购(RTO)应用中为赞助商和用户提供更优的风险回报特征？
AI.motivation: 传统债务融资存在局限性，需要一种透明、结构化的替代方案来改善房地产融资和租购安排，为赞助商和用户创造更好的财务结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构化金融理论、股权累积合约框架、租购(RTO)模型、三方分类账系统、算法支付分配理论
AI.method: 1. 数学形式化EAC合约规范；2. 设计操作工作流程；3. 使用NestQuestROI模拟引擎；4. 基于美国1971-2023年历史数据进行实证分析；5. 比较EAC与传统租赁模型的关键指标
AI.findings: 1. EAC为赞助商在真实净营业利润率(RNOM)等关键指标上优于传统租赁模型；2. 为居住者-买家提供正实际回报，而传统租赁无此回报；3. EAC具有普遍适用性，但需要根据当地法律进行参数化定制
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 形式化定义了股权累积合约(EAC)的完整数学规范；2. 建立了透明三方分类账系统的理论框架；3. 提出了算法支付分配的理论模型；4. 证明了EAC在租购应用中的理论优势
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了可操作的EAC工作流程设计；2. 开发了NestQuestROI模拟引擎；3. 展示了EAC在实际应用中的优越性能；4. 强调了本地法律合规的重要性；5. 为全球房地产融资提供了新的结构化工具

title: The Gravity of Soft Power
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Gravity of Soft Power
detail.abstract:
Soft power is always harder to see. Hard power leaves marks on paper, tariffs, numbers, signatures, decisions that can be counted. Soft power is different. It is attraction, credibility, resonance. It is the pull that works without force, the current of trust that cannot be weighed precisely yet still decides whether dialogue holds or falls apart. Without it the machinery shakes. With it the system steadies. Nye, 1990.

This article was originally published by the rEUconnecting Digital Magazine - (REUC). Read the original version here: https://reuc.snm.rs/guest-journalists/articles-and-columns/the-gravity-of-soft-power/

AI.tldr: 该文章探讨软实力的重要性，认为软实力虽然难以量化，但通过吸引力、可信度和共鸣在国际关系中发挥关键作用，是维持对话和系统稳定的基础。
AI.research_question: 软实力在国际关系中如何发挥作用？为什么软实力虽然难以量化却对国际对话和系统稳定至关重要？
AI.motivation: 软实力常常被忽视，因为它不像硬实力那样有明确的量化指标（如关税、数字、签名等），但软实力通过吸引力、可信度和共鸣在国际关系中发挥着关键作用，是维持国际对话和系统稳定的基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要基于约瑟夫·奈（Joseph Nye）的软实力理论（1990年），强调软实力作为吸引力、可信度和共鸣的力量，与硬实力（可量化的经济、军事力量）形成对比。
AI.method: 文章采用概念分析和理论阐述的方法，基于约瑟夫·奈的软实力理论框架，通过对比软实力和硬实力的特征来论证软实力的重要性。
AI.findings: 软实力虽然难以精确衡量，但它是维持国际对话和系统稳定的关键因素。没有软实力，国际关系机制会动摇；有了软实力，系统才能稳定。软实力通过吸引力、可信度和共鸣发挥作用，是一种无需强制就能产生影响的"拉力"。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对软实力本质的理解，强调软实力作为"无法精确衡量但决定对话成败的信任流"的重要性，为软实力理论提供了更丰富的内涵和现实意义。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者和国际关系实践者重视软实力的建设，认识到虽然软实力难以量化，但它对维持国际对话、建立信任和稳定国际体系具有不可替代的作用。

title: Artificial Intelligence Modernization in the US Air Force: Strategic Implications, Readiness, and National Security Impact
affiliations: University of the Cumberlands

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence Modernization in the US Air Force: Strategic Implications, Readiness, and National Security Impact
detail.abstract: This paper examines the rapid integration of artificial intelligence (AI) across the United States Air Force (USAF) and evaluates its implications for readiness, digital modernization, human-machine teaming, ISR survivability, and national security. Drawing from Department of Defence (DoD) strategies, RAND Corporation analyses, Congressional Research Service (CRS) reports, and global military-AI benchmarks, the study identifies critical drivers accelerating USAF AI modernization. The research includes analysis of predictive maintenance models, autonomous teaming, ABMS/JADC2 integration, cyber and adversarial machine learning risks, and operational vulnerabilities in contested environments. The paper also provides comparative analysis of AI-enabled military capabilities in China and Russia, highlighting strategic competition in autonomous systems, ISR fusion, swarming, and electronic warfare. Real data visualizations and forecasting models demonstrate global AI spending trajectories and operational gaps. The research concludes with a national interest justification, showing that AI modernization within the USAF strengthens U.S. defence competitiveness, mitigates adversarial threats, improves workforce readiness, and aligns directly with federal AI security priorities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国空军AI快速整合及其对备战、数字现代化、人机协同、ISR生存能力和国家安全的影响，识别关键驱动因素，分析中美俄AI军事能力对比，论证AI现代化对提升美国国防竞争力的重要性。
AI.research_question: 美国空军人工智能快速整合的驱动因素是什么？这种整合对空军备战、数字现代化、人机协同、ISR生存能力和国家安全有何影响？
AI.motivation: 人工智能技术在全球军事领域的快速发展，特别是中国和俄罗斯在AI军事应用方面的进展，对美国空军构成战略竞争压力，需要评估AI整合对空军现代化和国家安全的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国防部战略、RAND公司分析、国会研究服务报告和全球军事AI基准，结合数字现代化理论、人机协同理论和战略竞争理论。
AI.method: 文献分析（DoD战略、RAND报告、CRS报告）、比较分析（中美俄AI军事能力）、案例研究（预测性维护、自主协同、ABMS/JADC2集成）、风险分析（网络和对抗性机器学习风险）、数据可视化（全球AI支出趋势）和预测模型。
AI.findings: 识别了加速美国空军AI现代化的关键驱动因素；揭示了AI在预测性维护、自主协同、ABMS/JADC2集成等方面的应用价值；分析了网络风险和对抗性机器学习威胁；展示了中美俄在自主系统、ISR融合、蜂群技术和电子战方面的战略竞争；通过数据可视化显示全球AI支出趋势和作战差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了军事AI整合的综合分析框架；发展了人机协同在军事环境中的理论理解；深化了对AI在战略竞争中作用的理论认识；提出了AI现代化与国家安全关联的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国空军AI现代化提供政策建议；识别操作漏洞和风险缓解策略；提供中美俄AI军事能力对比的实用洞察；为国防预算分配和AI投资决策提供数据支持；提升空军人员对AI技术的准备度。

title: Federal Control of State Structure
affiliations: Husch Blackwell LLP

detail.title: Federal Control of State Structure

contentType.other: already selected, forthcoming law journal article

detail.abstract:
The conventional narrative holds that the federal Constitution mandates a tripartite separation of powers at the federal level but says nothing about state government structure. States, rather, have free rein to organize themselves as they wish.

This Article challenges the conventional narrative as reductive and largely wrong. True, no constitutional provision explicitly controls state structure. The closest is the Republican Guarantee Clause, which has not been understood to control state structure in any enforceable way.

Yet as this Article catalogues, several other federal constitutional provisions and doctrines have the effect of controlling state structure. Rooted in the enforcement of federal individual-rights guarantees, these doctrines are not necessarily about state structure. But they all have the collateral consequence of requiring states to separate either legislative power from non-legislative power, executive power from non-executive power, or judicial power from non-judicial power.

Considered all together, these various doctrines require, as a matter of federal constitutional law, that states maintain a tripartite separation of powers. They also set forth standards for policing the required separation in accordance with federal law. And, because they ultimately derive from individual-rights guarantees, they are judicially enforceable.

In sum, this Article constructs a theory of federal control of state structure based on existing constitutional doctrines. In addition to exposing the conventional narrative of federal–state interaction as (at best) incomplete, the theory also has further implications. For one, it may help explain perceived tensions between modern structure-controlling doctrines, on the one hand, and constitutional history, on the other. It may also suggest a gravitational-pull reading of the Republican Guarantee Clause that preserves a role for that Clause in constitutional discourse, even if not in constitutional adjudication. And it may offer a useful, theoretically grounded way of interpreting and applying Moore v. Harper’s reference to “ordinary judicial review” in the election-law context.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了传统观点，认为联邦宪法虽然没有明确条款控制州政府结构，但多项宪法条款和学说实际上要求各州维持三权分立体制。
AI.research_question: 联邦宪法是否以及如何控制州政府的组织结构？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为联邦宪法只规定联邦层面的三权分立，对州政府结构没有要求，但这一观点过于简化且错误。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联邦宪法学说、三权分立理论、共和保障条款、个人权利保障理论
AI.method: 文献分析、宪法条款解释、司法判例研究、理论建构
AI.findings: 多项联邦宪法条款和学说实际上要求各州维持三权分立，这些规定源于个人权利保障，具有司法可执行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了基于现有宪法学说的联邦控制州政府结构理论，揭示了传统联邦-州互动叙事的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 为解释现代结构控制学说与宪法历史之间的紧张关系提供框架，为《Moore v. Harper》案中"普通司法审查"的解释提供理论基础。

title: Implementation of the social component of ESG strategies of Russian TNCs at the present stage
affiliations: Moscow State Institute of International Relations (MGIMO)

detail.title: Implementation of the social component of ESG strategies of Russian TNCs at the present stage
detail.abstract: Starting in 2022, the role of the "S" component within the ESG agenda will increase due to the emergence of new social challenges requiring the corporate environment to adapt to current realities. The rise of the "S" component can be considered a key trend in the transformation of the corporate ESG agenda in Russia. The state is articulated as an imperative for the corporate sector to participate in the implementation of pressing social policy issues, including job creation in the context of the cessation of foreign business activities following the commencement of the ESG, increased well-being in the regions where they operate, and support for local communities. Furthermore, investors and foreign stakeholders are also demanding the social responsibility aspect of companies whose shares are traded on foreign stock exchanges. Thus, it can be argued that a profound rethinking of social values by companies is currently underway. The increasingly popular national ESG rating assesses such a socially significant parameter as "personnel" (salary levels, social and demographic programs, charitable projects). The "G" (government) dimension examines the business reputation of companies, social investment in the regions of presence, and interaction with business associations.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了俄罗斯ESG议程中"S"（社会）成分的重要性提升，分析了国家、投资者和评级体系如何推动企业重新思考社会价值，重点关注就业创造、区域福祉和社区支持等社会政策议题。
AI.research_question: 俄罗斯企业ESG议程中"S"（社会）成分如何因新的社会挑战、国家要求、投资者压力而转变，以及这种转变对企业实践和评级体系的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 自2022年以来，新的社会挑战（如外资企业退出导致的就业问题）要求企业适应现实，国家将社会政策实施作为企业责任，投资者对上市公司社会责任要求增加，促使企业重新思考社会价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: ESG（环境、社会、治理）框架，重点关注其中的"S"（社会）维度；企业社会责任理论；利益相关者理论；国家-企业关系理论。
AI.method: 基于文献分析和政策文件的理论分析，可能包含对俄罗斯ESG评级体系（特别是"S"和"G"维度）的考察，以及对国家政策、投资者要求和商业实践变化的定性分析。
AI.findings: 1. 俄罗斯ESG议程中"S"成分重要性显著提升；2. 国家要求企业参与解决紧迫社会问题（就业、区域福祉、社区支持）；3. 投资者和外国利益相关者要求上市公司履行社会责任；4. 国家ESG评级体系将"人员"（薪资、社会项目）和"治理"（声誉、社会投资）作为关键评估参数。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了ESG框架中"S"维度的理论内涵；2. 探讨了国家在推动企业社会责任中的角色；3. 分析了转型经济体中ESG议程的特殊性；4. 提出了企业社会价值重构的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业适应ESG议程转型提供实践指导；2. 帮助企业理解国家政策要求和投资者期望；3. 为企业改进ESG评级表现提供具体方向（人员管理、社会投资等）；4. 为政策制定者设计ESG激励措施提供参考。

detail.abstract: Orientation: Spiritual genetic engineering, in the form of renaming, is a practice that has its roots in religious sacred texts and practices. This practice is centred on the subtle notion that each letter has vibrational energy that it releases to the universe. Consequently, numerology have been used in naming and renaming processes, both at individual and corporate level. Research purpose: The main purpose of this study was to examine the role of name change and/or name addition, in the pursuit of increased consciousness. Motivation of the study: The main purpose of this study was to contribute towards the attainment of higher consciousness, a critical factor in achieving global consciousness. Research approach / Design and Method: Desktop literature review, autoethnography, gematria, and Chaldean numerology were used to achieve the study's objectives. Main Findings: It was found that names have a significant influence on people's lives, and have the capacity to suppress or support one's soul desire. Due to physical genes being passed down from ancestors, spiritual naming was found to be an effective corrective approach to address negative physical genes. Astonishingly, the results validated the claim concerning a spiritual encoding system, based on the Hebrew language. Practical Implications: The main practical implication is the conscious naming of newborns, consequently leading the rapid reversal of negative traits, ultimately leading to the rise of conscious leaders. Contribution / Value-added: Apart from contributing to the body of knowledge in the novel area of finatual literacy and intelligence, the study enhances the achievement of global consciousness. Furthermore, the study proved the claim about Hebrew being the language of creation.

title: The Architecture of Exception: A Multi-Dimensional Analysis of the 2025 New Zealand Puberty Blocker Ban
affiliations: Victoria University of Wellington - Te Herenga Waka

detail.title: The Architecture of Exception: A Multi-Dimensional Analysis of the 2025 New Zealand Puberty Blocker Ban

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nil.
declarations.funderStatement: Unfunded.

detail.abstract:
Background
On 19 November 2025 the New Zealand Government used the Medicines Act 1981 to restrict puberty blockers (GnRHa) for transgender adolescents. Framed as a "precautionary approach," the decision created a higher evidentiary standard for this group than is applied elsewhere in paediatric medicine.

Analysis
We argue that the ban is an instance of "Regulatory Exceptionalism." We analyse a 44-document policy corpus and extract a 32-field matrix from 12 core policy documents. This material is interpreted through a seven-pillar framework: demanding near-impossible evidence (Epistemological), misdiagnosing rising demand (Economic), bypassing normal processes (Procedural), suspending rights (Constitutional), weaponizing uncertainty (Discourse), inverting non-maleficence (Ethical), and using a health issue for political gain (Political Economy).

Conclusion
Comparing the ban with the routine off-label use of other medicines and the government's parallel push to deregulate medicine approvals shows this policy is an outlier. It reflects evidence selection shaped by policy preference, creating a differential standard of care for transgender youth.

AI.tldr: 新西兰政府2025年11月通过《1981年药品法》限制跨性别青少年使用青春期阻滞剂，该政策被作者批判为"监管例外主义"，即对特定群体设置比其他儿科药物更高的证据标准。
AI.research_question: 新西兰政府限制跨性别青少年使用青春期阻滞剂的政策是否体现了"监管例外主义"？这种政策如何通过七个支柱框架影响跨性别青少年的医疗权益？
AI.motivation: 新西兰政府以"预防性措施"为名，对跨性别青少年使用青春期阻滞剂设置了比其他儿科药物更高的证据标准，这种差异化的监管政策可能对跨性别青少年群体造成不公平的医疗障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管例外主义理论，以及七个支柱分析框架：认识论（要求近乎不可能的证据）、经济学（误诊需求增长）、程序（绕过正常流程）、宪法（暂停权利）、话语（武器化不确定性）、伦理（颠倒无害原则）、政治经济学（利用健康问题获取政治利益）。
AI.method: 分析44份政策文件组成的语料库，从12份核心政策文件中提取32个字段的矩阵，通过七个支柱框架进行解释性分析。
AI.findings: 该禁令与其他药物的常规超说明书使用以及政府同时推动的药物审批放松管制形成鲜明对比，表明这是一种政策异常。政策反映了证据选择受政策偏好影响，为跨性别青少年创造了差异化的医疗标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"监管例外主义"的概念框架，并发展了七个支柱的分析工具，为理解针对特定群体的差异化监管政策提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了政策制定过程中的偏见和不一致性，为倡导跨性别青少年医疗权益提供了分析工具，有助于识别和挑战基于群体身份的差异化监管标准。

title: "The Immigrant's Paradox" Publication Series - Part 1: Why We All Uphold the Sky Where We Stand
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: "The Immigrant's Paradox" Publication Series - Part 1: Why We All Uphold the Sky Where We Stand
detail.abstract: This commentary confronts a fundamental paradox of human history: we are a species of migrants, yet our modern identities are often built on myths of native purity and permanent belonging. This "Immigrant's Paradox" fuels contemporary conflict, from nationalist backlash against newcomers to the refusal of some ideological immigrants to integrate into their host societies. We argue that the solution lies not in ending migration, but in resurrecting a universal principle of coexistence, perfectly captured by the Indonesian proverb "Dimana bumi dipijak, disitu langit dijunjung"—"Wherever you set your foot, there you uphold the sky." This is the non-negotiable duty to respect the local social contract, a concept that is the ultimate antidote to the corrosive forces of supremacist ideology and the key to a stable, pluralistic future.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨"移民悖论"：人类本是迁徙物种，却构建了本土纯正的神话身份认同。作者提出解决之道在于复兴"入乡随俗"的共存原则，即尊重当地社会契约，这是对抗至上主义意识形态、实现稳定多元未来的关键。
AI.research_question: 如何解决"移民悖论"——人类作为迁徙物种却构建本土纯正神话身份认同所引发的当代冲突？
AI.motivation: 当代社会面临移民引发的冲突：民族主义者排斥新移民，而某些意识形态移民拒绝融入东道主社会。这种"移民悖论"威胁社会稳定和多元共存。
AI.theoretical_framework: "移民悖论"理论、社会契约理论、文化适应理论、身份认同理论、多元文化主义理论
AI.method: 概念分析、哲学思辨、文化比较分析（以印尼谚语为例证）
AI.findings: 解决移民冲突的关键不是停止移民，而是复兴"入乡随俗"的普遍共存原则——尊重当地社会契约，这是对抗至上主义意识形态、实现稳定多元未来的根本途径。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"移民悖论"概念框架；2. 将印尼谚语"Dimana bumi dipijak, disitu langit dijunjung"理论化为普遍共存原则；3. 将社会契约理论应用于移民研究；4. 为多元文化主义提供新的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供解决移民冲突的新思路；2. 为移民和东道主社会提供共存指导原则；3. 促进社会稳定和多元文化和谐；4. 为国际移民治理提供伦理框架。

title: The Evolution of the Wave Mechanics Theory in Microwave Absorption: A Journey from Scientific Correction to Academic Exile
affiliations: Shenyang Normal University

detail.title: The Evolution of the Wave Mechanics Theory in Microwave Absorption: A Journey from Scientific Correction to Academic Exile
detail.abstract: This article reviews the development of the "Wave Mechanics Theory" of microwave absorption, tracing its history from its inception in 2018 to its systematic maturation in 2025. The theory originated from a fundamental correction: the identification that mainstream research confused the physical properties of material with those of films. While the period from 2018 to 2022 saw the successful overturning of the dominant "Impedance Matching" and "Quarter-wavelength" theories by Liu Yue's research group, the sociological response of the academic community reveals deep systemic issues. Instead of fostering healthy debate, the mainstream community responded with silence, rejection, and a deliberate deluge of papers supporting the flawed status quo. The article concludes by discussing the post-2025 era, where the suppression of this theory in peer-reviewed journals led to a shift toward independent publishing platforms (Substack), highlighting a critical crisis in academic peer review and scientific integrity.

AI.tldr: 该论文回顾了"波动力学理论"从2018年提出到2025年系统化成熟的发展历程，揭示了主流学术界对颠覆性理论的压制机制，以及由此暴露的同行评审危机和科学诚信问题。
AI.research_question: 微波吸收"波动力学理论"如何从提出到成熟发展？学术界对颠覆性理论的反应机制是什么？这种反应揭示了学术体系的哪些深层问题？
AI.motivation: 揭示微波吸收领域主流理论（阻抗匹配和四分之一波长理论）存在根本性错误，记录颠覆性理论在学术体系中的发展历程和遭遇的压制，暴露同行评审机制和科学诚信的系统性危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 波动力学理论（微波吸收新理论）、阻抗匹配理论（被推翻的主流理论）、四分之一波长理论（被推翻的主流理论）、科学社会学理论、学术权力结构理论
AI.method: 历史回顾分析、文献综述、学术社会学分析、案例研究（刘岳研究组的工作）、时间序列分析（2018-2025年发展历程）
AI.findings: 1. 波动力学理论成功推翻了阻抗匹配和四分之一波长理论；2. 主流学术界对颠覆性理论采取沉默、拒绝和论文洪水的压制策略；3. 2025年后理论被主流期刊压制，转向Substack等独立出版平台；4. 暴露了同行评审机制的系统性缺陷和科学诚信危机。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了微波吸收的波动力学理论框架；2. 提供了科学理论颠覆过程的实证案例；3. 发展了学术社会学中关于理论压制机制的分析框架；4. 揭示了学术权力结构与科学进步之间的张力关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为微波吸收材料设计提供了新的理论基础；2. 暴露了同行评审系统的缺陷，推动学术出版改革；3. 为年轻学者面对学术压制提供了应对策略；4. 促进了独立学术出版平台的发展。

title: A Dual Learning Model for Last-Mile Delivery Pricing

detail.title: A Dual Learning Model for Last-Mile Delivery Pricing
detail.abstract: Last-mile delivery platforms encounter significant order cancellations due to uncertainty about the customer's willingness to pay adequate delivery fee and also the driver's willingness to accept such offers. The current approach of using static pricing models fail to adapt to this dual uncertainty, leading to suboptimal market outcomes. This paper develops a framework to address this challenge by modeling this as a learning problem. We formulate the interaction as a stackelberg game where the platform acts as the leader, making direct price and payout offers. We propose and compare two learning methodologies for the platform: a model-based approach that simultaneously learns the parameters of customer and driver valuation functions using a gradient-based method, and a modelfree Q-learning approach that directly learns an optimal pricing policy. Numerical simulations demonstrate that both learning approaches significantly outperform a non-learning, fixed-rate benchmark policy. Both the model-based and model-free approaches are shown to converge towards the true underlying values over time, leading to more efficient transaction outcomes and a larger total economic surplus for the platform, customers, and drivers. The results highlight the substantial value of adaptive learning in such a two-sided market. By actively managing this exploration-exploitation trade-off, a platform can uncover latent market dynamics, automate its pricing strategy, and achieve superior long-term profitability. This provides a clear advantage over static pricing mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对最后一公里配送平台的双边不确定性（顾客支付意愿和司机接单意愿）问题，提出了两种学习型定价策略：基于模型的方法和无模型Q学习，显著优于静态定价基准。
AI.research_question: 最后一公里配送平台如何通过自适应学习策略解决顾客支付意愿和司机接单意愿的双重不确定性，以优化定价和支付决策？
AI.motivation: 最后一公里配送平台面临大量订单取消，原因是无法准确预测顾客愿意支付的配送费和司机愿意接受的报价。现有的静态定价模型无法适应这种双边不确定性，导致市场结果次优。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将平台与顾客、司机的互动建模为Stackelberg博弈，平台作为领导者制定价格和支付报价。采用探索-利用权衡理论来管理市场动态学习。
AI.method: 提出并比较两种学习方法：1）基于模型的方法，使用梯度法同时学习顾客和司机估值函数的参数；2）无模型Q学习方法，直接学习最优定价策略。通过数值模拟验证效果。
AI.findings: 两种学习方法都显著优于非学习的固定费率基准策略。两种方法都能随时间收敛到真实底层价值，带来更高效的交易结果，为平台、顾客和司机创造更大的总经济剩余。
AI.theory_contributions: 为双边市场中的自适应定价提供了理论框架，将Stackelberg博弈与机器学习相结合，展示了探索-利用权衡在揭示潜在市场动态中的价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为配送平台提供了可操作的定价策略，能够自动化定价决策，提高长期盈利能力，相比静态定价机制具有明显优势。

title: Youth Radicalization as a Regional Security Threat: Global South and Bangladesh Perspectives Author

detail.title: Youth Radicalization as a Regional Security Threat: Global South and Bangladesh Perspectives Author
detail.abstract:
Youth radicalization has emerged as a critical security challenge across many parts of the Global South, where demographic youth bulges, economic exclusion, political marginalization, and rapidly expanding digital connectivity interact to create fertile ground for extremist recruitment and mobilization. This paper examines youth radicalization as a multi-causal, socially embedded process and argues that its implications extend beyond individual trajectories to pose significant regional security threats—transnational recruitment, cross-border militant mobility, diaspora-mediated financing, and digital propaganda spillovers. Drawing on established theoretical models (e.g., Moghaddam’s ‘staircase to terrorism’), recent empirical studies, and policy reports focused on South Asia and Bangladesh, the paper synthesizes drivers (structural, ideological, social, and
technological), pathways (offline and online), and outcomes (violence, instability, and governance erosion). Bangladesh is used as a detailed case study: despite important counter-extremism gains in the 2010s, emergent socio-political crises, high youth unemployment, periodic mass protests, and intensified online information ecosystems have contributed to renewed vulnerability among segments of youth. The paper maps how local grievances are sometimes reframed by transnational
extremist narratives and how social media accelerates radical socialization, while state responses (security operations, closure of civic space) both mitigate and, at times, exacerbate drivers by alienating communities. Policy implications emphasize a regional, multi-level approach: (1) socioeconomic inclusion and youth employment; (2) community-led prevention and resilience; (3) calibrated law enforcement aligned with human rights; (4) digital literacy and platform accountability; and (5) enhanced cross-border cooperation for intelligence, deradicalization, and reintegration. The conclusion calls for research-policy partnerships in the Global South to design context-sensitive CVE (countering violent extremism) strategies and recommends longitudinal evaluation of prevention interventions to reduce risk while preserving civic freedoms.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了全球南方青年激进化问题，以孟加拉国为案例，分析了多因素驱动、线上线下途径及区域安全影响，提出了多层次政策建议。
AI.research_question: 全球南方青年激进化如何作为多因素、社会嵌入的过程，对区域安全构成威胁？孟加拉国案例揭示了哪些具体驱动因素和应对挑战？
AI.motivation: 青年激进化已成为全球南方关键安全挑战，人口年轻化、经济排斥、政治边缘化和数字连接性增强相互作用，为极端主义招募创造了肥沃土壤，需要系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Moghaddam的"恐怖主义阶梯"理论模型，结合结构、意识形态、社会和技术驱动因素框架，分析青年激进化的多因素过程。
AI.method: 综合理论模型、实证研究和政策报告，以孟加拉国为详细案例研究，分析驱动因素、途径和结果。
AI.findings: 青年激进化是多因素过程，本地不满被跨国极端主义叙事重构，社交媒体加速激进社会化。国家应对措施有时会通过疏远社区而加剧驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 将青年激进化概念化为多因素、社会嵌入的过程，扩展了对全球南方区域安全威胁的理解，强调线上线下途径的相互作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出区域多层次政策方法：社会经济包容、社区主导预防、人权校准执法、数字素养、跨境合作。建议建立研究-政策伙伴关系，设计情境敏感的CVE策略。

AI.research_question: 欧盟成员国在人工智能发展和应用中，儿童权利被考虑的程度如何？存在哪些现有框架和需要填补的差距？

AI.method: 采用映射研究方法，通过文献分析、政策审查和案例研究，系统调查欧盟成员国在AI领域的儿童权利保护现状。
AI.findings: 研究发现成员国在AI领域对儿童权利的保护存在差异，部分国家建立了初步框架，但整体上缺乏系统性的儿童权利保护机制。
