AI.practical_contributions: 为新闻出版商、人工智能开发者和数据挖掘从业者提供了法律指引，有助于规范相关行业实践，促进技术创新与版权保护的平衡

title: Remedy or Retreat? Investigating Ex-post Incentives under the One-Vote Veto System
affiliations: ShanghaiTech University - School of Entrepreneurship and Management, Peking University - Guanghua School of Management, Tsinghua University - PBC School of Finance and Peking University - Guanghua School of Management

detail.title: Remedy or Retreat? Investigating Ex-post Incentives under the One-Vote Veto System
detail.abstract: This study offers a nuanced exploration of the unintended behavioral consequences stemming from the one-vote veto system---a performance evaluation mechanism that nullifies all achievements in the event of a critical failure. While previous research has largely concentrated on the ex-ante effects of such systems---how they shape agents' efforts to avoid failures---this paper shifts focus to the ex-post strategic responses of agents, particularly local government officials in China, following veto-triggering events like major workplace safety accidents (WSAs). Using a comprehensive prefecture-by-day dataset on WSAs and employing a regression discontinuity design in time, with the dates of major WSAs as the cutoff, we uncover significant behavioral shifts. Before the implementation of the veto system, local governments actively engaged in remedial actions after WSAs, such as intensifying efforts to promote economic growth and environmental protection. However, following the introduction of the veto system, these compensatory measures ceased, indicating that local officials abandoned broader efforts once a single failure nullified all other accomplishments. Further analysis reveals that this behavioral shift is closely linked to promotion incentives, as the rigid accountability framework diminished the motivation to address failures holistically. By shedding light on the adverse effects of the one-vote veto system, this study provides critical insights for policymakers aiming to design effective performance evaluation systems, especially in contexts where overly rigid mechanisms risk undermining comprehensive governance and sustained effort.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了中国"一票否决"绩效评估系统的意外行为后果。研究发现，在实施一票否决制后，地方政府在发生重大安全事故后不再采取补救措施，因为一旦触发否决，所有其他成就都被清零，官员失去了继续努力的动机。
AI.research_question: 一票否决制如何影响地方政府官员在触发否决事件（如重大安全事故）后的战略行为反应？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注一票否决制的事前效应（如何影响代理人避免失败的努力），但缺乏对事后战略反应的研究。了解官员在触发否决后的行为变化对设计有效的绩效评估系统至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于绩效评估理论、激励理论和官僚行为理论，特别关注刚性问责框架如何影响地方官员的补救行为。
AI.method: 使用中国地级市每日安全事故的全面数据集，采用时间断点回归设计，以重大安全事故发生日期为断点，分析一票否决制实施前后的行为变化。
AI.findings: 在一票否决制实施前，地方政府在安全事故后会积极采取补救措施（如促进经济增长和环境保护）。但实施后，这些补偿性措施完全停止，官员一旦触发否决就放弃了更广泛的努力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 拓展了对一票否决制后果的理解，从事前效应延伸到事后行为反应；2) 揭示了刚性问责机制如何削弱官员处理失败的整体动机；3) 丰富了绩效评估系统设计的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者设计有效的绩效评估系统提供关键见解；2) 警示过度刚性的问责机制可能破坏全面治理和持续努力；3) 建议在绩效评估中考虑更灵活的机制以保持官员的补救动机。

title: The Road to the World's First Children's AI Summit
affiliations: The Alan Turing Institute, The Alan Turing Institute, The Alan Turing Institute and The Alan Turing Institute

detail.title: The Road to the World's First Children's AI Summit

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: The Children’s AI Summit, organised by the Children and AI team at The Alan Turing Institute, was done in partnership with Queen Mary University of London and supported by the LEGO Group, Elevate Great, and EY.

detail.abstract: The Children's AI Summit, organised by the Children and AI team at The Alan Turing Institute in partnership with Queen Mary University of London and supported by the LEGO Group, Elevate Great, and EY, took place on February 4 th , 2025. It brought together around 150 children and young people, aged 8 to 18, from over 20 schools and youth groups across the UK to explore their hopes and concerns about AI, their visions for how they'd like to see AI developed and used in the future and their messages for what they wanted governments, policy-makers and AI developers to know about children's experiences with AI. The event aimed to inform the agenda of the global AI Action Summit which took place in Paris the following week, but also to demonstrate unequivocally that children's participation in these processes is both possible and hugely valuable. This paper outlines the rationale behind the event and provides an overview of the process through which the event and its outputs were developed, illustrating the various interlocking components that were necessary to ensure the success and impact of the summit. It is our hope that by sharing details on the planning and methodology, we can enable other organisations to meaningfully engage with children and young people in conversations about AI and the way it is developed now and in the future. We believe, this event should not be an exception but rather the norm and we hope that this Summit is the first of many such processes to bring children's voices and experiences-and children themselves-directly into decision-making and policy-making relating to AI.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了2025年儿童AI峰会，这是一个让8-18岁儿童和青少年参与AI讨论的活动，旨在将儿童的声音纳入AI决策过程，并希望此类活动成为常态。
AI.research_question: 如何有效组织儿童参与AI讨论的峰会，并将他们的声音纳入AI政策制定过程？
AI.motivation: 儿童作为AI的重要使用者和受影响群体，他们的声音在AI政策制定中往往被忽视。需要创建平台让儿童直接参与AI讨论，为全球AI行动峰会提供儿童视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 儿童参与理论、参与式设计方法、儿童权利框架、代际公平原则
AI.method: 组织儿童AI峰会，汇集150名8-18岁儿童和青少年，通过研讨会、讨论组等方式收集他们对AI的希望、担忧和愿景，并将结果整理为政策建议。
AI.findings: 成功组织了儿童参与AI讨论的峰会，收集了儿童对AI的多元观点，证明了儿童参与AI政策讨论的可行性和价值，为后续类似活动提供了方法论参考。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了儿童参与AI政策制定的理论框架，展示了如何将儿童权利和参与式设计原则应用于AI治理领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了组织儿童AI峰会的具体方法和流程，为其他组织开展类似活动提供了可复制的模板，促进了儿童声音在AI政策制定中的制度化。

title: Enhancing Students' Digital Competencies Within the Employability Module of the University of Europe's Skills-based Curricula
affiliations: Hochschule Fresenius - University of Applied Sciences and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Enhancing Students' Digital Competencies Within the Employability Module of the University of Europe's Skills-based Curricula
detail.abstract: The onset of the coronavirus has catalyzed an acceleration in the adoption of digital teaching practices that have been trending in Higher Education for over a decade. The most obvious of these has been the abrupt switch to online training. Given the speed at which this transition from in-person instruction has taken place, many instructors' natural first inclination has been to maintain teaching styles as similar as possible to those employed in person, including the traditional lecture format. However, a growing body of research is confirming what instructors across the educational spectrum are observing: namely, that student behaviour, the psychological effect of the medium, participation levels, attention span and learning outcomes online can vary widely from those demonstrated in traditional classroom settings. It is becoming increasingly clear that conditions such as "Zoom fatigue" are very real, and that, if teaching is to be effective, different methodologies based on digital learning experiences should be added to educators' repertoires that take the particular challenges and new opportunities of the online environment into consideration. This paper will examine how some of these new online-based methodologies and digital tools are being developed and introduced at the University of Europe within the undergraduate students' Employability module to enhance the student online experience as well as learning outcomes. The module spans three semesters; here the authors will focus on implementations within the first semester, Employability I: English and the second semester, Employability II: Soft Skills to nurture relevant skills and to ensure that learning environments remain fit-for-purpose for the digital age.

AI.tldr: 新冠疫情加速了高等教育数字化转型，但许多教师仍沿用传统面授教学方式。研究发现线上学习的学生行为、心理效应、参与度、注意力等与线下差异显著，需要针对线上环境特点开发新的教学方法。本文探讨欧洲大学在就业能力模块中如何引入基于数字学习体验的新方法和工具，以提升学生在线学习体验和成果。
AI.research_question: 在新冠疫情加速高等教育数字化转型的背景下，如何针对线上学习环境的特殊挑战和机遇，开发和应用新的在线教学方法和数字工具，以提升学生的在线学习体验和学习成果？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情迫使高等教育迅速转向在线教学，但许多教师仍沿用传统面授教学方式。研究发现线上学习的学生行为、心理效应、参与度、注意力等与线下存在显著差异，"Zoom疲劳"等现象真实存在。需要开发适合线上环境的教学方法，确保数字时代的学习环境保持有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字学习体验理论、在线教育心理学、学生参与度理论、注意力理论、学习成果评估理论、数字时代教学法理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，以欧洲大学就业能力模块为研究对象，重点分析第一学期"就业能力I：英语"和第二学期"就业能力II：软技能"中在线教学方法和数字工具的开发与应用实践。
AI.findings: 线上学习环境需要不同于传统面授的教学方法；基于数字学习体验的新方法能有效应对"Zoom疲劳"等挑战；针对性的数字工具能提升学生参与度和学习效果；多学期模块化设计有助于系统培养数字时代所需技能。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了数字时代教学法理论，提出了针对线上学习环境特点的教学设计原则；丰富了在线教育心理学理论，特别是关于"Zoom疲劳"等心理效应的应对策略；发展了数字学习体验理论，为高等教育数字化转型提供理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育机构提供了在线教学的具体实施案例；开发了适用于就业能力培养的在线教学方法和工具；为教师提供了应对线上教学挑战的实践指导；为多学期模块化在线课程设计提供了参考框架。

title: Public Diplomacy Built to Last: Why Trust Needs Layers, Not Moments
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Public Diplomacy Built to Last: Why Trust Needs Layers, Not Moments
detail.abstract:
Public diplomacy does not succeed because something looked good once. It is not about moments. Not really. It lives in layers. One speech. One program. One conversation. They build on each other, or they cancel each other out. Trust is not earned in one go. It comes from repetition. It comes from rhythm. And it needs memory.

This article was originally published by the rEUconnecting Digital Magazine - (REUC). Read the original version here: https://reuc.snm.rs/guest-journalists/articles-and-columns/public-diplomacy-built-to-last-why-trust-needs-layers-not-moments/

AI.tldr: 本文探讨公共外交的长期性，强调信任建立需要层层累积而非单次事件，主张通过持续、有节奏的互动来构建持久信任。
AI.research_question: 公共外交如何有效建立持久信任？为什么信任需要层层累积而非依赖单次事件？
AI.motivation: 传统公共外交往往关注单次事件或短期成果，但实际信任建立需要长期、持续的努力。本文旨在揭示公共外交中信任建立的本质过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信任建立理论、关系营销理论、社会资本理论，强调信任的累积性和过程性特征。
AI.method: 概念性分析，通过理论推演和案例观察，探讨公共外交中信任建立的动态过程。
AI.findings: 信任建立是渐进过程，需要多次互动累积；单次事件效果有限，甚至可能相互抵消；节奏和记忆在信任建立中起关键作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"层叠信任"理论框架，强调公共外交中信任建立的累积性和过程性，挑战了传统的事件驱动型公共外交模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共外交实践者提供指导：应设计长期、连贯的互动项目，注重节奏和一致性，建立制度性记忆机制，避免依赖单次事件。

title: Innovation as a Factor of Increasing Company Value in Modern Conditions
affiliations: Moscow State Institute of International Relations (MGIMO)

detail.title: Innovation as a Factor of Increasing Company Value in Modern Conditions
detail.abstract: Value maximization of an economic entity is one of the most popular concepts in corporate governance, aimed at increasing the long-term wealth of shareholders. In modern conditions, the driving force behind this growth is the development of new technologies and increased business activity through innovation. The purpose of this study is to uncover the essence of innovation in improving business processes and developing competitive advantages, as well as the impact of this activity on company value.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨创新如何通过改进业务流程和建立竞争优势来提升公司价值，分析创新活动对企业价值最大化的影响机制。
AI.research_question: 创新活动如何通过改进业务流程和建立竞争优势来影响公司价值？
AI.motivation: 在现代经济条件下，技术创新和业务创新是推动企业价值增长的核心驱动力，但创新如何具体转化为公司价值的过程和机制需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司治理中的价值最大化理论、创新理论、竞争优势理论、业务流程优化理论
AI.method: 未明确说明，但可能采用文献综述、案例分析或实证研究方法

title: Coffee-Based Agroforestry Systems as a Sustainable Forest Management Strategy: Evidence from Humbang Hasundutan, Indonesia
affiliations: Universitas Sumatera Utara, Universitas Sumatera Utara, Universitas Sumatera Utara and Universitas Sumatera Utara

detail.title: Coffee-Based Agroforestry Systems as a Sustainable Forest Management Strategy: Evidence from Humbang Hasundutan, Indonesia
detail.abstract: Deforestation and land degradation remain pressing challenges in Indonesia, particularly in forest-margin areas where agricultural expansion drives ecological decline. Coffee-based agroforestry has emerged as a promising strategy to reconcile ecological conservation with socio-economic development. This study analyzes the characteristics, ecological functions, and economic contributions of coffee-based agroforestry systems in Humbang Hasundutan Regency, North Sumatra, Indonesia. Using a mixed-methods approach, primary data were collected through field surveys, soil and vegetation analysis, and farmer interviews, complemented by secondary spatial and statistical datasets. The study applied land suitability analysis, economic feasibility assessment, and modeling of biomass and carbon stocks to evaluate system performance across different forest types and management zones. Results indicate that coffee-based agroforestry systems significantly enhance land productivity and farmer income compared to monoculture practices, with average household earnings exceeding regional minimum living standards. Ecologically, these systems reduce soil erosion, improve soil fertility and water retention, and contribute to biodiversity conservation. Multistrata agroforestry models demonstrated higher carbon sequestration potential (up to 52 t C/ha) compared to simplified systems, highlighting their role in climate change mitigation. The integration of diverse shade trees not only stabilizes microclimatic conditions but also provides complementary products such as fruits, timber, and fuelwood, further diversifying farmer livelihoods. This study concludes that coffee-based agroforestry represents a viable alternative for sustainable forest management in tropical uplands. By integrating ecological, economic, and social dimensions, it offers a pathway to align local livelihoods with global sustainability targets, including SDG 15 on life on land. Policy support, capacity building, and long-term monitoring are essential to optimize system adoption and scalability across forest-margin communities.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了印度尼西亚北苏门答腊省Humbang Hasundutan县咖啡农林复合系统的特征、生态功能和经济贡献，发现该系统能显著提高土地生产力和农民收入，改善土壤质量，增强碳汇能力，是实现热带高地可持续森林管理的可行方案。
AI.research_question: 咖啡农林复合系统在森林边缘地区的特征、生态功能和经济贡献是什么？这些系统如何协调生态保护与社会经济发展？
AI.motivation: 印度尼西亚森林边缘地区的森林砍伐和土地退化问题严重，农业扩张导致生态衰退。咖啡农林复合系统作为协调生态保护与社会经济发展的有前景策略，需要系统评估其实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续森林管理理论、农林复合系统理论、生态系统服务理论、可持续生计框架、气候变化减缓理论。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：通过实地调查、土壤和植被分析、农民访谈收集一手数据，辅以二手空间和统计数据。应用土地适宜性分析、经济可行性评估、生物量和碳储量建模，评估不同森林类型和管理区域的系统表现。
AI.findings: 1. 咖啡农林复合系统显著提高土地生产力和农民收入，家庭平均收入超过地区最低生活标准；2. 生态上减少土壤侵蚀，改善土壤肥力和保水能力，促进生物多样性保护；3. 多层农林复合模型碳汇潜力更高（达52吨碳/公顷）；4. 多样化遮荫树稳定微气候条件，提供水果、木材、薪材等补充产品，多样化农民生计。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为热带高地可持续森林管理提供实证支持；2. 丰富农林复合系统在森林边缘地区的应用理论；3. 扩展生态系统服务与生计可持续性的整合框架；4. 为SDG 15（陆地生物）目标实现提供理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供森林边缘地区可持续农业发展的可行方案；2. 为农民提供提高收入和生态效益的具体实践指导；3. 为气候变化减缓提供基于自然的解决方案；4. 为社区发展项目提供可扩展的模型；5. 强调政策支持、能力建设和长期监测的重要性。

title: From “America First” to the MAGA Mindset: The Cognitive-Political Roots of Mike Ferguson’s Interpretive Lens
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: From “America First” to the MAGA Mindset: The Cognitive-Political Roots of Mike Ferguson’s Interpretive Lens

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no financial, personal, or professional relationships that could be perceived as influencing the research presented in this paper. The analysis is entirely independent and based solely on publicly available information and scholarly evaluation.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human subjects, medical data, or experimental interventions requiring institutional ethics approval. The individual referenced in the case study is examined solely through publicly available statements and interactions within open online forums. No personal data was collected, and no private communications were used
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author as part of an ongoing research program within the IR3 framework.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the cognitive-ideological framework underlying the worldview of Mike Ferguson, a representative figure of the post-Cold War conservative consciousness in the United States. By situating his interpretive lens within the historical evolution of America First nationalism, the MAGA movement, Christian Zionism, and the rise of the digital right-wing youth (Groyper Movement), the study reveals a distinctive Trumpcentric narrative structure. This structure operates not as a political theory but as a psychopolitical apparatus built upon identity, nostalgia, and moral absolutism. The paper analyzes how this lens shapes Ferguson's interpretation of global issues-including Russia, Islam, Israel, immigration, and Europe-while highlighting the generational rupture between the "single-voice media" era and the technologically pluralistic present. Through this case study, the research exposes a broader epistemic crisis in American conservatism, wherein outdated cognitive models clash with a rapidly transforming international system. The paper concludes by situating this phenomenon within the IR3 framework, arguing that understanding such cognitive collapses is essential for diagnosing the failures of modern diplomacy and global political analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析美国后冷战时期保守主义代表人物Mike Ferguson的世界观认知-意识形态框架，揭示了一种独特的特朗普中心叙事结构，该结构基于身份认同、怀旧情绪和道德绝对主义，而非政治理论，并探讨了这种认知框架如何塑造对全球问题的解读，以及美国保守主义面临的认知危机。
AI.research_question: Mike Ferguson作为美国后冷战时期保守主义意识的代表人物，其世界观背后的认知-意识形态框架是什么？这种框架如何塑造他对全球问题的解读，并反映了美国保守主义面临的更广泛的认知危机？
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于理解后冷战时期美国保守主义意识的演变，特别是特朗普时代形成的独特叙事结构，以及这种认知框架如何影响对全球政治的理解，揭示美国保守主义在面对快速变化的国际体系时所面临的认知危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 研究基于美国优先民族主义、MAGA运动、基督教锡安主义和数字右翼青年（Groyper运动）的历史演变框架，运用特朗普中心叙事结构理论，以及IR3（国际关系3.0）框架来分析认知崩溃现象。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，通过分析Mike Ferguson的认知-意识形态框架，将其置于美国优先民族主义、MAGA运动等历史语境中，揭示其叙事结构如何运作并塑造对全球问题的解读。
AI.findings: 研究发现Ferguson的世界观呈现一种独特的特朗普中心叙事结构，这种结构不是政治理论，而是基于身份认同、怀旧情绪和道德绝对主义的心理政治装置。这种认知框架塑造了他对俄罗斯、伊斯兰、以色列、移民和欧洲等全球问题的特定解读，并揭示了"单一声音媒体"时代与技术多元化现状之间的代际断裂。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于提出了特朗普中心叙事结构作为心理政治装置的概念框架，揭示了美国保守主义中认知模型与快速变化的国际体系之间的冲突，为理解现代外交失败和全球政治分析提供了认知层面的解释工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献在于帮助政策制定者和分析师理解美国保守主义内部的认知危机，为诊断现代外交失败提供认知视角，并为应对技术驱动的政治传播变化提供见解，有助于更有效地进行国际政治分析和外交实践。

title: A Systematic Review of Mental Health and Productivity Challenges and Navigating Turbulence in Academia
affiliations: School of Business and Management, Christ University, , Nirmala College for Women, Christ Deemed to be University and Christ Deemed to be University

detail.title: A Systematic Review of Mental Health and Productivity Challenges and Navigating Turbulence in Academia
detail.abstract: This study examines academic mental health and productivity through a systematic and thematic literature review of research published from 2019 to 2025, with a focus on the impact of COVID-19. Searches in Scopus, Ebsco, ProQuest, Science Direct, and Google Scholar identified key challenges, including stress, burnout, and work-life imbalances, which were exacerbated by the pandemic. Systemic barriers such as inadequate funding, fragmented support, and rigid institutional policies further disrupted academic productivity. Vulnerable groups, including academic mothers, doctoral candidates, minority students, and early career researchers, faced disproportionate burdens. Additionally, academic writing productivity declined, and excessive media use negatively impacted attention spans and mental health. While interventions such as peer support systems, flexible work policies, and co-designed mental health initiatives have been proposed, existing approaches remain fragmented and insufficient for long-term solutions and targeted interventions to improve academic mental health and productivity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过2019-2025年文献的系统性主题综述，研究了COVID-19对学术界心理健康与生产力的影响，识别了关键挑战、系统性障碍和脆弱群体，并评估了现有干预措施的局限性。
AI.research_question: COVID-19如何影响学术界的心理健康和生产力？哪些系统性障碍加剧了这些问题？哪些群体最为脆弱？现有干预措施的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: COVID-19大流行对学术界造成了前所未有的冲击，加剧了原本存在的心理健康和生产力问题，需要系统性研究来理解其影响机制并寻找有效解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于工作压力理论、工作-生活平衡理论、社会支持理论以及脆弱性理论框架，分析疫情对学术界的影响。
AI.method: 采用系统性文献综述和主题分析方法，检索Scopus、Ebsco、ProQuest、Science Direct和Google Scholar等数据库2019-2025年的相关研究。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1)疫情加剧了压力、倦怠和工作生活失衡；2)资金不足、支持体系碎片化、制度政策僵化等系统性障碍阻碍了生产力；3)学术母亲、博士生、少数群体学生和早期职业研究者等脆弱群体负担更重；4)学术写作生产力下降，过度媒体使用损害注意力和心理健康；5)现有干预措施碎片化且不足以提供长期解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1)整合了疫情背景下学术界心理健康与生产力的多维度分析框架；2)识别了系统性障碍与脆弱群体之间的相互作用机制；3)提出了需要更系统化干预的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1)为高等教育机构制定针对性心理健康政策提供依据；2)识别需要优先支持的脆弱群体；3)建议发展同伴支持系统、灵活工作政策和共同设计的心理健康计划；4)强调需要更整合、长期的干预策略。

title: Financial Information Theory
affiliations: Artificial Intelligence in Finance Institute

detail.title: Financial Information Theory
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a comprehensive framework for Financial Information Theory by applying information-theoretic concepts-such as entropy, Kullback-Leibler divergence, mutual information, normalized mutual information, and transfer entropy-to financial time series. We systematically derive these measures with complete mathematical proofs, establish their theoretical properties, and propose practical algorithms for estimation. Using S&P 500 data from 2000-2025, we demonstrate empirical usefulness for regime detection, market efficiency testing, and portfolio construction. We show that normalized mutual information (NMI) behaves as a powerful, bounded, and interpretable measure of temporal dependence, highlighting periods of structural change such as the 2008 financial crisis and COVID-19 shock. Our entropy-adjusted Value at Risk, information-theoretic diversification criterion, and NMI-based market efficiency test provide actionable tools for risk management and asset allocation. We interpret NMI as a quantitative diagnostic of the Efficient Market Hypothesis and demonstrate that information-theoretic methods offer superior regime detection compared to traditional autocorrelation or volatility-based approaches. All theoretical results include rigorous proofs, and empirical findings are validated across multiple market regimes spanning 25 years of daily returns.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个金融信息理论的综合框架，将信息论概念（如熵、KL散度、互信息、归一化互信息、传递熵）应用于金融时间序列分析，并展示了其在制度检测、市场效率测试和投资组合构建中的实证应用。
AI.research_question: 如何将信息论概念系统性地应用于金融时间序列分析，并开发出可用于制度检测、市场效率测试和投资组合构建的实用工具？
AI.motivation: 传统金融分析方法（如自相关或基于波动率的方法）在检测市场制度变化和评估市场效率方面存在局限性，需要更强大的理论框架和工具来更好地理解金融市场的动态行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融信息理论框架，基于信息论的核心概念：熵、Kullback-Leibler散度、互信息、归一化互信息、传递熵。
AI.method: 1. 系统推导信息论度量并建立理论性质；2. 提出实际估计算法；3. 使用2000-2025年标普500数据进行实证分析；4. 验证多个市场制度下的结果。
AI.findings: 1. 归一化互信息（NMI）是强大的、有界且可解释的时间依赖性度量；2. NMI能有效检测结构性变化时期（如2008年金融危机和COVID-19冲击）；3. 信息论方法在制度检测方面优于传统方法；4. NMI可作为有效市场假说的定量诊断工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了金融信息理论的综合框架；2. 提供了所有理论结果的严格证明；3. 将NMI解释为有效市场假说的定量诊断工具；4. 建立了信息论度量的理论性质。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 熵调整的VaR（风险价值）；2. 信息论多样化准则；3. NMI市场效率测试；4. 为风险管理和资产配置提供可操作工具；5. 实证验证了25年日收益率数据的实用性。

title: Measuring the Value of Trademark Distinctiveness: Evidence from the Market for Bordeaux Wines
affiliations: Duke University School of Law, University of Chicago - Law School and The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Measuring the Value of Trademark Distinctiveness: Evidence from the Market for Bordeaux Wines

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Hong Kong Faculty of Law Research Paper No. 2025/19
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Hong Kong Faculty of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: Duke Law School Public Law & Legal Theory Series No. 2025-38
publicationDetails.journalName: Duke Law School Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Empirical Legal Studies, volume 22, issue 4, 2025[10.1111/jels.70002]

detail.abstract: The market value of distinctive trademarks is a fundamental assumption of both trademark law and marketing theory. However, there is little empirical evidence underlying this assumption. We examine the relationship between brand dissimilarity and market prices in the context of the Bordeaux wine market. Using a unique dataset covering thousands of wines and their associated prices and professional ratings, we find that brand distinctiveness is related to higher wine prices. We further show that this relationship persists across the wine quality spectrum with both lower quality and higher quality wines benefiting from dissimilar marks. Finally, we show that while there is a dissimilarity price premium for lower quality wines, producers who invest in higher quality wines are rewarded with an even greater premium for dissimilar names in absolute dollar terms.

AI.tldr: 研究发现品牌独特性与葡萄酒市场价格正相关，这种关系在质量谱系中普遍存在，且高质量葡萄酒的品牌独特性溢价绝对值更大
AI.research_question: 品牌独特性（商标差异性）与市场价格之间的关系是什么？这种关系在不同质量水平的葡萄酒中如何变化？
AI.motivation: 商标法和营销理论都假设独特商标具有市场价值，但缺乏实证证据支持这一基本假设
AI.theoretical_framework: 商标法理论（商标独特性价值）、品牌差异化理论、信号理论（质量信号）
AI.method: 使用波尔多葡萄酒市场的独特数据集，涵盖数千种葡萄酒的价格和专业评分，实证分析品牌差异性与价格的关系
AI.findings: 1. 品牌独特性与更高的葡萄酒价格相关；2. 这种关系在整个葡萄酒质量谱系中都存在；3. 高质量葡萄酒的品牌独特性溢价绝对值更大
AI.theory_contributions: 为商标法和营销理论中的基本假设提供了实证支持，扩展了品牌差异化理论在奢侈品市场的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为葡萄酒生产商提供品牌命名策略建议，表明投资高质量产品并采用独特名称能获得更大溢价

title: Solving Professors' Dilemmas about Prohibiting or Promoting Student AI Use
affiliations: University of Missouri School of Law

detail.title: Solving Professors' Dilemmas about Prohibiting or Promoting Student AI Use

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2025-53
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Faculty face difficult dilemmas as law students increasingly use generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools like ChatGPT.  Should faculty prohibit student use of AI in course work, allow it within limits, or actively encourage it to build professional skills?  Because students already use AI tools, faculty must respond.  Doing nothing can undermine core educational goals.

This article offers practical strategies for addressing these dilemmas.  These strategies are designed to promote learning, uphold academic integrity, and prepare students for an evolving legal profession.  This article outlines two broad approaches:  restricting unauthorized AI use and promoting responsible, supervised use.  It provides concrete suggestions for both approaches as well as a middle path permitting some uses and prohibiting others.  In addition, some faculty may treat AI literacy as an important learning objective in its own right.

This article includes model policies, a certification form, grading rubrics, and assignment ideas to help faculty clarify goals and manage student AI use.  It offers techniques to help students use AI tools effectively and responsibly.  Rather than treating AI solely as a threat to legal education, this article presents it as an opportunity to clarify core values, rethink teaching methods, and better prepare students for a profession reshaped by emerging technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文针对法学院学生使用生成式AI工具（如ChatGPT）带来的教学困境，提出了实用的应对策略，包括限制未经授权的使用和促进负责任、有监督的使用两种主要方法，并提供具体实施工具。
AI.research_question: 法学院教师应如何应对学生使用生成式AI工具带来的教学挑战？具体应采取何种策略来平衡学术诚信、学习效果和职业准备？
AI.motivation: 随着学生越来越多地使用生成式AI工具，法学院教师面临教学困境：是禁止使用、有限允许还是积极鼓励以培养职业技能？不作为会损害核心教育目标，因此必须制定应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育技术整合理论、学术诚信框架、职业能力发展理论、教学法创新理论
AI.method: 实践导向的策略分析，提供具体的实施工具和框架，包括模型政策、认证表格、评分标准和作业设计
AI.findings: 提出了两种主要应对策略：1）限制未经授权的AI使用；2）促进负责任、有监督的AI使用。提供了中间路径，允许某些用途而禁止其他用途。强调AI素养本身可以作为重要的学习目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI挑战重新定义为澄清核心价值、重新思考教学方法的机会，而非单纯威胁；提出了法律教育中AI整合的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的实施工具：模型政策、认证表格、评分标准、作业设计；帮助教师明确目标、管理学生AI使用；培养学生有效、负责任使用AI的能力。

title: The Role of Explainable AI (XAI) in Improving Transparency in Human Resource Decisions
affiliations: Rashtrasant Tukdoji Maharaj Nagpur University

detail.title: The Role of Explainable AI (XAI) in Improving Transparency in Human Resource Decisions
detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has rapidly transformed Human Resource Management (HRM) practices, offering unprecedented efficiency in recruitment, talent management, and employee retention. However, the "black box" nature of AI systems has raised significant concerns about transparency, accountability, and fairness in HR decision-making. This paper examines the critical role of Explainable AI (XAI) in addressing these challenges by enhancing transparency in HR processes. Drawing on recent literature from 2024-2025, this study explores how XAI techniques such as SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations), LIME (Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations), and feature importance analysis improve the interpretability of AI-driven HR decisions. The paper analyzes XAI applications across recruitment, employee attrition prediction, performance evaluation, and bias mitigation. Findings indicate that while XAI offers substantial benefits in building trust, ensuring fairness, and enabling data-driven decision-making, significant challenges remain in technical implementation, organizational adoption, and regulatory compliance. This research contributes to the growing discourse on ethical AI in HRM and provides practical recommendations for HR practitioners, AI developers, and policymakers.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨可解释人工智能（XAI）在人力资源管理（HRM）中的关键作用，分析XAI如何通过提高AI决策的透明度来解决HRM中的公平性、问责制和信任问题。
AI.research_question: 可解释人工智能（XAI）如何解决人力资源管理（HRM）中AI系统的透明度、公平性和问责制挑战？
AI.motivation: AI在HRM中的广泛应用带来了效率提升，但"黑箱"特性引发了透明度、问责制和公平性的严重关切，需要XAI来应对这些挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于可解释人工智能（XAI）理论，结合人力资源管理中的公平性、透明度和问责制理论框架。
AI.method: 文献综述法，分析2024-2025年最新文献，探讨SHAP、LIME和特征重要性分析等XAI技术在HRM中的应用。
AI.findings: XAI在建立信任、确保公平性和支持数据驱动决策方面具有显著优势，但在技术实施、组织采纳和监管合规方面仍面临重大挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了HRM中伦理AI的理论讨论，为AI透明度和公平性理论提供了实证支持，推动了XAI在组织环境中的应用理论发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为HR从业者、AI开发者和政策制定者提供了实用建议，指导XAI在招聘、员工流失预测、绩效评估和偏见缓解等HR流程中的实际应用。

title: Killing Shipwrecked Survivors is Not Just Illegal - It Endangers U.S. Servicemembers
affiliations: Emory University School of Law

detail.title: Killing Shipwrecked Survivors is Not Just Illegal - It Endangers U.S. Servicemembers

publicationDetails.journalName: Emory University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
According to recent media reports, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth verbally ordered special forces to "kill everybody" ahead of a Sept. 2 operation targeting alleged drug traffickers in international waters. That order allegedly resulted in a follow-on "double tap" strike that killed two survivors who were clinging to wreckage. 

I agree with Professor Jack Goldsmith that if the media reporting is accurate, this military operation is a "dishonorable strike" that is illegal under international law and the laws of war. This sentiment and logic were echoed by former U.S. military lawyers. The illegal order also runs contrary to longstanding U.S. military doctrine and U.S. Navy Regulations governing the treatment of survivors at sea.  But beyond the troubling legal issues associated with the strike, killing unarmed and vulnerable survivors is stunningly shortsighted. Killing survivors of a military strike is not just patently illegal and morally reprehensible; it is strategically reckless. 

The United States, which has military forces deployed around the globe, cannot build a safer world for its own servicemembers by discarding basic laws of war. History shows that when America blatantly abandons humane norms and the law of war, it ultimately endangers its own people. Compliance with international law - including the laws of war - is built, in many respects, on reciprocity. If the United States abandons these rules, it cannot expect its adversaries to follow them when Americans are the ones captured, isolated, shipwrecked, or shot down. And it's not just reciprocity. Weakening the legitimacy of such fundamental rules also corrodes the underlying foundation of a system that serves U.S. servicemembers time and again. As the world's most widely deployed maritime power, the United States relies on these protections more than any other nation. And what's more, illegal orders create moral, reputational, and strategic harm long after the violations of law have ceased.

AI.tldr: 该文批评美国国防部长下令在军事行动中"杀死所有人"并随后攻击幸存者的行为，认为这违反国际法和战争法，不仅不道德且战略上短视，会损害美国自身利益和全球军事行动的合法性。
AI.research_question: 美国军事指挥官下达"杀死所有人"并攻击幸存者的命令是否符合国际法和战争法？这种行为对美国军事利益和全球安全秩序有何战略影响？
AI.motivation: 基于媒体报道美国国防部长下令在打击毒品贩运行动中"杀死所有人"并实施"双重打击"杀死幸存者的事件，作者认为这种行为严重违反国际法和战争法，需要从法律、道德和战略角度进行分析批判。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际人道法（战争法）、美国军事法规、互惠原则、战略理性理论、军事伦理理论
AI.method: 法律分析、历史案例分析、战略推理、道德论证、基于媒体报道的事实分析
AI.findings: 1. 该军事命令违反国际法和美国军事法规；2. 杀死无武装幸存者是不道德且战略短视的行为；3. 违反战争法会破坏互惠原则，最终危及美国军人；4. 美国作为全球部署最广的海上强国，最需要这些法律保护；5. 非法命令会造成长期的道德、声誉和战略损害。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将互惠原则应用于现代战争法遵守的分析；2. 提出违反战争法对美国自身军事利益的战略损害理论；3. 强调军事强国遵守国际法的特殊重要性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为军事指挥官提供遵守战争法的战略理由；2. 为军事决策者展示违反国际法的长期后果；3. 为军事训练和条令制定提供伦理和法律指导；4. 为国际社会监督美国军事行动提供分析框架。

title: Timing the Drop: Release Day Patterns and Strategic Implications
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: Timing the Drop: Release Day Patterns and Strategic Implications
detail.abstract:
This report explores how artists of different sizes and genres choose their release days in today’s streaming-driven music market. Using data from more than 1,000 tracks released on Spotify in 2024, the analysis compares weekday patterns across artist follower tiers and major genre groups to reveal how competition, platform cycles, and listening behaviors shape release strategies.

The findings show that Friday remains the industry’s most dominant release day, driven by Spotify’s global update cycle—yet it is also the most competitive. Mid-level artists appear to avoid this crowd by releasing more frequently on Thursdays, while genres such as EDM, K-Music, and Hip-Hop show their own distinct timing patterns linked to fan activity and consumption rhythms. These results suggest that release timing is not just a scheduling choice but a strategic decision that can influence early visibility.

By highlighting these structural patterns, the report provides practical insights that artists, managers, and labels can use to plan releases more effectively. Future work could connect release timing to actual performance outcomes, offering even clearer guidelines for navigating the competitive streaming landscape.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了2024年Spotify上1000多首歌曲的发行日模式，发现周五仍是主流发行日但竞争激烈，中等级别艺术家更多选择周四发行，不同音乐类型有独特的发行时间模式。
AI.research_question: 在流媒体驱动的音乐市场中，不同规模和类型的艺术家如何选择发行日？发行日模式如何受到竞争、平台周期和听众行为的影响？
AI.motivation: 在当今流媒体主导的音乐市场中，发行时机对歌曲的早期可见性和成功可能具有重要影响。然而，不同规模和类型的艺术家在发行策略上可能存在差异，这些模式尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争理论、平台周期理论、听众行为模式理论、战略时机选择理论
AI.method: 使用2024年Spotify平台上1000多首歌曲的发行数据，分析不同艺术家粉丝等级和主要音乐类型的发行日模式，比较工作日模式。
AI.findings: 1. 周五仍是行业最主要的发行日，由Spotify的全球更新周期驱动，但竞争最激烈；2. 中等级别艺术家更频繁地选择周四发行以避免竞争；3. EDM、K-Music和Hip-Hop等音乐类型有独特的发行时间模式，与粉丝活动和消费节奏相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了流媒体时代音乐发行时间的战略性质；2. 建立了艺术家规模、音乐类型与发行时机选择之间的关系；3. 阐明了平台周期对行业实践的结构性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为艺术家、经纪人和唱片公司提供实用的发行规划建议；2. 帮助不同规模的艺术家制定差异化发行策略；3. 为特定音乐类型的发行时机选择提供参考依据。

detail.title: Measuring the Uncertain Task Content of Work: Workforce Design for AI-Driven Human-Robot Collaboration in Intralogistics

publicationDetails.detailsText: MIT Center for Transportation & Logistics Research Paper No. 2025/035
publicationDetails.journalName: MIT Center for Transportation & Logistics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of strategic workforce planning for AI-driven human-robot collaboration (AI-HRC) in intralogistics. We ask two questions: how can task-level full-time equivalent (FTE) estimates be constructed from existing labor statistics, and how can these estimates, combined with AI exposure metrics, inform strategic AI-HRC design and workforce planning? Drawing on U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics employment data, O*NET occupational profiles, and task-level AI exposure scores, we develop a stochastic task-time framework that decomposes occupations into tasks and models task frequencies as probability vectors on the simplex. A covariance-completion procedure reconstructs task covariance matrices consistent with survey standard errors, enabling the translation of occupational data into task-and detailed work activity (DWA)-level FTE estimates with uncertainty bounds. Applying the framework to the U.S. intralogistics workforce, we find that roughly 380,000 FTEs (about 17% of workers) are concentrated in DWAs in the top 15% of AI-exposed DWAs. These results provide task-specific insight into AIdriven automation and support scenario-based workforce planning by linking alternative AI-HRC adoption paths to task-level FTE impacts, uncertainty bands, and upskilling priorities, thereby offering an analytical foundation for resilient, humancentered AI-HRC systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个随机任务时间框架，将职业分解为任务，利用美国劳工统计局数据、O*NET职业档案和任务级AI暴露评分，为AI驱动的人机协作（AI-HRC）提供战略劳动力规划方法，特别应用于美国内部物流领域。
AI.research_question:
1. 如何从现有劳动力统计数据构建任务级全职等效（FTE）估算？
2. 这些估算如何结合AI暴露指标，为战略AI-HRC设计和劳动力规划提供信息？
AI.motivation: AI驱动的人机协作在内部物流等领域的快速发展需要战略性的劳动力规划，但现有劳动力统计数据缺乏任务级别的详细分析，难以准确评估AI自动化对具体工作任务的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 随机任务时间框架：将职业分解为任务，将任务频率建模为单纯形上的概率向量
2. 协方差完成程序：重建与调查标准误差一致的任务协方差矩阵
3. 任务级AI暴露评分与劳动力数据分析的整合框架
AI.method:
1. 使用美国劳工统计局就业数据、O*NET职业档案和任务级AI暴露评分
2. 开发随机任务时间框架，将职业分解为详细工作活动（DWA）
3. 应用协方差完成程序重建任务协方差矩阵
4. 将职业数据转化为任务和DWA级别的FTE估算，并计算不确定性边界
5. 应用于美国内部物流劳动力分析
AI.findings:
1. 美国内部物流劳动力中，约380,000名FTE（约17%的工人）集中在AI暴露最高的15%的DWA中
2. 提供了任务特定的AI驱动自动化洞察
3. 支持基于情景的劳动力规划，将替代性AI-HRC采用路径与任务级FTE影响、不确定性边界和技能提升优先级联系起来
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 开发了将宏观劳动力统计数据转化为微观任务级分析的理论框架
2. 提出了结合AI暴露指标的随机任务时间建模方法
3. 建立了任务协方差矩阵重建的统计方法，为不确定性量化提供理论基础
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为企业提供AI-HRC战略设计和劳动力规划的分析工具
2. 识别AI自动化高风险任务和相应的技能提升需求
3. 支持弹性、以人为本的AI-HRC系统建设
4. 为政策制定者提供基于数据的劳动力转型决策支持

detail.title: The Implications of Resale Channels in the Apparel Industry

publicationDetails.detailsText: SMU Cox School of Business Working Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: SMU Cox School of Business Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: There is widespread perception that resale platforms that allow consumers to buy and sell used apparel play an important role in reducing production and waste. Many consumers possess clothes that they rarely use because their individual utility has eroded, due to changes in fit or personal tastes. Nearly all existing resale channels, both those operated by branded apparel manufacturers and those that operate independently, promote themselves as helping to get clothes out of closets or landfills by finding new homes for them. While resale channels seem well-positioned to transfer products from consumers who no longer value them highly to those who do, whether they will necessarily benefit branded apparel manufacturers, or reduce the quantity of new units produced are open questions. We develop a game-theoretic infinite-horizon model in which a brand chooses production and pricing while interacting with resale channels. We first consider brand-operated resale and show that resale increases the quantity of new units only when it is also socially efficient. We then consider the impact of a third-party resale channel on a brand that does not operate its own. In this case, the brand never benefits from resale, and the possibility of resale increases output of new units for a range of intermediate transaction costs for which this is not socially efficient. Finally, we extend the analysis to competitive resale markets. While competition can replicate brand-controlled outcomes, it can also exacerbate overproduction for a range of intermediate transaction costs. Our results demonstrate that resale channels are not uniformly beneficial, especially when operated by third-parties. Without well-structured relationships between brands and resale platforms or clear policies about which products a resale platform will trade, resale may encourage overproduction. This insight should inform decisions made by brands, resale platforms, and regulators.

AI.tldr: 本文通过博弈论模型分析二手服装转售平台对品牌商生产决策的影响，发现第三方转售平台可能导致过度生产，而品牌自营转售仅在符合社会效率时才增加产量。
AI.research_question: 二手服装转售平台是否必然有利于品牌服装制造商？是否会减少新服装的生产量？
AI.motivation: 二手转售平台普遍宣传能减少服装浪费，但实际是否有利于品牌商和减少新生产量尚不明确。消费者因尺码变化或个人喜好改变而闲置的服装能否通过转售真正实现环保效益需要验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论无限期模型，分析品牌生产定价决策与转售渠道的互动关系。考虑品牌自营转售、第三方转售以及竞争性转售市场三种情境。
AI.method: 建立博弈论无限期模型，品牌选择生产和定价策略，与转售渠道互动。分析不同交易成本下转售对产量和社会效率的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 品牌自营转售仅在符合社会效率时才增加新产量；2. 第三方转售平台对品牌无益，且在一定交易成本范围内会导致过度生产；3. 竞争性转售市场可能复制品牌控制结果，也可能加剧过度生产。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统分析转售渠道对品牌生产决策的影响机制，揭示第三方转售可能导致过度生产的理论机制，为可持续消费研究提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒品牌商、转售平台和监管机构：转售渠道并非总是有益，需要建立品牌与平台的结构化关系，明确转售产品范围，避免过度生产。为政策制定提供决策依据。

detail.title: Trading Down or Cutting Back? U.S. Household Consumption Responses to the U.S.-China Trade War

publicationDetails.detailsText: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines whether lower household consumption growth in U.S. counties more exposed to Chinese retaliatory tariffs during the 2018-19 trade war reflected true consumption declines or households "trading down" to cheaper goods. Using granular barcode-level scanner data to measure purchase quality, the study finds a national shift toward lower-quality goods from 2016 to 2019, suggesting households may have eased economic distress by buying cheaper products. However, this trading-down trend was not stronger in more tariff-exposed counties. The findings clarify how tariffs and foreign retaliation affect household welfare and the urgency for policymakers seeking to offset negative consumption effects.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用条形码级别的扫描数据发现，2016-2019年间美国家庭普遍转向购买更便宜的低质量商品，但这种"降级消费"趋势在受中国报复性关税影响更大的县并不更明显，表明关税暴露地区的消费增长放缓主要反映了真实消费下降而非消费降级。
AI.research_question: 美国家庭在2018-19年贸易战中消费增长放缓，是反映了真实消费下降，还是仅仅"降级消费"转向更便宜的商品？
AI.motivation: 理解贸易战和关税对家庭福利的实际影响，区分消费数量下降和质量下降的不同效应，为政策制定者提供更精确的评估依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易战的经济影响理论，关税对消费行为的效应，家庭应对经济冲击的消费调整策略（质量调整vs数量调整）。
AI.method: 使用细粒度的条形码级别扫描数据测量购买质量，比较2016-2019年间不同关税暴露程度县的家庭消费行为变化。
AI.findings: 1. 全国范围内存在向低质量商品转移的趋势；2. 但这种"降级消费"趋势在受中国报复性关税影响更大的县并不更强；3. 关税暴露地区的消费增长放缓主要反映了真实消费下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了关税和外国报复如何影响家庭福利，区分了消费数量效应和质量效应，为理解贸易冲击的微观机制提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更精确的评估工具，强调了抵消负面消费影响的紧迫性，帮助识别真正需要政策干预的地区和群体。

title: Why Premium AI Subscriptions Don't Transform Mediocrity Into Genius: Empirical Evidence on the Creativity Gap in Human-AI Collaboration

detail.title: Why Premium AI Subscriptions Don't Transform Mediocrity Into Genius: Empirical Evidence on the Creativity Gap in Human-AI Collaboration

publicationDetails.detailsText: This working paper is also available on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.17735720) in identical form.

detail.abstract: Silicon Valley promises that generative AI democratizes creativity for less than $20 monthly. Recent empirical evidence challenges this claim decisively. This working paper synthesizes findings from multiple 2025 studies, demonstrating that individuals with higher baseline creativity and intelligence continue to outperform peers when both groups access AI assistance. Drawing on research with 442 participants from Penn State and University of Connecticut, plus meta-analytical evidence from 28 studies (N=8,214), this paper shows AI amplifies rather than equalizes creative capacity. Three critical patterns emerge: (1) prior creative ability predicts AI-assisted performance (β = 0.39 to 0.42); (2) AI collaboration reduces idea diversity, generating homogenization effects; (3) AI functions as selective talent amplifier, not universal equalizer. Contribution: This working paper contributes to the literature by integrating empirical findings into a unified framework that conceptualizes AI as a selective talent amplifier rather than a creativity equalizer, with strategic implications for organizations, education systems, and policy design. The analysis emphasizes that AI serves as productivity multiplier for existing talent rather than substitute for human creativity, judgment, and contextual intelligence.

AI.tldr: 生成式AI并未如硅谷所承诺的以每月20美元的价格实现创造力民主化。2025年多项研究表明，具有更高基线创造力和智力的个体在获得AI协助后仍然优于同龄人。AI放大了而非均衡了创造能力，主要体现为：1）先前的创造能力预测AI辅助表现；2）AI协作减少想法多样性；3）AI是选择性人才放大器而非普遍均衡器。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI是否真正实现了创造力的民主化？AI是作为创造力均衡器还是选择性人才放大器？
AI.motivation: 硅谷声称生成式AI以每月不到20美元的价格实现了创造力民主化，但近期实证证据对这一说法提出了挑战。需要系统研究AI对创造力分布的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人才放大理论而非均衡理论，认为AI作为选择性放大器而非普遍均衡器。整合了创造力理论、认知能力理论和AI协作理论。
AI.method: 综合多项2025年研究：1）442名来自宾夕法尼亚州立大学和康涅狄格大学参与者的实证研究；2）28项研究的元分析（N=8,214）。采用定量分析（β系数）和定性分析（模式识别）。
AI.findings: 三个关键模式：1）先前创造能力预测AI辅助表现（β=0.39-0.42）；2）AI协作减少想法多样性，产生同质化效应；3）AI作为选择性人才放大器而非普遍均衡器。
AI.theory_contributions: 将实证发现整合到统一框架中，将AI概念化为选择性人才放大器而非创造力均衡器。强调AI是现有人才的生产力乘数，而非人类创造力、判断力和情境智力的替代品。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织、教育系统和政策设计提供战略启示：需要重新思考AI在创造力培养和人才发展中的作用，避免对AI作为均衡器的过度依赖。

detail.abstract: Using high-frequency consumption data and panel local projections, we examine the heterogeneous responses of household consumption to different types of aggregate uncertainty. We employ macroeconomic, financial, and real uncertainty measures and find a significant negative impact, with notable differences in the timing of the impact and its persistence. Constructing a nominal uncertainty index reveals that the prolonged effect of macroeconomic uncertainty is primarily driven by monetary factors such as interest rates, rather than real variables. We also find heterogeneous effects across households with different observable characteristics, such as income volatility and race. In addition, we account for key unobservable heterogeneity in time and risk preferences, with discount factor heterogeneity exhibiting the largest effect. Importantly, classifying households by liquidity constraints shows that unconstrained households respond more rapidly, whereas constrained households adjust their consumption with a delay and exhibit larger declines.

AI.tldr: 使用高频消费数据和面板局部投影方法，研究不同类型总体不确定性对家庭消费的异质性影响，发现宏观经济不确定性通过货币因素产生持久影响，且不同特征家庭（收入波动性、种族、流动性约束等）的反应存在显著差异。
AI.research_question: 不同类型总体不确定性如何异质性影响家庭消费？不同特征家庭对不确定性的消费反应有何差异？
AI.motivation: 理解不确定性对消费的影响对宏观经济政策制定至关重要，但现有研究对不确定性类型和家庭异质性的考虑不足，需要更精细的分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于不确定性经济学、消费理论、预防性储蓄理论，结合异质性家庭模型和时间/风险偏好理论。
AI.method: 使用高频消费数据和面板局部投影方法，构建宏观经济、金融和实际不确定性指标，并建立名义不确定性指数。
AI.findings: 1. 不同类型不确定性对消费有显著负向影响，但影响时机和持续性不同；2. 宏观经济不确定性的持久效应主要由利率等货币因素驱动；3. 收入波动性、种族等可观测特征导致异质性反应；4. 时间偏好异质性影响最大；5. 流动性约束家庭反应延迟且下降幅度更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 区分不同类型不确定性的消费效应；2. 揭示货币因素在不确定性传导中的核心作用；3. 整合可观测和不可观测异质性对消费反应的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为货币政策制定提供依据；2. 帮助识别脆弱家庭群体；3. 为经济不确定性时期的精准政策干预提供指导。

title: Ethical Marketing and Sustainable Tourism: Integrating Corporate Social Responsibility, Cultural Values, and Environmental Awareness
affiliations: ,  and Stamford University Bangladesh - Department of Business Administration

detail.title: Ethical Marketing and Sustainable Tourism: Integrating Corporate Social Responsibility, Cultural Values, and Environmental Awareness
detail.abstract: The tourism sector serves as essential for worldwide economic and cultural advancement, although it is under growing examination for its environmental and social impacts. As emerging economies like Bangladesh pursue sustainable growth, the incorporation of ethical marketing has become essential for balancing profitability with accountability. Ethical marketing extends mere persuasive communication; it encompasses openness, justice, and respect for cultural and ecological values. In this context, corporate social responsibility (CSR), cultural values, and environmental awareness are acknowledged as essential factors that determine ethical marketing practices and affect sustainable tourism results. This study examines the mediating function of ethical marketing in connecting corporate social responsibility (CSR), cultural values, and environmental awareness to sustainable tourist development in Bangladesh. Utilizing Stakeholder Theory and the Triple Bottom Line framework, it examines how ethical marketing converts internal sustainability commitments into outward performance results. A quantitative cross-sectional survey was administered to 550 tourists having previous experience visiting tourism destinations in Bangladesh. Data were examined by Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) to evaluate the proposed correlations. The findings indicate that corporate social responsibility, cultural values, and environmental consciousness substantially affect ethical marketing, which subsequently enhances sustainable tourism. CSR emerged as the most significant predictor of ethical marketing, suggesting that responsible business conduct fosters transparent, culturally responsive, and environmentally sustainable marketing communication. Nonetheless, environmental awareness demonstrated a weak direct correlation with sustainable tourism, indicating that awareness alone does not guarantee responsible behavior unless reinforced by ethical marketing strategies. The results offer theoretical insights about the mediating function of ethical marketing and practical implications for tourist officials, marketers, and organizations in developing economies aiming to synchronize ethical practices with long-term sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了伦理营销在连接企业社会责任、文化价值观和环境意识与孟加拉国可持续旅游发展之间的中介作用。研究发现CSR、文化价值观和环境意识显著影响伦理营销，进而促进可持续旅游，其中CSR是最强预测因子。
AI.research_question: 伦理营销在企业社会责任、文化价值观、环境意识与孟加拉国可持续旅游发展之间起什么中介作用？
AI.motivation: 旅游业对全球经济文化发展至关重要，但面临日益严峻的环境和社会影响审查。孟加拉国等新兴经济体追求可持续增长时，需要平衡盈利与责任，伦理营销成为关键。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利益相关者理论和三重底线框架，用于解释伦理营销如何将内部可持续发展承诺转化为外部绩效结果。
AI.method: 定量横断面调查，对550名曾访问孟加拉国旅游目的地的游客进行问卷调查，使用结构方程模型(SEM)分析数据。
AI.findings: 企业社会责任、文化价值观和环境意识显著影响伦理营销，进而促进可持续旅游。CSR是伦理营销的最强预测因子。环境意识与可持续旅游的直接关系较弱，表明仅靠意识不足以促进行为改变，需要伦理营销策略强化。

AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：为旅游官员、营销人员和组织提供指导，帮助他们在新兴经济体中协调伦理实践与长期可持续发展，特别是强调CSR在推动伦理营销中的关键作用。

detail.abstract: In terms of social activities and exercise, the COVID-19 pandemic means that many of us are sitting at home. For individuals, the corona virus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic can be traumatic. In adults and adolescents, uncertainty and anxiety about a new disease could be daunting thereby may trigger intense emotions. Public-health actions can make individuals feel alienated and alone, such as social distancing, and can increase stress and anxiety. However, to decrease the spread of COVID-19, these acts are required. People you care for and your culture can be made stronger by dealing with stress in a healthier way. This can have an adverse impact on your mental and physical health. It is vital that everyone is aware about other health threats and hazards in these crucial situations so that they can remain safe and secure. The studies in this section allow you to understand in depth the psycho-social wellbeing of Covid-19 affected people.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨COVID-19大流行对人们心理社会福祉的影响，分析疫情带来的创伤性体验、不确定性、焦虑情绪以及社交隔离对心理健康的影响，并提出应对策略。
AI.research_question: COVID-19大流行如何影响个体的心理社会福祉？疫情带来的创伤性体验、不确定性、社交隔离等因素如何影响人们的心理健康？
AI.motivation: COVID-19大流行导致人们居家隔离、社交活动减少，这种生活方式的改变可能对心理健康产生负面影响。疫情带来的不确定性、焦虑情绪以及公共卫生措施（如社交距离）可能导致个体感到孤独和压力增加，需要深入研究这些心理社会影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创伤理论、压力应对理论、社会支持理论、心理健康框架、危机心理学理论。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，综合现有研究分析COVID-19对心理社会福祉的影响。
AI.findings: COVID-19大流行对个体心理健康产生多方面负面影响：1）疫情具有创伤性特征；2）不确定性和焦虑情绪显著增加；3）社交隔离措施导致孤独感和压力加剧；4）这些因素共同影响心理和生理健康；5）健康的应对方式可以增强社会支持和文化韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了危机情境下心理社会福祉的理论理解；2）深化了公共卫生事件对心理健康影响的理论框架；3）为创伤性公共卫生事件的心理学研究提供理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提高公众对疫情心理健康影响的认识；2）为制定心理健康干预措施提供依据；3）促进健康应对策略的推广；4）帮助个体在危机中保持心理安全；5）为公共卫生政策制定提供参考。

title: LLMs in Product Selection for Small E-Commerce

detail.title: LLMs in Product Selection for Small E-Commerce
detail.abstract: Product selection is a persistent challenge for small businesses. With limited data and technical expertise, these firms often rely on intuition rather than evidence. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) offer a promising alternative for supporting data-driven decisions in resource-constrained settings. We propose an LLM-based product selection framework that emphasizes comparative rather than single-item prediction. We show that LLMs perform poorly without contextual references, but that constructing reference groups and enabling comparative reasoning substantially improves predictive accuracy. However, larger reference groups reduce performance, and different grouping strategies lead to meaningfully different outcomes. Our approach significantly outperforms competitive machine learning models in predicting product-selection outcomes. These findings provide practical guidance for small businesses making product decisions and offer new insights into how LLMs leverage relational information in decision-making tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于大语言模型的产品选择框架，强调比较而非单项预测，显著提升了小企业在资源有限情况下的产品决策准确性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用大语言模型帮助资源有限的小企业进行更准确的产品选择决策？
AI.motivation: 小企业在产品选择上面临持续挑战，由于数据和专业技术有限，往往依赖直觉而非证据进行决策。大语言模型的进展为资源受限环境下的数据驱动决策提供了有前景的替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较推理理论、参考群体理论、大语言模型在决策任务中的应用理论
AI.method: 提出基于LLM的产品选择框架，强调比较而非单项预测；构建参考群体并启用比较推理；测试不同参考群体规模和分组策略对预测准确性的影响
AI.findings: 1. 没有上下文参考时，LLM表现不佳；2. 构建参考群体并启用比较推理能显著提高预测准确性；3. 较大的参考群体反而降低性能；4. 不同的分组策略导致明显不同的结果；5. 该方法在预测产品选择结果方面显著优于竞争性机器学习模型
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了关于LLM如何在决策任务中利用关系信息的新见解，深化了对比较推理机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为小企业产品决策提供实用指导，提供了一种在资源有限情况下进行数据驱动决策的有效框架

detail.abstract:
This dissertation investigates how short sleep, stimulant use, and mental health have relationships one another. Across three chapters, I move from descriptive to quasi-experimental evidence and show that (i) greater stimulant purchasing is associated with more insomnia symptoms—and vice versa; (ii) exogenously later sunsets—which misalign biological and social clocks and thereby reduce sleep—raise household caffeine purchases; and (iii) the same late sunsets increase the prevalence of depression and anxiety, especially where circadian misalignment is most severe.

Building on prior work that estimates one-way associations using small sample or self-reported stimulant consumption, I fill the gap by examining bidirectional relationships with nationally representative longitudinal purchase and health data. The causal evidence that later sunsets/sunrises increase both caffeine purchases and depression suggests a compensatory behavioral response to sleep loss—households purchase more caffeine to offset fatigue—and an elevated mental health risk from short sleep.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究短睡眠、兴奋剂使用和心理健康之间的相互关系。通过三个章节从描述性证据到准实验证据，发现：兴奋剂购买与失眠症状相互关联；日落时间推迟（导致生物钟与社会时钟错位）会增加家庭咖啡因购买；同样的日落推迟会增加抑郁和焦虑患病率，尤其在昼夜节律失调最严重的地方。
AI.research_question: 短睡眠、兴奋剂使用和心理健康之间如何相互关联？这些关系是单向的还是双向的？昼夜节律失调如何影响兴奋剂消费和心理健康？
AI.motivation: 先前研究多使用小样本或自我报告数据，仅估计单向关联。本研究填补空白，使用全国代表性纵向购买和健康数据，检验双向关系，并提供因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生物钟与社会时钟错位理论（昼夜节律失调）、睡眠剥夺理论、补偿性行为反应理论（用咖啡因抵消疲劳）、心理健康风险理论。
AI.method: 采用三阶段研究设计：从描述性分析到准实验证据。使用全国代表性纵向购买数据和健康数据。利用外生性日落时间变化作为自然实验，检验昼夜节律失调对咖啡因购买和心理健康的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 兴奋剂购买与失眠症状存在双向关联；2. 日落时间推迟（导致生物钟与社会时钟错位）会增加家庭咖啡因购买；3. 同样的日落推迟会增加抑郁和焦虑患病率，尤其在昼夜节律失调最严重的地方。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了短睡眠、兴奋剂使用和心理健康之间双向关系的理论证据；2. 建立了昼夜节律失调通过睡眠剥夺影响兴奋剂消费和心理健康的因果机制；3. 扩展了补偿性行为反应理论在睡眠-兴奋剂关系中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为公共卫生政策制定者提供证据，支持关注睡眠健康的重要性；2. 为心理健康干预提供新视角，考虑睡眠和兴奋剂使用的综合影响；3. 为企业（如咖啡行业）和医疗保健提供者提供消费者行为洞察。

detail.abstract: The great thinkers and philosophers of our country like Swami Dayananda, Swami Vivekananda, Aurobindo and Gandhi have described education as a man-making process. Bringing out the latent sublime qualities within the individual and providing for the all-round development of the personality including the physical, mental, intellectual and spiritual aspects should form the goal of education. Education has been considered as one of the very important dominion in our national life as the system of education constitutes as the foundation of the legal, civic and administrative also developmental domains of future unfolding India. The purpose of this paper is not to provide any detailed plan of educational reform, but it suggests that there is no dearth of educational innovative ideas, but we are lacking in putting them into reality. It recommends that the main purpose of education should not become to create just human robots or making a skilled manpower, but an immediate action is needed to provide the necessary roadmap for future policy and concrete action. Project-Based Learning (PBL) is an individual or group activity that goes on over a period of time, resulting in a product, presentation, or performance. It is now used at many professional institutes to promote lifelong learning, open inquiry, teamwork, and critical thinking. Traditional learning is being replaced by PBL which is new and innovative educational technique. The Present study aims at finding the effectiveness of PBL in professional education especially in MBA Program. Following an overview of the characteristics of the project-based learning method, a comparison of PBL has been made with traditional learning with faculty and MBA students' perceptions. The comparative value of scores supported by data on outcomes that have been studied, reveal that t-values are significant at 0.01 levels. It is concluded that the project-based learning method can yield a surplus value compared to more traditional types of education and training.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了项目式学习（PBL）在MBA专业教育中的有效性，通过与传统学习方法比较，发现PBL能产生显著优于传统教育的额外价值。
AI.research_question: 项目式学习（PBL）在MBA专业教育中的效果如何？与传统学习方法相比有何优势？
AI.motivation: 教育不应仅仅培养"人类机器人"或熟练劳动力，而应关注人的全面发展。虽然教育创新理念丰富，但缺乏实施。PBL作为一种创新的教育技术，在促进终身学习、开放探究、团队合作和批判性思维方面具有潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于印度思想家（如Swami Dayananda、Swami Vivekananda、Aurobindo和Gandhi）的教育哲学，强调教育是"造人过程"，应促进个体全面发展（身体、心理、智力和精神）。同时结合现代教育理论中的项目式学习理论。
AI.method: 比较研究方法：通过教师和MBA学生的感知，比较PBL与传统学习方法。使用统计分析方法（t检验）分析学习成果数据，显著性水平设为0.01。
AI.findings: t值在0.01水平上显著，表明PBL方法相比传统教育类型能产生额外价值。数据支持的结果显示PBL在专业教育中具有显著优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 将印度传统教育哲学与现代项目式学习理论相结合，为教育创新提供了理论框架。验证了PBL在专业教育环境中的理论有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者提供实施PBL的具体路线图；为MBA等专业教育项目提供有效的教学方法；促进从传统教育向创新教育模式的转变。

title: Community-Based Live Selling: A Strategic Model
affiliations: University of Connecticut - Department of Marketing, Texas A&M University and Georgia Institute of Technology - Ernest Scheller Jr. College of Business

detail.title: Community-Based Live Selling: A Strategic Model
detail.abstract:
Community-based live selling, where entrepreneurs act as both influencers and direct-to-consumer sellers, offers small businesses new ways to reach consumers through real-time social commerce. We develop a game-theoretic model of how streamers allocate communication bandwidth, including the scarce time in live selling sessions and other online content, between two competing activities: educating followers about product categories (which builds informed consumers) versus describing specific products (which enables precise product-consumer matching). This trade-off shapes market outcomes by interacting with two key mechanisms: social learning, where uninformed buyers mimic informed ones, and urgency, which strengthens the social signals generated by quick purchase decisions.

Our analysis yields four insights. First, the streamer benefits from selling to social learners only when product quality is moderate; for high-quality products, focusing on informed buyers is optimal. Second, social learners' presence can raise consumer surplus across the community, particularly when they are highly responsive to social signals. Third, educating followers allows streamers to charge premiums for products with moderate quality but may reduce overall consumer surplus. Finally, expanding the community is not always optimal even if costless, although effective education makes expansion more attractive.

These results highlight how live commerce generates distinctive forms of imprecise matching and reveal counterintuitive effects: bigger communities do not always benefit streamers and higher product qualities do not always benefit consumers. 
The findings carry implications for seller strategy, platform design, and consumer protection in this rapidly growing online selling format.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了社区直播销售中主播如何分配沟通带宽（直播时间和其他在线内容）的教育与产品描述之间的权衡，分析了社会学习和紧迫性机制如何影响市场结果，发现社区规模扩大和产品质量提高并不总是对主播和消费者有利。
AI.research_question: 在社区直播销售中，主播应如何在教育粉丝（建立知情消费者）和描述具体产品（实现精准匹配）之间分配有限的沟通带宽？这种权衡如何通过社会学习和紧迫性机制影响市场结果？
AI.motivation: 社区直播销售为小企业提供了通过实时社交商务接触消费者的新途径，但主播面临沟通带宽分配的决策难题：是教育粉丝建立产品类别知识，还是直接描述具体产品实现精准匹配。理解这种权衡如何通过社会学习和紧迫性机制影响市场结果对卖家和平台设计至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型分析主播的沟通带宽分配决策；社会学习理论（非知情买家模仿知情买家）；紧迫性机制（快速购买决策增强社会信号）；产品-消费者匹配理论。
AI.method: 建立博弈论模型分析主播在教育和产品描述之间的沟通带宽分配决策，考虑社会学习和紧迫性机制对市场结果的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 主播仅在产品质量中等时从向社交学习者销售中获益；高质量产品时专注于知情买家更优。2. 社交学习者的存在可以提高整个社区的消费者剩余，特别是当他们高度响应社会信号时。3. 教育粉丝允许主播对中等质量产品收取溢价，但可能降低整体消费者剩余。4. 即使无成本，扩大社区规模也不总是最优，但有效的教育使扩张更具吸引力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了直播商务中不精确匹配的独特形式。2. 发现了反直觉效应：更大的社区并不总是使主播受益，更高的产品质量并不总是使消费者受益。3. 理论化了社会学习和紧迫性机制在直播销售中的交互作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为卖家策略提供指导：根据产品质量调整沟通策略。2. 为平台设计提供启示：考虑如何优化社区规模和互动机制。3. 为消费者保护提供参考：理解社交学习可能带来的影响。

title: Beyond Automation: Redesigning Jobs with LLMs to Enhance Productivity
affiliations: , affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Exeter Business School - Department of Economics

detail.title: Beyond Automation: Redesigning Jobs with LLMs to Enhance Productivity
detail.abstract: The adoption of generative artificial intelligence (AI) is predicted to lead to fundamental shifts in the labour market, resulting in displacement or augmentation of AI-exposed roles. To investigate the impact of AI across a large organisation, we assessed AI exposure at the task level within roles at the UK Civil Service (UKCS). Using a novel dataset of UKCS job adverts, covering 193,497 vacancies over 6 years, our large language model (LLM)-driven analysis estimated AI exposure scores of 1,542,411 tasks. By aggregating AI exposure scores for tasks within each role, we calculated the mean and variance of job-level exposure to AI, highlighting the heterogeneous impacts of AI, even for seemingly identical jobs. We then use an LLM to redesign jobs, focusing on task automation, task optimisation, and task reallocation. We find that the redesign process leads to tasks where humans have comparative advantage over AI, including strategic leadership, complex problem resolution, and stakeholder management. Overall, automation and augmentation are expected to have nuanced effects across all levels of the organizational hierarchy. Most economic value of AI is expected to arise from productivity gains rather than role displacement. We contribute to the automation, augmentation and productivity debates as well as advance our understanding of job redesign in the age of AI.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用大语言模型分析英国公务员系统19.3万个职位空缺，评估了154万个任务的AI暴露程度，发现AI对工作的影响具有异质性。通过任务自动化、优化和重新分配进行工作再设计，发现人类在战略领导、复杂问题解决和利益相关者管理方面具有比较优势。AI的经济价值主要来自生产力提升而非岗位替代。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI如何影响大型组织中的工作？AI暴露程度在不同角色中如何分布？工作再设计如何帮助人类发挥相对于AI的比较优势？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI预计将导致劳动力市场的根本性转变，可能替代或增强AI暴露的角色。需要实证研究AI在大型组织中的实际影响，特别是任务层面的异质性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自动化与增强理论、比较优势理论、工作再设计理论、生产力经济学、组织层级理论
AI.method: 使用大语言模型分析英国公务员系统193,497个职位空缺（6年数据），评估1,542,411个任务的AI暴露程度，计算职位层面的平均暴露度和方差。然后使用LLM进行工作再设计，关注任务自动化、优化和重新分配。
AI.findings: 1. AI暴露程度在不同角色中存在显著异质性，即使是看似相同的工作；2. 工作再设计后，人类在战略领导、复杂问题解决和利益相关者管理方面具有比较优势；3. 自动化和增强对组织各层级都有细微影响；4. AI的经济价值主要来自生产力提升而非岗位替代。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 推进自动化与增强的辩论；2. 深化对AI时代工作再设计的理解；3. 提供任务层面AI暴露的异质性分析框架；4. 丰富比较优势理论在AI背景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织提供AI影响评估方法；2. 指导工作再设计实践；3. 帮助识别人类相对于AI的核心优势领域；4. 为政策制定者提供AI劳动力市场影响的实证依据。

title: Real-World Applicability of Multiple International Terminology Systems in Oncology: A Comprehensive Experience in Mapping Clinical Terms for Cancer Diagnosis and Treatment
affiliations: National Cancer Center, Korea, National Cancer Center, Korea, National Cancer Center, Korea, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences - National Cancer Center, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences - National Cancer Center, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences - National Cancer Center, National Cancer Center, Korea - Graduate School of Cancer Science and Policy, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences - National Cancer Center, National Cancer Center, Korea, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences - National Cancer Center and Seoul National University - Seoul National University Bundang Hospital

detail.title: Real-World Applicability of Multiple International Terminology Systems in Oncology: A Comprehensive Experience in Mapping Clinical Terms for Cancer Diagnosis and Treatment
detail.abstract: Objective: With the rapid expansion of healthcare data, multiple international standardized terminology systems have been developed and refined to ensure semantic interoperability, a crucial factor in facilitating collaborative use. The aim of this study was to evaluate the real-world utility and applicability of standardized terminology systems by mapping clinical terms from routine cancer care and to propose guidelines that optimize mapping.Materials and methods: Clinical terms generated during cancer care at the National Cancer Center Korea were extracted and mapped to multiple target terminology systems: the Korean Standard Classification of Diseases; International Classification of Diseases, 9th Revision, Clinical Modification; Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes (LOINC); RxNorm; Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical classification; and Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms (SNOMED CT). Healthcare information managers, data experts, and oncologists cross-verified mapping outcomes, calculated concordance, and compared coverage across systems.Results: In total, 3,565 source terms were identified across chief complaint, diagnosis, laboratory and imaging tests, surgery/procedure, medication, and radiation therapy. With post-coordination and predefined mapping guidelines, SNOMED CT achieved >90% exact semantic match in all domains, while inter-mapper discordance remained low (0.7–2.7%). RxNorm and LOINC showed complementary strengths within their specialized domains, extending coverage where SNOMED CT was limited.Conclusions: Standardized terminology systems are feasible and effective for encoding clinical terms in cancer care. SNOMED CT was the most comprehensive, and predefined mapping guidelines markedly reduced discrepancies among mappers. Domain-specific systems should be used alongside SNOMED CT, and all systems should be updated regularly to reflect evolving clinical practice.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了标准化术语系统在癌症护理中的实际应用效果，通过将韩国国家癌症中心的临床术语映射到多个国际标准术语系统，发现SNOMED CT在所有领域都实现了超过90%的精确语义匹配，而预定义的映射指南显著减少了映射者之间的差异。
AI.research_question: 标准化术语系统在癌症护理中的实际效用和适用性如何？如何优化临床术语的映射过程？
AI.motivation: 随着医疗数据的快速增长，需要确保语义互操作性以促进协作使用。多个国际标准化术语系统已经开发和完善，但它们在真实世界癌症护理中的实际效用和适用性需要评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于标准化术语系统理论、语义互操作性理论、临床术语映射理论，以及医疗信息管理中的术语标准化框架。
AI.method: 从韩国国家癌症中心的常规癌症护理中提取临床术语，映射到多个目标术语系统（韩国标准疾病分类、ICD-9-CM、LOINC、RxNorm、ATC、SNOMED CT），由医疗信息管理者、数据专家和肿瘤学家交叉验证映射结果，计算一致性并比较系统间的覆盖范围。
AI.findings: 共识别3,565个源术语，涵盖主诉、诊断、实验室和影像检查、手术/操作、药物和放射治疗等领域。使用后协调和预定义映射指南后，SNOMED CT在所有领域实现了超过90%的精确语义匹配，映射者间的不一致率保持在0.7-2.7%的低水平。RxNorm和LOINC在其专业领域显示出互补优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了标准化术语系统在癌症护理中的可行性和有效性理论；提出了术语映射的优化理论框架；证明了预定义映射指南对减少映射差异的理论价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的术语映射指南；证明了SNOMED CT在癌症护理中的全面性；建议领域特定系统应与SNOMED CT结合使用；强调了定期更新术语系统以反映临床实践变化的重要性。

title: The Autonomous Financial Investigator (AFI): A Generative AI Framework for Cross-Module Anomaly Resolution in SAP
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Autonomous Financial Investigator (AFI): A Generative AI Framework for Cross-Module Anomaly Resolution in SAP
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Autonomous Financial Investigator (AFI), a conceptual Generative AI framework for resolving financial anomalies across integrated SAP ERP modules. AFI is envisioned as a cognitive automation system that emulates the reasoning process of an expert financial investigator, autonomously detecting, interpreting, and explaining inconsistencies that span financial, controlling, materials, production and sales domains. The paper develops a multilayered conceptual model describing how AFI observes data patterns, constructs hypotheses, validates relationships, and generates narrative explanations that enhance accounting transparency. The framework contributes to emerging accounting research by defining a theoretical foundation for generative reasoning in enterprise control environments. It proposes a shift from rule-based anomaly detection toward autonomous interpretive intelligence, highlighting implications for continuous assurance, internal control, and the evolution of AIaugmented financial judgment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了自主财务调查员（AFI）概念框架，这是一个用于解决SAP ERP模块间财务异常的生成式AI系统，模拟专家调查员的推理过程，实现跨财务、控制、物料、生产和销售领域的异常自主检测、解释和说明。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够自主检测、解释和解决跨SAP ERP模块财务异常的生成式AI框架？
AI.motivation: 传统基于规则的异常检测方法在复杂的集成企业系统中存在局限性，需要向自主解释性智能转变，以增强会计透明度并支持持续保证和内部控制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生成式推理理论、认知自动化系统、专家推理模拟、企业控制环境中的智能系统框架。
AI.method: 概念模型开发方法，构建多层概念框架，描述AFI如何观察数据模式、构建假设、验证关系并生成叙述性解释。
AI.findings: 提出了AFI概念框架，能够模拟专家财务调查员的推理过程，实现跨领域异常的自主检测和解释，增强会计透明度。
AI.theory_contributions: 为企业在控制环境中的生成式推理奠定了理论基础，推动了从基于规则的异常检测向自主解释性智能的范式转变。
AI.practical_contributions: 为持续保证、内部控制和AI增强的财务判断提供了实用框架，有助于提升企业财务异常检测的效率和准确性。

title: Labor Market Strength and Declining Community College Enrollment
affiliations: and

detail.title: Labor Market Strength and Declining Community College Enrollment

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Declining U.S. college enrollments over the past 15 years have triggered questions about the health of the postsecondary sector. Using institution-level data, we make four points. First, such declines are driven not by the four-year sector but by two-year community colleges, which have apparently shrunk by over 30% since the peak of the Great Recession. Second, over one-third of this apparent decline is an artifact of some community colleges being reclassified as offering four-year degrees. Third, pre-Great Recession data shows a 1 percentage point increase in the local unemployment rate increases first-time community college enrollment by 2 percent, suggesting many students are on the margin between community college and job opportunities. For-profit college enrollments are similarly countercyclical, while public and private four-year college enrollments appear acyclical. Our estimates suggest that strengthening labor markets explain about 60% of the post-Great Recession decline in first-time community college enrollment. Fourth, students whose enrollment decisions are most sensitive to labor market conditions appear unlikely to have completed a degree. Though declining community college enrollments are a challenge for postsecondary institutions, it is less clear whether they signal a problem for students on the margin of enrollment.

AI.tldr: 美国社区大学入学率下降主要由劳动力市场改善、学校分类调整等因素驱动，而非四年制大学问题；对边缘学生而言，入学率下降可能不一定是坏事。
AI.research_question: 美国高等教育入学率下降的原因是什么？特别是社区大学入学率下降是否反映了学生面临的问题？
AI.motivation: 过去15年美国大学入学率持续下降，引发了对高等教育健康状况的担忧，需要深入分析下降的原因和影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场与教育选择的替代关系理论（countercyclical enrollment patterns），即经济好时工作机会多，入学率下降；经济差时工作机会少，入学率上升。
AI.method: 使用机构层面的数据进行分析，包括：1）比较不同教育部门的入学趋势；2）分析学校分类调整的影响；3）建立失业率与入学率的回归模型；4）评估劳动力市场对入学率变化的解释力。
AI.findings: 1）入学率下降主要发生在两年制社区大学，而非四年制大学；2）约三分之一的下降是学校被重新分类为四年制大学的结果；3）失业率每增加1个百分点，社区大学首次入学率增加2%，显示学生处于工作和教育的边际选择；4）劳动力市场改善解释了约60%的经济大衰退后社区大学入学率下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）明确了不同高等教育部门对经济周期的不同反应模式；2）揭示了学校分类调整对入学率统计数据的实质性影响；3）提供了劳动力市场与教育选择边际替代关系的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）帮助政策制定者区分入学率下降的真实原因；2）为高等教育机构提供应对入学率波动的策略依据；3）表明对边缘学生而言，入学率下降可能反映了更好的就业机会而非教育问题。
